title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

At least 1 landing page or ecommerce product page design, shown for desktop and mobile.

At least 3 before-and-after AI compositing examples. For each, show the original source photo, the raw AI generation, and your final image, with a short note on tools used and time spent.

Results where available, such as click-through or conversion lift or a split test outcome. If you are under NDA, explain what you changed and why.

Your role on each project: sole designer, lead, or part of a team.



Live Amazon or Chewy product links are welcome. Portfolios built mainly on templates, stock mockups, or unedited AI output will not move forward.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



A link to your portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, or personal site). Make sure the link is set to public.

A short note on which piece in your portfolio you are most proud of and why.

Start your message with the words “SCROLL STOPPER” so we know you read the full post.



Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Brand & Marketing Strategist for Premium Home Builder
description:
Can you make a premium builder impossible to ignore, for the right clients? 



Build Prestige Homes is a design and construct builder of premium custom homes based in Brisbane, Australia, and we are looking for an expert Marketing Strategist & Specialist to develop our marketing strategy and execute it to the highest standard.

Strategy comes first. We have award-winning residences, a strong reputation built since 2010, a new website and an audience of around 42,000 followers, but our marketing has not kept pace with our work. Your role is to review our content, develop our brand guide and voice, build a clear marketing strategy and then carry it out with expert, careful execution.



We work with a small number of high-end clients. We do not want hundreds of leads that do not suit us and create more work for the team. We want a smaller number of quality enquiries from the right clients. You must understand our brand, understand what our ideal clients need and attract them with work of the highest quality.



We want someone with initiative who is proactive, takes tasks off the directors' plate, solves problems and comes with solutions, not questions. You will build the workflows that keep our marketing moving, progress the strategy efficiently and change direction quickly when feedback shows something is not landing.



You will work closely with the General Manager, with the opportunity to grow alongside the business. This is a part-time independent contractor engagement of 20 hours per week, worked Monday to Friday, with flexible hours between 8:00am and 7:00pm Brisbane time (Australian Eastern Standard Time). All content, brand material, systems and data you create in the role belong to Build Prestige Homes.



Pay is USD $6.50 to $9.50 per hour, depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise.



We offer flexible working times, Philippine public holidays off (unpaid), your birthday off as a paid holiday (paid at your usual daily hours), training and support for your growth and development, the ability to grow with the team and working from home.



Position Requirements

• At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing, including developing marketing strategies and carrying them out with measurable results

• Experience marketing premium or luxury brands, with examples of work that shows a high standard of quality

• Experience developing a brand guide and brand voice, and then following it exactly in writing, design and video

• The ability to understand a client's needs and motivations and attract the right clients, not just more leads

• A portfolio of social media accounts you have run, with examples of posts and the results they achieved

• Strong skills in Canva and short-form video editing for reels and stories

• Proven results in search engine optimisation (SEO) and local search

• Understanding of AI search visibility (generative engine optimisation), including structured data, consistent business listings and content that AI tools cite

• Experience managing Google Business Profile, Google Analytics and Google Search Console

• Hands-on experience with WordPress, including page updates, on-page SEO and enquiry forms

• Experience mapping sales processes and building a CRM around them, including funnels and automations

• Confident using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) to build dashboards, automations and marketing work, with the judgement to check and edit everything before it is published

• Excellent written English, with a high standard of grammar, spelling and consistency

• Strong initiative: proactive, solution focused and able to work independently with minimal supervision

• Takes feedback well and repositions work quickly when it is not landing

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection and a suitable work environment



Key Responsibilities

Content Review & Brand Guide

• Review our existing content, website, social channels and brand material within your first 2 weeks

• Develop our brand guide and brand voice within your first 2 weeks, for approval by the directors

• Apply the approved brand guide to every piece of work, with no exceptions

• Check every post, page,
 and video for accuracy, spelling, grammar and consistency before it is submitted

Marketing Strategy

• Build our marketing strategy and 90 day action plan within your first 4 weeks, for approval by the directors

• Define our ideal client, key messages and channel priorities

• Focus every activity on quality enquiries from clients building premium homes over $1.2 million in South East Queensland

• Break the plan into 2 week work cycles and review results at the end of each cycle

• Adjust the strategy quickly when results or feedback show something is not working

Social Media

• Plan and run a content calendar across Instagram,
, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Houzz, posting regularly and on schedule

• Create posts, carousels, reels and stories from our library of residence and site photographs and video

• Respond to comments and messages promptly and pass genuine enquiries to the team the same day

• Grow engagement with our existing audience of around 42,000 followers

Campaigns & Content

• Run campaigns from start to finish, including content, landing pages,
s and social posts

• Draft and publish journal articles on our website that support both search and AI visibility

• Draft suburb and service pages, residence case studies and campaign landing pages for approval

• Maintain our new website, including page updates, on-page SEO and fixing errors

Search & AI Visibility

• Improve our Google rankings for high-intent local searches such as custom home builder and luxury home builder across our service areas

• Keep our Google Business Profile current, with regular posts and photographs

• Make Build Prestige Homes visible and accurately described in AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity

• Keep our business details consistent everywhere they appear online

Sales Funnel Automation & CRM Development

• Map our current sales funnel and processes with the directors, from first enquiry through to signed agreement

• Design and build a customised, low-cost CRM around our sales funnel and processes, potentially as an AI dashboard with our own stages, settings and automations

• Maintain the CRM so every enquiry is recorded, qualified, tracked and followed up

• Build and automate the sales funnel up to the point a lead is ready to speak with us: capture, qualification, follow-up and booking

• Filter out unsuitable enquiries and spam so only quality leads reach the team

• Hand qualified leads to the director and general manager, who handle all phone calls and meetings with clients

Referral Marketing

• Develop and maintain our referral contact list of building designers, real estate and buyers agents and other industry contacts

• Support our referral program with outreach content and follow-up

Workflows & Initiative

• Develop the workflows and procedures that keep our marketing running efficiently

• Take marketing tasks off the directors' plate and see them through to completion

• Identify problems early and bring a recommended solution



Key Performance Indicators

• Brand Guide: content review and brand guide delivered within the first 2 weeks

• Strategy: marketing strategy and 90 day action plan delivered within the first 4 weeks

• Quality Enquiries: enquiries that match our ideal client and budget, tracked by source

• Delivery: work completed to plan in each 2 week cycle

• Quality: work submitted to our brand guide and standard, with minimal corrections needed

• Social Media: content calendar delivered on schedule, with engagement growing

• Search & AI: first page Google rankings and accurate AI search results for agreed priority searches

• CRM: every enquiry recorded and followed up within 1 business day



Meetings & Reporting

Daily Update

• Send a short daily update by
, WhatsApp or the AI dashboard covering what was completed, what is next and anything that needs a decision

Twice-Weekly Meeting

• Meet with the director or general manager twice a week to review progress and get the approvals needed to move work forward

• Arrive prepared with a short list of items that need an answer, with your recommendation for each

• Record each decision and action it straight away

Weekly Results Report

• Report each week on enquiries, content delivered, social results, search position and progress against the 90 day plan

• Flag anything off track with a proposed action



Preferred Experience

• Marketing for builders, building designers, interior designers, real estate or other premium home services

• Experience marketing to Australian clients

• Photography or video skills for content

• Experience building custom dashboards, tools or automations with AI



Application Requirements

To show you have read this advert in full, start your application with the phrase "Mango is magnificent". Applications without it will not be considered.



Please submit a reel of 15 to 30 seconds that represents our brand and would attract our ideal client: people planning a premium custom home in South East Queensland. Use the information and photographs on our website, 
. Our logo and brand files are not required. We will judge your reel on its story, tone, pacing and how well it speaks to our ideal client. Share it as a link (Google Drive, Dropbox or an unlisted video) and do not post it publicly.



Please also submit a short video outlining:

• Why you are interested in the position

• How your experience aligns with the position requirements and key responsibilities

• How you would approach our brand guide and marketing strategy in your first 4 weeks

• Why you made the creative choices in your reel

• A time you received feedback that your work was not landing and how you changed it

• Your desired income

• Areas where you may require further training

title: Experienced Cold Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist for Coaching Business (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)
description:
# Experienced Cold Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist for Coaching Business (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)



**Starting Pay:** $5/hour  

**Schedule:** 5 hours per week  

**Trial Period:** 1 month, paid  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with potential to grow into full-time



### About Sedona Coach



I'm the founder of Sedona Coach, a transformational coaching business focused on inner-child healing, emotional patterns, and conscious parenting.



I'm looking for an experienced **cold outreach and lead generation specialist** who can independently find potential clients, start genuine conversations, build relationships, and book qualified coaching consultations.



**This is NOT a position for someone who only responds to inbound leads, messages existing followers, or works from a provided lead list.**



You must have proven experience finding and connecting with completely new prospects.



### Who My Ideal Clients Are



I primarily work with mothers who:



- Have already done some personal development, therapy, or inner-child work but still find themselves reacting emotionally to their children.

- Struggle with yelling, shutting down, controlling behaviors, guilt, or emotional triggers.

- Recognize that some of their parenting reactions may come from unresolved childhood experiences.

- Want to break generational patterns and raise emotionally secure children.

- Are motivated to do deeper personal work and open to investing in coaching.



My clients aren't necessarily looking for parenting tips. They're looking for deeper transformation within themselves so they can become the emotionally safe adults their children need.



### Your Responsibilities



- Independently research and identify new potential clients who fit my target audience.

- Find appropriate cold outreach opportunities through Instagram,
, and other relevant platforms.

- Initiate personalized, respectful conversations with people who are not already connected to Sedona Coach.

- Build genuine relationships and identify interest in coaching.

- Follow up consistently without being pushy.

- Qualify interested prospects and invite them to book consultations.

- Track outreach, responses, qualified conversations, follow-ups, and booked consultations in a simple spreadsheet.

- Communicate regularly about progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.



Because my work involves sensitive personal experiences, I value empathy, professionalism, and genuine connection. I do not want aggressive sales tactics, spam, or mass messaging.



### Requirements



- **Proven experience with cold outbound prospecting**, not just warm or inbound leads.

- Experience generating qualified appointments for coaches, consultants, or service-based businesses.

- Ability to independently research and identify prospects without relying on an existing lead list.

- Strong written English and natural conversational skills.

- Experience with Instagram,
, or similar platforms.

- Reliable communication and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative.



### Schedule, Compensation & Growth Opportunity



- **Starting schedule:** 5 hours per week, approximately 1 hour per day, Monday through Friday.

- **Starting pay:** $5/hour.

- **Trial period:** One-month paid trial.



I understand that cold outreach takes time, especially when building genuine relationships with potential coaching clients. I don't expect immediate bookings in the first week or two.



During the first month, I'll evaluate the quality of prospect research, personalized outreach, meaningful conversations, consistent follow-ups, and progress toward qualified consultations.



**I'm looking for someone who can grow with my business.** If the first month goes well and we see promising results, I'm open to increasing the hours, adjusting compensation based on performance, and potentially offering a full-time position as the business grows.



My goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is reliable, proactive, and genuinely good at connecting with the right people.



### How to Apply



Start your application with the word **SEDONA** and answer the following questions based on your actual experience.



1. Have you personally found and contacted completely new prospects who were not already following or engaging with your client's business? Explain exactly how you found them.

2. What platforms or methods have you used for cold prospecting? Please give a specific example.

3. How many qualified consultations did you personally book through cold outreach in a previous role, and how many hours per week were you working?

4. If you started working for Sedona Coach tomorrow with no existing lead list and limited social media engagement, where would you look for potential clients?

5. With only five hours per week, how many new prospects and follow-ups could you realistically manage, and how many qualified consultations would you aim to book per month?



Please answer in your own words, without AI-generated responses. I'm interested in your actual experience, your approach, and how you think.



**Only apply if you have real cold outreach experience.**



Thank you!  

Misun  

Founder, Sedona Coach

We are an Australian-based company looking for an experienced Mobile App Developer to help extend our existing web-based application to mobile platforms, making it accessible on both iOS and Android devices.



The successful candidate will assess the current application, recommend a suitable development approach, and implement a mobile solution that maintains the system's existing functionality while providing a smooth and user-friendly mobile experience.

Review the existing web-based application and understand its functionality and technical requirements.



Recommend an appropriate approach for making the application available on iOS and Android.



Develop, implement, and test mobile applications based on the agreed project scope.



Ensure the mobile application integrates properly with the existing system, database, and backend services, where applicable.



Adapt existing features and workflows to provide a user-friendly mobile experience.



Ensure compatibility, performance, security, and reliability across supported devices.



Identify and resolve technical issues, bugs, and functionality gaps.



Collaborate with the team to clarify requirements, provide progress updates, and address technical concerns.



Assist with application deployment and submission to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, where required.



Provide source code, technical documentation, and relevant project files upon completion.



Provide post-launch support and maintenance as agreed.



Requirements



Proven experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android.



Experience working with existing web applications, APIs, databases, and backend systems.



Knowledge of relevant mobile development technologies and frameworks.



Ability to assess technical requirements and recommend practical, cost-effective solutions.



Understanding of mobile application design, security, testing, and performance optimisation.



Experience with application deployment and publishing to mobile app stores.



Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, manage project deliverables, and meet agreed deadlines.



Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with a remote team.



Project requirements, timelines, milestones, and fees will be discussed and agreed upon.



How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit their CV or portfolio, including examples of relevant mobile application projects.



Please also include your technical expertise, recommended approach for extending an existing web-based application to mobile platforms, estimated project cost, and availability.



Applicants should be able to provide an estimated cost and timeline based on the project requirements.



We look forward to working with a skilled developer who can deliver a practical, reliable, and user-friendly mobile solution.

title: Architectural / Structural Drafter
description:
Reynolds Engineering Company is seeking a part-time or full-time architectural and structural drafter to assist with residential and small commercial projects.



Our work generally involves preparing architectural and structural plans for building permit applications. Typical projects include renovations, additions, changes in use, structural repairs, and modifications to existing buildings, with a focus on masonry and wood-frame construction. It is preferable if the candidate has experience with both architectural and structural drafting. Extra bonus if you have a structural / civil engineering background. 



Responsibilities:

-Prepare architectural and structural drawings using AutoCAD and Revit

-Develop existing and proposed floor plans, building elevations, and architectural details

-Prepare foundation plans, structural framing plans, and structural details

-Produce coordinated drawing sets for building permit applications

-Revise plans based on field measurements, photographs, sketches, markups, and engineering direction

-Interpret existing building conditions and develop drawings when complete information is not readily available

-Gather relevant information from photographs, available property records, online resources, manufacturer information, and other project documentation

-Work through project-specific construction details with the project engineer and identify conditions requiring additional information or field verification

-Coordinate architectural layouts with structural requirements

-Assist with revisions and responses to permit review comments

-Help maintain company drawing standards, standard details, and project files



Qualifications:

-Experience preparing architectural and structural construction drawings

-Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Revit

-Experience with masonry and wood-frame construction

-Ability to read and understand architectural and structural plans

-Ability to evaluate available information, research existing conditions, and work through details without always receiving complete drafting markups

-Good judgment in recognizing when information is missing or when additional direction or field verification is needed

-Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, organized drawing sets

-Familiarity with residential and small commercial construction

-Ability to manage multiple assignments and work independently while communicating questions as they arise



Experience with structural engineering or structural design is preferred. The ideal candidate will be able to understand structural conditions, work through basic framing and construction issues, and assist in developing appropriate structural details rather than only drafting completed markups.



Familiarity with the International Building Code, International Residential Code, and other applicable building codes is also preferred. Experience with load-bearing masonry, wood framing, steel framing, foundations, and structural repairs would be particularly helpful.



This is preferably a full-time employee position but part-time would be considered. Please submit a resume and examples of relevant architectural and/or structural drafting work.

title: Virtual Events & Customer Support Assistant (Eventbrite + OpenTable + Email Management)
description:
# Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist (Remote)



**Eventbrite | POSH | Luma | Customer Service |
 & Phone Support | Administrative Operations**



**Company:** DMV Events / Konnex Events  

**Location:** 100% Remote – International Applicants Welcome  

**Position:** Part-Time Initially, With Full-Time Growth Opportunity  

**Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Washington, D.C. Time (Eastern Time)  

**Compensation:** $2–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws  

**Start Date:** Immediate



## About Our Company



We are a fast-growing, U.S.-based events, entertainment, and technology company headquartered in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.



Our company organizes singles mixers, speed dating events, nightlife experiences, bar crawls, networking events, social gatherings, and special events at restaurants, lounges, and nightclubs.



We work with multiple venues, entertainment partners, promoters, and customers across Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia, Maryland, and expanding U.S. markets.



We currently manage **100+ active event listings** and utilize multiple online platforms to coordinate ticket sales, registrations, customer communication, event marketing, and business operations.



As our company continues expanding, we are looking for a **highly organized, dependable, intelligent, and proactive Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist** to help manage the daily operations of our business.



**This is much more than a traditional Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who can eventually become a trusted member of our operations team, independently handle customer inquiries, manage event listings, communicate with business partners, and keep our company running smoothly.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people, learns software quickly, and can manage multiple assignments simultaneously.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Service & Virtual Support



You will serve as one of the primary points of contact for our customers.



- Monitor and respond to incoming customer
s throughout your assigned shifts.

- Answer questions regarding upcoming events, tickets, venues, schedules, and registration.

- Provide excellent customer support through
, online messaging, live chat, and telephone.

- Handle ticket-related questions, cancellations, refund requests, and registration issues according to company policies.

- Respond professionally to customer complaints and resolve problems efficiently.

- Follow up with customers to ensure their questions are answered and issues are resolved.

- Help attendees understand event locations, arrival instructions, and check-in procedures.

- Escalate urgent or sensitive customer matters to management.

- Maintain a friendly, welcoming, professional customer experience.



**Excellent spoken and written English is essential for this position.**



### 2. Eventbrite, POSH & Luma Event Management



You will help manage our online event listings and registration platforms.



Platforms include:



- Eventbrite

- POSH

- Luma

- Other event registration and ticketing platforms



Responsibilities include:



- Create new events on multiple platforms.

- Duplicate and schedule recurring weekly events.

- Write, edit, and improve event descriptions.

- Upload event flyers, promotional images, and information.

- Update ticket pricing, registration limits, and event details.

- Ensure addresses, event times, venue names, and dates are accurate.

- Monitor event registrations and ticket sales.

- Review existing listings for mistakes, outdated information, or broken links.

- Maintain consistency across all ticketing platforms.

- Assist with registration lists and attendee check-in reports.

- Track upcoming events and confirm listings are published on time.



You must be comfortable managing **100+ active event listings** while maintaining accuracy and organization.



### 3.
, Telephone & Business Communication



This position requires excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with customers and business partners.



- Monitor and organize company
 inboxes.

- Respond promptly and professionally to incoming messages.

- Make and receive business telephone calls when required.

- Communicate with customers, restaurants, nightclubs, event organizers, DJs, and venue management.

- Confirm event schedules and coordinate logistical details with partner venues.

- Send reminders, confirmations, and follow-up messages.

- Draft professional business
s.

- Communicate updates between customers, partners, and company management.

- Maintain organized records of important conversations and follow-up tasks.



**You must be confident speaking English on the telephone with U.S.-based customers and business professionals.**



### 4. Venue Reservations & Partner Coordination



You will assist our operations team with coordinating weekly events across multiple restaurants, lounges, and entertainment venues.



- Use OpenTable and other reservation systems to make and manage reservations.

- Confirm reservations and event arrangements with venues.

- Coordinate arrival times, table sizes, and expected attendance.

- Maintain updated contact information for venue managers and partners.

- Confirm that participating venues have accurate event information.

- Assist with last-minute event changes and schedule adjustments.

- Maintain professional relationships with venue staff and partners.

- Track confirmations, outstanding requests, and unresolved issues.



### 5. Administrative Operations & Multitasking



You will help keep the company's daily operations running smoothly.



- Manage multiple assignments and platforms simultaneously.

- Maintain organized calendars, schedules, and spreadsheets.

- Update Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and internal tracking systems.

- Track ticket sales, registrations, customer support requests, and attendance.

- Prepare basic daily and weekly activity reports.

- Keep digital files, folders, and event records organized.

- Identify missing information, incorrect listings, and operational issues.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks without constant reminders.

- Prioritize urgent customer support requests while completing administrative work.

- Provide management with regular updates on completed assignments and outstanding issues.



**You must be someone who can independently manage a busy workflow without becoming overwhelmed.**



### 6. Marketing, CRM & Customer Follow-Ups



You may also assist our team with basic marketing and customer engagement activities.



- Help coordinate
 and SMS campaigns for customers who have opted in to receive communications.

- Prepare event reminders and follow-up communications.

- Maintain customer and attendee databases.

- Assist with CRM updates and customer segmentation.

- Help coordinate promotional campaigns across different event platforms.

- Schedule basic social media posts.

- Support customer retention and repeat attendance initiatives.

- Work with management on improving customer satisfaction and event participation.



### 7. Special Projects & Business Growth



As our company grows, you may also support additional projects involving:



- Onboarding new event venues and organizers.

- Expanding events into additional U.S. cities.

- Helping organize new customer service processes.

- Supporting new software platforms and event technology.

- Improving internal workflows and operations.

- Assisting with partner communications and new business opportunities.



We value employees who contribute ideas, identify inefficiencies, and help us improve our operations.



## Required Qualifications



**Communication Skills**



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Clear, professional speaking voice.

- Confidence handling telephone calls with U.S. customers and business partners.

- Ability to write professional
s independently.

- Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

- Ability to communicate calmly and professionally when resolving problems.



**Computer & Technical Skills**



- Excellent general computer and internet skills.

- Ability to quickly learn new software platforms.

- Comfortable working with multiple browser tabs and applications.

- Familiarity with Gmail or similar
 platforms.

- Experience with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, or Microsoft Excel.

- Good typing speed and attention to detail.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic software and account issues.



**Organization & Work Ethic**



- Excellent multitasking abilities.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Highly dependable, punctual, and responsive.

- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Comfortable working independently.

- Ability to follow written instructions and standard operating procedures.

- Willingness to learn and accept constructive feedback.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.



**Equipment & Availability**



- Reliable computer or laptop.

- Stable high-speed internet connection.

- Working microphone or headset for customer calls.

- Quiet, professional environment for telephone conversations.

- Consistent availability during assigned shifts within 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

- Ability to attend occasional meetings or support special event schedules with advance notice.



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in the following areas is a major advantage:



- Virtual Assistant or Executive Assistant

- Customer Support Representative

- Administrative Assistant

- Event Coordinator or Event Management

- Eventbrite event management

- POSH or Luma event creation

- OpenTable or restaurant reservation systems

- Call center or telephone customer service

- Hotel, hospitality, restaurant, or nightlife operations

-
 and SMS marketing

- CRM or customer database management

- Canva or basic graphic design

- Social media management



**Previous Eventbrite experience is strongly preferred, but we will consider candidates with excellent communication skills, administrative experience, and the ability to learn quickly.**



## Work Schedule



**Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Washington, D.C. Time (Eastern Time)**



We are initially hiring for a part-time role, with scheduled working hours falling within this window.



Qualified candidates must have reliable availability during their assigned hours.



As responsibilities expand, the position may transition into a full-time role covering the complete business day.



Some additional flexibility may be requested during busy event weeks or special occasions.



## Compensation & Career Growth



**Starting Compensation: $2–$5 USD per hour**, based on relevant experience, communication ability, location, and applicable employment laws.



We offer:



- Long-term employment opportunities.

- Flexible growth from part-time to full-time.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for increased responsibilities and compensation.

- Exposure to U.S. event management and hospitality operations.

- Training on different software platforms.

- Potential advancement into a supervisory or operations management role.



**Career Growth Opportunity:**



Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist → Senior Operations Assistant → Events Operations Manager



We want to invest in someone who can grow with our company over the long term.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role?



We are looking for someone who:



- Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions.

- Notices and corrects mistakes before they become problems.

- Responds quickly and follows through on commitments.

- Enjoys helping customers and solving problems.

- Can communicate confidently with venue owners and business partners.

- Learns new software and processes quickly.

- Can independently manage several different systems.

- Stays organized even when handling multiple assignments.

- Takes ownership of their responsibilities.

- Wants to become an important part of a growing company.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assignments mechanically. We want someone who thinks ahead, understands our business, and helps us operate more efficiently.



## Please Do Not Apply If:



- You cannot consistently work your assigned Eastern Time schedule.

- You are uncomfortable speaking English on the telephone.

- You frequently miss deadlines or require constant reminders.

- You are unable to multitask or manage competing priorities.

- You cannot respond to customers promptly during scheduled working hours.

- You do not have reliable internet access.

- You cannot dedicate sufficient attention to this role.

- You are not interested in learning new software or processes.



We are looking for someone **reliable, professional, detail-oriented, and committed to long-term growth**.



## How to Apply



To demonstrate that you have carefully read this job posting, **start your application with the words: "DMV Events Pro."**



Please include the following:



1. **Resume:** Attach your most recent resume or CV.

2. **Customer Support Experience:** Describe your previous experience handling customer
s, chat messages, and telephone calls.

3. **Event Platform Experience:** Tell us whether you have used Eventbrite, POSH, Luma, OpenTable, or similar platforms.

4. **English Communication:** Provide a short 45–60 second voice introduction explaining your background and why you are interested in this position.

5. **Computer & Internet:** Tell us what type of computer you use and your internet speed.

6. **Availability:** Confirm that you can work during assigned shifts between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Washington, D.C. time, Monday through Friday.

7. **Hourly Rate:** State your expected hourly compensation in USD.

8. **Why Should We Hire You?** Explain what makes you a strong candidate and how you would help our company.



**We are interviewing immediately and aim to make hiring decisions within 48 hours of completing the interview process.**



If you are highly organized, excellent with customers, confident using technology, and excited to grow with a fast-moving U.S. events and entertainment company, we encourage you to apply.



**Join our team and help us build one of the fastest-growing event communities in the Washington, D.C. area and beyond.**

title: Credit Optimization Specialist (Credit Repair Experience) | 700 to 800+ | Long-Term Potential
description:
I’m a business owner looking for an experienced credit specialist to help take my personal credit score from the low 700s to 800+. The target timeline is 2 to 3 months. I know that’s aggressive, and I want someone who will tell me honestly what’s achievable in that window and what will take longer, rather than someone who promises a number.



If this engagement goes well, there will be additional work, including business credit building and ongoing financial operations support. I’m looking for a long-term partner, not a one-off gig.



What You’ll Do



- Review my three bureau reports (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) and identify exactly what is holding my score below 800

- Deliver a written, prioritized action plan with expected impact and timing for each item

- Draft dispute letters for any inaccurate, outdated, or unverifiable items, and goodwill letters where appropriate

- Build a utilization strategy, including statement-date payment timing and credit limit increase requests

- Track score changes weekly and report progress in a simple shared tracker

- Advise on what NOT to do (new accounts, closures, inquiries) during the optimization window



Requirements



- 3+ years of hands-on credit repair or credit optimization experience with US clients

- Strong working knowledge of FICO 8, FICO 9/10, and VantageScore, and how each weighs utilization, age, and payment history

- Working knowledge of the FCRA, FDCPA, and Credit Repair Organizations Act

- Experience with clients already in the 700s (optimizing a good score is different from repairing a poor one)

- Excellent written English. Your dispute letters will go to US bureaus and creditors.

- Attention to detail is non-negotiable. To confirm you read this posting in full, type the word SPARK in all caps at the very top of your application and in your
 subject line. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel for progress tracking

- Available for at least two 30-minute video calls per month during US Central Time business hours



Security and Working Arrangement



- I will provide redacted reports and documents. You will not need my logins, passwords, or full SSN, and you should never ask for them.

- I will submit all disputes and account requests myself based on your drafts and instructions.

- Payment is per completed milestone or hourly for work performed. I do not pay upfront fees for promised results.



How to Apply



Please include:



- A short summary of your credit optimization experience, specifically with clients starting in the 700s

- One or two anonymized examples of results you’ve achieved (starting score, ending score, timeframe)

- Your honest view: is 700 to 800+ in 2 to 3 months realistic, and what factors d
 it?

title: Full-Time 3D FPS Weapon & First-Person Arms Animator (Blender/Maya), Remote
description:
Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term

Pay: USD $1,200–$2,500/month depending on skill and portfolio, plus bonuses for outstanding work



About us

We’re a game technology startup building an AI-first game engine. Our first title is a fast first-person shooter in the style of Call of Duty: Black Ops 2/3. We need a talented artist to build our in-house library of first-person weapons, arms and animations.



What you’ll do



Build first-person arms: realistic gloves and sleeves, a clean game-ready rig, natural hand and finger poses.

Model and texture game-ready weapons: pistols, rifles, SMGs, shotguns, snipers and melee, with separate moving parts (magazine, slide, bolt, pump).

Animate first-person weapon actions: idle, aim down sights, fire and recoil, tactical reload, empty reload (with slide or charging handle), inspect, draw and holster, sprint, and melee swings.

Work to our technical spec (rig, naming, attachment points, file formats) and deliver clean FBX/GLB plus source .blend/.ma files.

Take feedback and iterate quickly. We review every delivery in-engine.



Must have



A strong portfolio of first-person (FPS) viewmodel work: arms holding weapons, reloads, inspects.

An excellent eye for hand and finger contact: thumbs wrapped, no clipping, no floating fingers, natural grip.

Blender or Maya (rigging, animation, hard-surface modelling, PBR texturing; Substance Painter is a plus).

Good English communication and reliable daily availability with some overlap with Australian hours.



Nice to have



Shipped FPS game, mod or Unreal/Unity weapon pack experience.

Game-optimised modelling: low/high-poly baking, LODs, texture budgets.

Experience with procedural or modular weapon systems (attachments, gunsmith).



Important: ownership

All work is made from scratch for us, with no marketplace assets and no AI-generated meshes. Full copyright and IP are assigned to our company.



How to apply (applications without a Drive link will not be reviewed)

Send us one Google Drive link (set to “Anyone with the link can view”) containing:



Videos of your first-person weapon animations, especially reloads and inspects (MP4, screen recordings are fine).

Screenshots or renders of first-person arms holding weapons, with close-ups of the hands and grip.

Any weapon models you’ve made: wireframes, renders, texture sheets.

(Optional) A source file or two (.blend/.ma/.fbx) so we can check your rig and animation quality.

A short note: your experience, the software you use, your monthly rate, and when you can start.



Start your application with the words “CLEAN GRIP” so we know you read this ad.



Next step: shortlisted applicants get a paid test task: a small first-person rifle grip plus reload in our spec. The best test gets the full-time role.

"Before an insurance inspection report can be finalized, the assigned representative must thoroughly reconcile discrepancies between documented property conditions, verbal statements, and photographic evidence. For example, if an insured indicates that a commercial sprinkler system was recently inspected, but the supporting certification is unavailable or illegible, the report must clearly distinguish verified observations from unsubstantiated claims. Similarly, discrepancies involving subcontractor indemnification agreements, general liability exposures, occupancy classifications, or workers' compensation documentation must be identified and communicated without introducing assumptions. When coordinating multiple appointments across different jurisdictions, administrative personnel must independently verify scheduling changes, accurately interpret detailed instructions, and prioritize outstanding documentation requests. Miscommunication, incomplete information, or inaccurate reporting can create significant complications during the underwriting review process."

Submit your current resume outlining your relevant experience, qualifications, and employment history.

**Apply using EXACTLY 20 AP (Apply Points). No more and no less.**

AI tools are permitted for approved work tasks after hiring. However, applicants must already possess the required English proficiency and professional skills.



**AI-generated voice recordings, text-to-speech software, translation tools, or AI-assisted application assessments are strictly prohibited.** Your recording must demonstrate your actual speaking ability.

title: Remote Executive Assistant & Operations Manager (Contract)
description:
Remote Executive Assistant & Operations Manager (Contract to Long-Term)



ABOUT THE ROLE

I'm a CEO based in rural North Dakota, USA. I actively run about 10 businesses and projects, including an accounting firm, a construction company, a lumberyard, rental properties, and some newer ventures like retail stores, and a custom travel service. I need a right-hand person who supports me directly and keeps my teams moving.



Each morning we'll chat about what needs to happen that day and who on my team needs to do it. You assign the work, follow up, and make sure it gets done and help me keep on top of things across all aspects of work life. 



I'm hiring for the long term. The role starts as a contract, and my goal is to keep the right person on my team for years.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Chat with me every morning and turn that conversation into a task list with owners and due dates

- Assign tasks to team members and follow up until each one is finished

- Manage my calendar, remind me what's coming, and make sure I'm prepared for every meeting

- Contact team members before meetings to collect what I need

- Track orders and deliveries and tell me about delays

- Respond to
s as me/for me as needed. 

- Research questions I send you and bring back a short answer with sources

- Edit and review written drafts for clarity and errors

- Design processes and SOPs as needed. 

- Help onboard new staff across all the companies, including setting up their accounts, walking them through our tools, and checking in during their first weeks

- Handle day-to-day operations and IT issues as they come up, such as account access, software setup, shared drives, and troubleshooting tools that stop working

- Track deadlines across all the businesses and tell me when two of them conflict



HOW WE WORK

- We work in Google Workspace and a task management system.

- I use AI heavily in my businesses. I'll train you on the AI systems I've built, and I expect you to use them every day.



WHAT MAKES THIS JOB HARD

- You'll work with people who have very different personalities. Some need a gentle reminder and some need a firm push.

- You'll hold team members accountable, including people more senior than you.

- Priorities change often. You'll need to d
 what matters most when everything feels urgent, and ask me when you can't tell.

- Some days bring problems nobody planned for. You'll need to figure out who or what can fix them, and solve them yourself when you can. But know when it's time to ask me and elevate the issue. 

- You'll work mostly US Central Time business hours. That means evenings and overnight in the Philippines. We could do a daily chat at my end of day, or my beginning of day. 



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, or project coordinator supporting a business owner or executive

- Experience assigning and following up on work for a team of 5-15 or more people

- Experience managing an executive's calendar and

- Uses Notion or Google Workspace in daily work

- Uses AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in daily work

- Has handled basic IT support, such as setting up user accounts, managing access, or troubleshooting software

- Has worked with US-based clients

- Strong written English, with experience editing other people's writing

- Reliable internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in accounting, construction, or property management, retail

- Experience with QuickBooks Online

- Familiarity with EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System). We don't run EOS, but we use parts of the system.



PAY AND TERMS

- $8–$12 USD per hour, based on experience

- 10-20 hours per week

- Independent contractor to start, moving to a long-term role for the right person

- Fully remote



HOW TO APPLY

Send these three things:

1. Your resume

2. A video introduction, 2 minutes or less

3. Your answer to this question: Tell me about a time you had to get someone more senior than you to finish work they were behind on. What did you do?

title: Python / PostgreSQL Engineer - Build a Complete Automation System
description:
We are a small property business hiring an experienced engineer to build a complete Python/PostgreSQL automation system from the ground up.



This is a clean build of the full system. You will own delivery from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment and a working end-to-end demonstration. Existing business records and communication history must be carried over safely.



THE WORK

- Turn the business workflow into a clear, practical build plan with milestones, effort estimates and acceptance checks.

- Build the property research, data organization and contact-follow-up workflows, with clear human approval points and an audit trail.

- Integrate external APIs, webhooks and useful AI services.

- Handle incoming events, background jobs and saved next actions reliably.

- Prevent duplicate database writes or customer messages when events repeat, jobs overlap or processes restart.

- Handle uncertain external API outcomes safely rather than blindly repeating an action.

- Migrate required historical records, contact restrictions and prior-send history without losing data or repeating completed actions.

- Deliver deployment, monitoring, startup/recovery procedures and straightforward operating documentation.



Our current working environment includes Windows Python. Explain how your proposed deployment will operate reliably and how any transition would be managed.



WHAT WE NEED TO SEE

You have personally delivered complete working Python/database systems and can explain your own code, design decisions and debugging. Experience with PostgreSQL, APIs and reliable background processing matters more than an "AI expert" label. Be ready to explain and test any AI-assisted code you use.



Success means the agreed workflow runs end to end, saves the correct results and recovers safely from failures. A plan, dashboard mockup or isolated passing test is not the finished deliverable.



RATE AND COMMITMENT

- $12-$18 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated relevant experience.

- Part-time: 15 hours per week initially, in agreed working blocks.

- Work will be scoped and estimated in phases. The weekly hours are not a promise that the entire build can be completed within a particular number of weeks.

- Additional hours require agreement in advance.



PLEASE INCLUDE THESE FOUR THINGS

1. One complete system you personally built and delivered: what it did, your exact contribution, the stack, deployment and actual outcome.

2. Existing work you have permission to show: relevant code/commits, tests and a walkthrough or demonstration. Distinguish implemented behavior and observed results from proposed designs; do not disclose client secrets.

3. A specific example of preventing duplicates, recovering from interruption or resolving a production failure, plus your deployment and Windows Python experience.

4. Your requested hourly rate, weekly capacity, available working blocks/time zone and earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates will demonstrate existing work and discuss a failure scenario and delivery approach. No new application needs to be built to apply.



A small paid practical trial may follow the interview. Any trial requires a separately agreed scope, acceptance checks and total budget capped at $150. No trial starts until both sides agree.

About the Role



Gembid is looking for a detail-oriented marketing analytics and advertising specialist to help us properly set up and manage our tracking, analytics, and advertising infrastructure.



The most important part of this role is making sure our Google ecosystem is set up correctly and giving us reliable data we can actually use. We want someone who is comfortable working inside Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, and related tools, and who can help make sure everything is connected, tracked, and organized properly.



Experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising and Meta Commerce or Shop setup is also a strong plus.

Your primary responsibility will be to audit, set up, and maintain our Google analytics and tracking infrastructure. This may include creating or cleaning up GA4 properties, configuring events and conversions, connecting Google Search Console, setting up or reviewing Google Tag Manager, linking Google Ads and Analytics, checking tracking accuracy, troubleshooting data issues, and making sure we can clearly understand where our traffic, leads, and sales are coming from.



You may also help with Google Ads setup and ongoing account organization, including conversion tracking, campaign tracking, reporting, and basic campaign management where needed.



On the Meta side, we would ideally like someone who can help with
 and Instagram properties, Meta Business Manager, ad accounts, pixels/datasets, conversion tracking, catalog or shop setup, and general account organization.



Over time, this person may also help us monitor paid advertising performance, maintain dashboards or reports, troubleshoot tracking issues, and keep all marketing properties organized and working correctly.



What We’re Looking For

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Search Console

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Ads

* Conversion and event tracking

* UTM tracking and attribution

 and Instagram Ads

 or Instagram Shops / Commerce Manager

What Success Looks Like



In the first few weeks, we would want you to help us get our Google and Meta properties organized, make sure our tracking is accurate, connect the necessary accounts, and identify any gaps or problems.



After that, the role would shift more toward ongoing maintenance, reporting, troubleshooting, and helping us improve our paid advertising and analytics as Gembid grows.



We are looking for someone who can say, “I checked it, here’s what was wrong, here’s what I fixed, and here’s what the data is now telling us.”



Schedule and Growth



This role will begin part-time at approximately $500 USD per month.

* Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions on every task.

* Has strong written and spoken English.

* Communicates clearly and consistently.

* Is highly organised and pays attention to detail.

* Can manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

* Enjoys researching opportunities and helping businesses grow.

* Is comfortable communicating professionally with prospective customers.

* Can identify problems and suggest practical solutions.

Skills & Experience

* Familiarity with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and online business tools.

* Good written communication and research skills.

Highly desirable:

* Instagram and

* Social media scheduling and content coordination.

* CRM systems and lead tracking.

You do not need to be an expert in every area. Reliability, initiative, communication and a willingness to learn are essential.



Working Arrangements



* Location: Remote; applicants worldwide are welcome.

* Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week initially, with the potential to increase.

* Rate: AUD $12–$18 per hour, depending on relevant experience and capability.

* Working relationship: Ongoing opportunity for the right candidate.

title: Probate Litigation Paralegal
description:
We only review applications from candidates who meet all of the qualifications listed below.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 with the subject line "Probate Litigation Paralegal Application: [Your Name]" and include:



1. Resume highlighting your legal background and CALIFORNIA probate litigation experience

2. Cover letter describing your probate and probate litigation experience as it relates to this role

3. Expected hourly rate or salary range

4. Available start date



ABOUT BAY LEGAL, PC



Bay Legal, PC is a full-service California law firm combining expert legal counsel with modern technology to deliver seamless, results-driven representation.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Probate Litigation Paralegal / Legal Assistant with direct experience in a California law firm. This role focuses on contested probate, trust, and estate matters, and we are specifically looking for candidates who have supported attorneys through the full life of a probate litigation case, from the initial petition through discovery, hearings, mediation, and settlement or trial. The ideal candidate holds a law degree, is a currently practicing attorney, or brings extensive hands-on paralegal experience in California probate litigation.



PROBATE LITIGATION EXPERIENCE (REQUIRED)



California probate litigation experience is required. Experience with probate matters in other states is a plus and will be considered alongside it. Relevant experience includes:



- Will and trust contests

- Petitions under Probate Code Section 850 (including Heggstad petitions) and petitions for instructions

- Petitions to remove or suspend trustees, executors, or administrators

- Breach of fiduciary duty and trust accounting disputes, including objections to accountings

- Financial elder abuse claims connected to estates or trusts

- Contested conservatorships and guardianships

- Creditor claims, spousal and domestic partner property petitions, and heirship disputes



We also value experience with uncontested probate administration, including petitions for probate, Letters, Notices of Proposed Action, inventories and appraisals with the probate referee, creditor notices, and petitions for final distribution.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Law degree (JD or foreign law degree) OR currently practicing attorney OR minimum 4 years of substantive paralegal experience in a California law firm

- Minimum 4 years of probate or probate litigation experience within a California law firm

- Working knowledge of the California Probate Code, California Rules of Court, and local probate rules

- Experience preparing and filing Judicial Council probate forms and California court e-filing

- Hands-on experience with Lawmatics and Clio Manage

- Paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program preferred

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines at the same time

- Reliable internet connection and home office setup for remote work



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Draft first-pass probate petitions, objections, responses, declarations, and proposed orders from firm templates for attorney review.

- Prepare and file Judicial Council probate forms, notices of hearing, and proofs of service with California superior courts.

- Monitor probate notes and tentative rulings, and help clear defects before hearing dates.

- Track and calendar statutory and court deadlines, including trust contest periods, hearing dates, continuances, and discovery deadlines.

- Prepare discovery requests and responses, deposition notices, and subpoenas for records, and organize documents received.

- Gather and organize evidence such as bank records, estate planning documents, medical records, and asset information for attorneys.

- Prepare and review fiduciary accountings and supporting schedules, and flag discrepancies for attorney review.

- Assist with mediation and settlement preparation, including briefs, exhibits, and settlement agreements.

- Assist with trial preparation, including exhibit lists, witness lists, and trial binders.

- Conduct factual research on estate assets, property records, court dockets, and public records, subject to attorney review.

- Conduct client intake interviews and gather case information under attorney supervision.

- Communicate professionally with clients, beneficiaries, heirs, courts, probate examiners, court investigators, and opposing counsel.

- Manage and update case files, deadlines, and client records in practice management systems (Lawmatics, Clio Manage, etc.).

- Coordinate execution, notarization, and e-signatures on legal documents.

- Draft, review, and proofread legal documents and correspondence, keep accurate records of all case activities, and maintain contemporaneous time records.

We are an established professional photography business specializing in corporate events, conferences, and business photography throughout the Mid-Atlantic region.

We are looking for a motivated, organized, and results-driven B2B Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant to help us expand our corporate client base and consistently identify new business opportunities.

2. Outbound
 & LinkedIn Prospecting

Write and send personalized introductory outreach
s using approved messaging.

Conduct professional LinkedIn prospecting and outreach.

Execute structured follow-up sequences.

Respond to routine inquiries using approved guidelines.

New qualified prospects identified

Initial outreach messages sent

Follow-up messages completed

Positive responses received

Upcoming appointments and warm opportunities

Challenges, insights, and recommendations for improvement

title: Marketing Coordinator and Video Content Specialist (Full-Time, US CPA Firm)
description:

This is not a task-taker role. We're looking for someone who spots opportunities, proposes ideas, and pushes work forward without waiting to be told. You'll recommend content, campaigns, and improvements; the owner reviews and approves them, and then you execute and report on results. You'll also turn new inquiries into booked consultations. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who wants real ownership and takes pride in quality work.



This is an independent contractor position, not employment. You'll be paid as a contractor and will handle your own taxes and government contributions (BIR, SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Plan and recommend

, and social, with topics that matter to high-income individuals and business owners.

- Submit plans and drafts for approval, then move them forward on schedule without needing reminders.



Create and publish

- Write content for our website, blog,
 newsletter, and social media.

- Create lead magnets, such as tax checklists, short guides, and planning worksheets. Write the content and design them in Canva.

- Build and run Mailchimp drip campaigns that nurture new leads and deliver our lead magnets, and track open and click rates.

- Edit short videos (30 to 90 seconds) of our presenter. Add captions, branded graphics, music, and a clean intro and outro.

- Publish videos on YouTube with titles, descriptions, tags, and custom thumbnails.

- Cut and schedule short-form clips for LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.

- Create Canva graphics that follow our brand: charcoal, green, and white.

- Manage our Google Business Profile with weekly posts and photo updates, and draft review responses for approval.



Manage leads and appointments

- Respond to new leads (website inquiries, Google Business messages, social messages, and
) within 1 business hour. Answer basic questions and book a consultation with the owner. Pass any tax or accounting questions to the owner. You won't give tax advice.

- Screen out spam and vendor pitches from real prospects.

- Book consultations directly on the owner's calendar through our booking page. Send confirmations and day-before reminders, and handle reschedules and cancellations.

- Follow up with leads who haven't booked yet, contact no-shows to rebook, and keep every lead's status up to date in our CRM.

- Keep our referral partner list up to date, send outreach
s, and schedule first meetings with referral introductions.

 performance, reviews, new leads, and consultations booked), what's next, and anything you need approved.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 2 years of marketing or content experience for US clients, including work you planned and led yourself, not only tasks you were assigned

s, or social copy). Writing samples are required.

NICE TO HAVE

 marketing platform, including automated drip campaigns

- Previous work for accounting, legal, financial, or other professional-services firms

- Experience with Google Business Profile management

WHAT WE OFFER

title: Client Success & Onboarding Manager
description:
AYARX | Telehealth Provider Network

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

Industry: Telehealth / Healthcare Services / SaaS



About the Role



AYARX is seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and patient Client Success & Onboarding Manager to serve as the primary point of contact for new clients once a sale is closed.

We work with telehealth companies at various stages of growth, from established healthcare brands to early-stage startups launching their first services. Some clients have fully developed systems and workflows, while others need significant guidance in understanding how to launch and operate a telehealth business.

This role requires someone who can confidently take ownership of the client relationship, guide clients through onboarding, coordinate with internal and external teams, and help turn ideas into functional workflows.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who has the patience to guide inexperienced clients, the stamina to navigate startup environments, and the ability to build strong, mutually beneficial relationships.



Key Responsibilities

1. Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients following contract execution.

Welcome new clients, conduct kickoff meetings, and establish clear expectations, timelines, responsibilities, and next steps.

Guide clients through onboarding, whether integrating with a third-party telehealth platform or using their own internal systems.

Maintain regular communication, provide progress updates, and proactively address questions or roadblocks.

Build long-term relationships that promote client satisfaction, retention, and growth.

2. Workflow Development & Implementation

Work with clients to understand their business model, patient journey, treatment offerings, and operational needs.

Help develop and document workflows covering patient intake, provider consultations, prescribing, follow-ups, escalations, and communication.

Coordinate with clinical, operations, technology, and platform teams to ensure workflows are practical and properly implemented.

Identify operational gaps and help clients develop solutions before launch.

Coordinate testing, training, and launch readiness.

3. Client Education & Guidance

Provide hands-on guidance to clients who are new to telehealth or unfamiliar with healthcare operations.

Explain provider network capabilities, general licensing considerations, telehealth workflows, and operational requirements.

Help clients understand the differences between clinical responsibilities, platform responsibilities, and administrative support.

Set realistic expectations while maintaining a supportive, solutions-oriented approach.

Know when to escalate clinical, regulatory, or legal questions to the appropriate professionals rather than independently interpreting requirements.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

Act as the liaison between clients, AYARX's clinical and operations teams, and external SaaS/platform partners.

Track onboarding milestones, outstanding requirements, deliverables, and launch dates.

Coordinate provider availability, state coverage requirements, platform access, and workflow approvals with the appropriate internal teams.

Ensure smooth handoffs and clear accountability across all parties.

Continue managing client relationships after launch, including troubleshooting, service improvements, and identifying expansion opportunities.



Required Qualifications



Experience in client success, account management, implementation, or onboarding within telehealth, healthcare services, or healthcare SaaS.

Working knowledge of HIPAA, patient privacy, and healthcare data-handling practices.

Familiarity with EMRs/EHRs, telehealth platforms, patient intake systems, and related SaaS tools.

Basic understanding of U.S. provider licensing, state-specific telehealth considerations, and clinical versus non-clinical responsibilities.

Experience developing, documenting, or improving operational workflows and SOPs.

Strong project management, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities independently.

Comfortable leading meetings, educating clients, and communicating with founders, executives, clinicians, and technical teams.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with telehealth startups, digital health companies, or white-label healthcare services.

Familiarity with GLP-1 weight management, hormone therapy, wellness, or other cash-pay telehealth programs.

Experience coordinating integrations or implementations involving multiple vendors and software platforms.

Background in healthcare operations, provider networks, or clinical support services.



The Personality We're Looking For



Technical knowledge is important, but the right temperament is essential.

Our ideal candidate is:

Exceptionally patient: Comfortable answering the same questions repeatedly and guiding clients who may have little understanding of telehealth operations.

Proactive and resourceful: Doesn't wait for clients to figure out what they need. Anticipates problems, identifies gaps, and proposes next steps.

Resilient and adaptable: Thrives in fast-moving startup environments where priorities shift, timelines change, and processes are still being developed.

A natural relationship builder: Knows how to make clients feel supported while maintaining professional boundaries and accountability.

Confident but diplomatic: Can manage demanding personalities, push back when necessary, and communicate limitations without damaging relationships.

Detail-oriented and accountable: Follows through, documents decisions, and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

A problem solver, not just a messenger: Takes ownership of issues and works toward resolution rather than simply forwarding
s between teams.



What Success Looks Like



New clients experience a structured, organized, and welcoming onboarding process.

Clients clearly understand what AYARX provides, what their platform provides, and what remains their responsibility.

Onboarding milestones and launch timelines are actively managed.

Workflows are documented, tested, and operationally ready before launch.

Clients feel supported without becoming unnecessarily dependent on the team for routine decisions.

Internal teams receive clear, complete requirements with minimal confusion or repeated follow-ups.

Client relationships remain productive, professional, and mutually beneficial beyond the initial launch.



Why Join AYARX?
