title: Bookkeeper/ Financial Advisor
description:
I’m seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Financial Advisor / Bookkeeper to support both my business and personal finances. This role is for someone who doesn’t just track numbers—but helps me understand them, plan with them, and make better decisions because of them.



I need someone who is confident in their work, good at what they do, and able to explain finances clearly, calmly, and without jargon.



This is a collaborative role with frequent meetings (weekly or bi-weekly). I’m looking for someone who takes initiative, flags issues before they become problems, and actively brings insights to the table.





I’m a business owner and I need a financial advisor who will help me answer questions like:



How much should I be saving monthly to reach my goals?



How much should I be paying down on my credit cards?



What should my monthly credit card budget be?



Am I overspending in certain categories?



Can I afford travel right now?



How much can I reasonably spend on eating out or coffee?



How many hours should my employees be working?



Does it make financial sense to hire someone new?



Can my budgeting system be improved?



I also already have my own organizing system and want someone who can help refine and improve it, not replace it blindly.



Key Responsibilities



Oversee all financial aspects of my business



Payroll management



Maintain clean, accurate books in QuickBooks



Separate and monitor business vs. personal finances



Monitor business and personal bank accounts



Cash flow tracking and forecasting



Credit card tracking, budgeting, and payoff strategy



Expense review and cost control (flag unnecessary spending)



Employee cost analysis (hours, staffing, hiring decisions)



Monthly and quarterly financial summaries



Translate financial data into clear, actionable insights



Proactively flag anything that looks off or risky



Participate in weekly or bi-weekly financial check-ins



Help me plan toward financial goals with clarity and confidence



What I’m Looking For



Experience supporting small businesses



Strong knowledge of QuickBooks and Excel



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable



Self-directed and proactive (you don’t wait to be asked)



Comfortable discussing both business and personal finances



Clear communicator who can explain numbers simply



Someone who enjoys helping a business owner grow strategically



Pay



Negotiable, based on experience and scope



To Apply


 your resume to

The city you're currently living in

title: GoHighLevel Specialist – Websites, Workflows & Automations (Part-Time)
description:
I'm looking for an experienced, highly reliable GoHighLevel Specialist to help build, customize, deploy, and maintain websites, landing pages, snapshots, workflows, and automation systems for our digital marketing agency.



This is a part-time, flexible, as-needed position working directly with me, the owner of Local Wave, a US-based digital marketing agency who works primarily with home service companies (tree services, plumbing companies, etc)



Hours are not guaranteed. Some weeks may involve just 2–5 hours of work, while busier weeks could require 20–25+ hours. Workload fluctuates based on client projects and agency needs.



This is to replace our most recent rockstar GHL & Marketing Specialist who was with us for 3 years



I'm looking for someone who can independently handle technical projects, follow established processes, maintain existing systems, and keep things running smoothly without constant supervision.



This is NOT an entry-level position. You must already have hands-on GoHighLevel experience.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



1. GHL WEBSITES & LANDING PAGES



Building and customizing websites and landing pages for agency clients.



Many projects will use existing templates or snapshots that need to be customized for each business.



Responsibilities include:



- Build professional, modern, mobile-responsive websites and landing pages inside GHL.

- Deploy and customize existing website templates and snapshots for new clients.

- Update branding, colors, logos, images, content, and business information.

- Customize website layouts and designs beyond standard templates when needed.

- Use GHL's AI website-building tools and AI-assisted coding to build or modify websites.

- Make adjustments using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or AI-assisted coding when necessary.

- Connect websites with forms, calendars, CRM pipelines, and automations.

- Troubleshoot website design, mobile responsiveness, and functionality issues.

- Test websites thoroughly before launch.



You should be comfortable both building new websites and efficiently customizing existing ones.





2. GHL SNAPSHOTS, WORKFLOWS & AUTOMATIONS



You'll help deploy, customize, maintain, and troubleshoot GHL backend systems.



Much of this work will involve implementing existing systems across multiple client accounts rather than building entirely new automations every time.



Responsibilities include:



- Deploy and configure GHL snapshots for new clients.

- Update custom values, business information, calendars, forms, pipelines, and workflow settings.

- Customize existing workflows and automations for individual client needs.

- Build new workflows and backend systems when necessary.

- Configure triggers, conditional logic, tags, opportunities, SMS/email sequences, and notifications.

- Set up appointment reminders, lead follow-ups, and other automated processes.

- Troubleshoot broken workflows and automation errors.

- Test systems to ensure everything functions correctly before deployment.

- Document changes and maintain organized client accounts.



You must understand how GHL's native workflow builder works. Simply knowing how to import a snapshot is not enough.





3. GENERAL MARKETING AGENCY SUPPORT



You'll regularly assist with other agency-related tasks depending on current needs.



These may include:



- Creating basic graphics, images, and marketing creatives.

- Updating website content and landing pages.

- Basic Google Business Profile management.

- Basic Meta Ads and Google Ads support.

- Using ChatGPT, Canva, Higgsfield, and other AI tools.

- Organizing client information and project documentation.

- Updating tasks and project statuses in ClickUp.

- Other technical or administrative tasks as needed.



You don't need to know everything in this section. 



Training for secondary responsibilities can be provided through written SOPs and Loom videos.









WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- Strong, hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Experience building and customizing GHL websites and landing pages.

- Experience with GHL snapshots, custom values, and client account configuration.

- Solid understanding of GHL's native workflow builder, including triggers, conditional logic, forms, calendars, pipelines, and SMS/email automations.

- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently.

- Comfortable using AI tools and learning new technologies.

- Ability to follow SOPs and implement repeatable processes accurately.

- Strong attention to detail and quality assurance.

- Familiarity with project management tools such as ClickUp.

- Comfortable communicating through Slack and Loom.



Experience with Zapier, Make, or n8n is helpful, but does not replace hands-on GHL experience.





PERSONAL QUALITIES (EXTREMELY IMPORTANT)



RELIABLE: You consistently follow through on commitments and meet deadlines.



ACCOUNTABLE: You take ownership of your work and responsibilities.



INDEPENDENT: You can complete assignments without constant supervision.



ORGANIZED: You keep tasks, projects, and documentation updated.



PROACTIVE: You communicate progress, identify issues, and suggest solutions.



RESOURCEFUL: You know how to research and troubleshoot problems independently.



DETAIL-ORIENTED: You carefully check your work and catch mistakes before they become problems.



CONSISTENT: You maintain the same level of quality even when tasks are repetitive.



I'm looking for someone I can assign a project to, trust to handle it properly, and know that they'll communicate if something needs my attention.





BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Meta Ads Manager experience.

- Google Ads experience.

- Google Business Profile management.

- Graphic design and ad creative production.

- Canva, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, or other AI creative tools.

- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and custom coding.

- API integrations, webhooks, Zapier, or Make.

- Experience working with US-based marketing agencies.

- Strong written English and client communication skills.





WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- Part-time, flexible, as-needed position.

- Some weeks may involve only 2–5 hours of work.

- Busier weeks may require 20–25+ hours.

- No guaranteed minimum weekly hours.

- You are welcome to work with other clients or businesses.

- Hourly compensation based on experience and skill level.

- Hours tracked using Clockify.

- No screen recording or invasive monitoring.

- Communication primarily through Slack and ClickUp.

- Expected response time within 1 business day, even during slower periods.

- Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities as the agency grows.



You'll generally have flexibility in when you complete assigned work, provided deadlines are met and communication remains consistent.





ABOUT WORKING WITH ME



You'll be working directly with me, the owner of Local Wave.



I run a lean, hands-on digital marketing agency and value efficiency, clear communication, and people who take ownership of their responsibilities.



I don't micromanage, and I don't expect you to know absolutely everything.



However, I do expect you to have the experience and resourcefulness to figure things out independently.



When training is necessary, I'll typically provide written SOPs or Loom videos rather than extensive live training sessions.



Some projects will involve building new systems from scratch. Others will involve customizing existing websites, deploying snapshots, updating client information, testing automations, or maintaining systems we've already built.



I'm looking for someone who is equally comfortable with both.



My goal is to find a dependable, technically capable person I can build a long-term working relationship with as the agency grows & changes.





HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



1. GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERIENCE



How many years have you worked with GoHighLevel? What types of websites, workflows, snapshots, and backend systems have you worked on?



2. WEBSITE EXAMPLES



Share 2–3 examples of websites or landing pages you've personally built or customized in GHL.



Please explain what you personally worked on.



3. SNAPSHOTS & CLIENT SETUP



Have you deployed GHL snapshots or customized similar websites and automation systems across multiple client accounts?



Describe your experience updating branding, custom values, forms, calendars, pipelines, and workflows.



4. WORKFLOWS & AUTOMATIONS



Describe an actual GHL workflow or automation system you've built, customized, or troubleshot.



What did it do, and what was your role?



5. QUALITY ASSURANCE & TROUBLESHOOTING



When launching a new client website and automation system, how do you make sure everything is configured correctly and working properly?



6. AI TOOLS & WEBSITE CUSTOMIZATION



Have you used GHL's AI website builder, custom HTML/CSS, JavaScript, or AI-assisted coding tools? Describe your experience.



7. ADDITIONAL SKILLS



Do you have experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, graphic design, or AI creative tools? Which ones?



8. INDEPENDENCE & COMMUNICATION



Are you comfortable working independently, following SOPs, keeping tasks updated, and occasionally communicating with US-based clients?



9. FLEXIBLE WORKLOAD



Are you comfortable with an as-needed position where some weeks may have only 2–5 hours of work and other weeks may have 20–25+ hours?



10. HOURLY RATE



What is your expected hourly rate or hourly rate range in USD?



Please include examples of your actual work, not just a list of tools you're familiar with.



I'm looking for someone experienced, reliable, organized, detail-oriented, and interested in building a long-term working relationship.



If that sounds like you, I look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Executive Assistant | US Construction + Real Estate
description:
We're hiring a remote Executive Assistant to support two U.S. businesses: a small construction business and a real estate team. You'll report to a different manager in each business and keep both teams organized, on schedule, and moving.



This is a hands-on role, not just inbox management. You'll build construction estimates, prepare home valuation reports, track jobs, listings, and deadlines, and help plan social media content for our construction jobs.



QUICK DETAILS

- Schedule: 7 AM to 3 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday (7 PM to 3 AM Manila time, 8 PM to 4 AM after U.S. clocks change in November)

- Pay: $6.00 USD per hour, logged in a time tracker, paid biweekly via Wise or PayPal

- Rate reviewed after 90 days based on accuracy, reliability, and follow-through

- Independent contractor

- Split: about 50% construction, 50% real estate



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Across both businesses

- Manage calendars, appointments, and reminders for both managers

- Triage
 and messages, draft replies, and flag what needs attention

- Keep a weekly priority list per business and run a short Monday check-in with each manager

- Take notes on calls and turn them into action items with owners and due dates

- Handle research, vendor quotes, and one-off tasks



Lead tracking (you will NOT contact leads)

- Log new leads from calls, web forms, referrals, and social media into the CRM within 1 business day

- Set follow-up dates and remind the right person before each one is due

- Send a daily "follow up today" list and a weekly list of leads with no contact in 7+ days

- Track open bids and flag any with no response

- Flag opportunities: expired listings, past client home anniversaries, repeat construction customers



Construction business

- Build job estimates from site notes, photos, measurements, and scope details

- Pull material pricing from suppliers and keep a current cost list

- Prepare proposals, change orders, and scope-of-work documents

- The owner must sign off on every estimate and change order before it goes to a client. Nothing goes out without that approval.

- Track active jobs: schedule, milestones, permits, inspections, and punch lists

- Keep the job profitability workbook updated

- Coordinate with subcontractors and crew leads on schedules and paperwork (COIs, W-9s, lien waivers)

- Help plan social media content for each job: suggest what to post at each stage (before, progress, finished), request photos and videos from the crew, and keep a simple content list for the team

- Follow up on invoices, deposits, and outstanding balances



Real estate team

- Prepare Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) and valuation reports from MLS data for agent review

- Pull comps, adjust for size, condition, and features, and summarize a suggested price range

- Assemble listing presentation packets and seller net sheets

- Track listings and pending deals against key dates (inspection, appraisal, financing, closing)

- Gather photos, property details, and copy for listing marketing

- Keep the CRM tidy: leads entered, follow-up tasks set, notes logged



Systems

- Own one task tracker with a board for each business

- Organize shared drive files and templates with clear naming

- Write simple step-by-step guides (SOPs) for repeat tasks

- Send each manager an end-of-week recap: done, in progress, blocked, next up



MUST HAVE

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Experience as an executive or virtual assistant supporting a business owner (6+ months preferred, ideally U.S. based)

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills (formulas, lookups, clean templates)

- Comfort with numbers: you can build an estimate or price range and explain how you got there

- A habit of closing loops without reminders

- Your own computer, headset, reliable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Construction estimating or project coordination experience

- Real estate admin or transaction coordinator experience, including MLS comps

- Experience with Google Workspace, a CRM, and a task manager

- Social media content planning experience

- Experience writing SOPs



IMPORTANT: To show us you read this entire post, type "Measure twice" as the very first line of your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



GETTING STARTED

1. Learn both businesses, meet each manager, take over calendars and inbox triage, and set up the task tracker.

2. Build estimates and CMAs with manager review, and start weekly recaps.

3. Deliver estimate drafts (ready for owner sign-off) and CMA drafts on your own, and write SOPs for top recurring tasks.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume and a short note that includes:

- "Measure twice" as the first line

- One system you set up that kept a busy person organized

- Your experience with construction estimating, real estate admin, or both

- Confirmation that you can work 7 AM to 3 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday



Finalists complete a 15-minute English video interview, a DISC personality assessment, and a short paid test task: a simple job estimate from sample notes and a 3-comp price range for a sample home.

title: Experienced Video Editor & Social Media Manager Needed
description:

Location: Remote

There is significant potential for this role to grow into a full-time opportunity.



We want someone who can do it all! More importantly, we want someone who does it WELL. We value creativity, professionalism, initiative, efficiency, and an exceptional eye for aesthetics and storytelling. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work and can bring fresh ideas to the table rather than simply follow instructions.



We believe in recognizing and rewarding excellent work. We're not looking for the cheapest editor or someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We're looking for a talented, dependable creative professional who takes pride in their craft and wants to build a lasting working relationship. We're happy to invest in the right person, and as our businesses grow, we want their opportunities to grow with us.



🎥 Podcast Video Editing — Our Primary Priority

- Experienced with long-form podcast editing, particularly for YouTube

- Skilled in creating engaging short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts

- Able to identify compelling moments from long-form recordings and repurpose them into engaging social media content

- Experienced in creating faceless videos and other creative visual content

- Strong sense of pacing, timing, storytelling, and audience engagement

- Skilled at creating tasteful, polished intros, outros, transitions, and visual effects

- Comfortable cleaning up audio, removing mistakes or unnecessary pauses, and creating a seamless audience experience

- Able to accommodate different editing styles and maintain a consistent aesthetic across multiple brands

- Familiar with Riverside

- Strong creative judgment and the ability to make thoughtful editing decisions independently



💻 Social Media Management & Strategy

- Experienced with creating, organizing, scheduling, and publishing social media content across multiple platforms

- Able to design engaging graphics, carousels, and other still visuals

- Skilled at writing compelling captions and optimizing posts for individual platforms

- Knowledgeable about current social media trends, algorithms, and effective content strategies

- Able to maintain content calendars and manage multiple social media accounts

- Comfortable reviewing content performance and using analytics to recommend improvements

- Proactive in suggesting ideas and opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and audience growth

We don't just want someone who can post content. We want someone who understands what makes content effective and can help us make it better.



💼 Personal & Professional Qualities

- Reliable, fast internet connection

- Hardworking, efficient, organized, and dependable

- Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality

- Strong time management skills and ability to meet strict deadlines

- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work

- Strong creative instincts and a clean, modern, professional aesthetic

- Able to work independently without constant supervision

- Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable offering creative recommendations

- Able to communicate fluently in written and spoken English

description:
($$$) AI Video Producer - UGC / VSL / Cinematic / Pixar-Style / Talking Head | US E-commerce Brand



We are a fast-growing US e-commerce brand looking for a talented and resourceful AI Video Producer.



Part-time to start (~20 hours/week), with a fast and clearly defined path to full-time.



We give you the script and everything you need. What we are looking for is someone who executes it precisely and figures out the production side on his own, without being walked through every step.



Applications are only processed through our form: 



YOUR ROLE

You will receive a detailed script and all necessary information (brand guidelines, references, tone of voice). Your job is to produce the video exactly as scripted, handle the full editing and post-production, and deliver a complete, ready-to-publish file. No improvisation on the script, full execution.



You own everything else: AI generation, shot choices, editing, sound design, captions, transitions, final export.



WHAT WE MEAN BY RESOURCEFUL

You respect the script exactly, and you figure out on your own how to bring it to life on screen

You know which AI tool to use for each shot, and you keep iterating until the result is right

You solve technical problems yourself instead of sending back a list of questions

You never deliver work that is "almost done". If a generation looks bad, you redo it before we see it

You ask questions only when something is genuinely unclear, not to be told what to do at every step

You apply feedback to the next batch without being reminded twice

TYPES OF VIDEOS YOU WILL PRODUCE

Ultra-realistic UGC-style videos (authentic, raw, iPhone-feel)

VSLs (long-form video sales letters, structured and retention-driven)

Cinematic AI videos (dramatic, high-production look)

Pixar / 3D animated style videos

Faceless cinematic storytelling videos

AI talking head / spokesperson videos

Product showcase videos with AI visuals

Motivational / faith-based narrative videos

Any other AI video format as requested per script

AI TOOLS

You are free to use any AI tools you want. But you must genuinely master the current stack and know which tool to use for each shot: video generation, image generation, voice cloning and TTS, lipsync, upscaling, editing.



This space changes every month. If you are not already testing new tools on your own, this role is not for you.



What matters is the final result, not the tools used.



REQUIREMENTS

Strong command of English, written and spoken. Our market is 100% US

Ability to follow a detailed script precisely and deliver on-brand results

Strong instinct for hooks, pacing and retention. You understand what stops the scroll and what keeps people watching

Reliable, responsive, deadline-driven

Videos delivered in 9:16 vertical (format may vary for VSLs)

Being able to mix AI shots with real b-roll you source yourself is a plus

Speaking or understanding French is a plus

PORTFOLIO - MANDATORY

You must include a portfolio link with your application. Your portfolio must contain AI-generated video examples. This is the very first thing we check. Applications without a portfolio will be automatically ignored, and applications with a portfolio that does not contain AI-generated videos will also be ignored. No exceptions.



VOLUME, PAY AND GROWTH PATH

You are paid per finished video, not per hour. Every video you deliver is paid, every week. The more you produce and the better they perform, the more you earn.



PART-TIME (starting point)



10 to 15 videos per week, delivered progressively throughout the week

FULL-TIME (fast track) If you are ambitious, curious, resourceful, and your videos perform, you move to full-time. Double the volume, double the pay.



20 to 30 videos per week

This is not a vague promise. It is based on measurable results: quality, consistency, autonomy, and ad performance. The faster you prove it, the faster it happens.



The application form asks for your rate per finished video. Give us your number there.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

A full, detailed script for every video

All brand assets, references and guidelines

Winning references to work from

Clear feedback on every delivery

SELECTION PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid test project before final selection. Multiple candidates will be evaluated simultaneously. The best work wins.



HOW TO APPLY

We only process applications sent through this form. It takes about 12 minutes.







Messages sent outside the form are not reviewed, whatever they contain. If you do not fill the form, we never see your application. No cover letter, no CV needed.



The code word is MOTION. The form asks for it, so we know you read the entire post.



Have these ready before you start, the form asks for them:



Your portfolio link, with AI-generated videos

Your single best AI video, and why you think it works

A 60 to 90 second video of yourself, in English, walking us through how you produced one of your videos: your steps, and why you chose those shots and not others

Your price per finished video, in USD

We do not read messages sent without the form. No cover letter, no CV needed.

**Creditor Communication & Documentation**



- Send approved letters of representation and authorization documents to creditors.

s, notices, and account correspondence.

, Calendar & Administrative Management**

s by client, creditor, and urgency.

s.

**Internal Operations & Process Improvement**



- Maintain Google Drive folders and document organization systems.

- Update internal spreadsheets, trackers, and reporting dashboards.

- Create and maintain standard operating procedures.

- Identify repetitive administrative tasks that can be standardized or automated.

- Assist with quality-control reviews of case files.

- Support onboarding and offboarding administrative procedures.

- Coordinate assignments between case managers, attorneys, and operations.

- Maintain confidentiality and follow all company data security requirements.

- Assist with other administrative and operational projects as assigned.



### Required Qualifications



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses, law firms, or professional service companies.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, PDFs, and document management.

 writing and proofreading skills.

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus



































































Key Interview Questions – Finance Assistant / Bookholder

???? Experience & Background

Can you describe the most complex reconciliation you’ve handled? What errors did you find, and how did you resolve them?





Have you ever managed accounts for multiple properties or clients at the same time? How did you stay organized?





What financial systems and tools have you used (QuickBooks, Excel, property management software)? Which one challenged you the most and why?







???? Property Financial Oversight

If you discover that a property’s ledger shows a surplus but the landlord insists there is a deficit, how would you verify the accuracy and explain your findings?





How would you handle a situation where rental income has been misallocated between two properties?





Tell me about a time when you found inconsistencies in property-related financial data. What steps did you take?







???? Tenant Accounts & Rent Management

A tenant claims they already paid rent, but there’s no record in the system. How do you investigate and resolve this?





How do you track and follow up on delinquent accounts without damaging the tenant relationship?





What process do you follow to ensure tenant payment entries are accurate and timely?







???? Vendor & Expense Management

If two invoices come in for the same service but with different amounts, how would you determine which one to process?





What steps do you take to ensure recurring expenses don’t exceed the approved budget?





Have you ever caught an error or overcharge from a vendor? How did you handle it?







???? Reporting & Cash Flow Management

How do you make sure your monthly reports are both accurate and ready on time, especially when you are managing multiple deadlines?





If you identify a cash flow shortfall for a property, what immediate actions would you take before escalating it to the Finance Manager?





What steps do you take to ensure accuracy in budget vs. actual reporting?







???? Compliance & Documentation

How do you make sure financial activities comply with lease agreements and company policies?





If an auditor asks for supporting documentation and you discover missing records, what would be your approach?





Tell me about a time you had to handle sensitive or confidential financial information. How did you protect it?







???? Coordination & Escalation

A property manager pushes you to approve an expense that doesn’t follow policy. What would you do?





How do you balance communication between landlords, tenants, and internal teams when dealing with financial disputes?





Tell me about a time you escalated a financial issue to leadership. What was the outcome?







???? Tools & Technical Skills

Walk me through how you would set up a spreadsheet in Excel to track rent payments for 50+ tenants.





How do you avoid errors when multiple tea
mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?





Have you ever suggested or implemented a change to improve financial workflows? What was the impact?







???? Problem-Solving & Judgment

Imagine you discover that monthly reconciliations were skipped for two months. How would you catch up and ensure no errors were missed?





You’re under pressure to close books, but you notice a suspicious transaction. Do you escalate immediately or finish closing first? Why?





What’s the biggest financial mistake you’ve ever made, and how did you correct it?







???? Commitment & Fit

This role requires handling multiple properties/accounts at once. How do you manage time and prioritize when everything feels urgent?





How do you stay calm and accurate when deadlines overlap and you’re under pressure?





What motivates you more: accuracy, deadlines, or recognition? Why?

I need someone who is organized, proactive, warm in communication, and genuinely hungry to be the best executive assistant they can possibly be. Not someone looking for a comfortable job. Someone looking to be great at this.

This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines working Arizona hours (starting 5:00 AM AZ time). Expect roughly 50 hours per week. This is not a job for the weak. It IS a job for someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility, grow alongside a scaling company, and become indispensable to an executive long-term.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Act as my right-hand partner in daily execution and organization

Manage calendar, scheduling, reminders, and priorities

Organize communication, follow-ups, and task tracking

Support operations, growth projects, and leadership workflows

Build clean systems in Google Sheets and other tools

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) daily to draft, research, organize, and move faster

This role requires serious initiative. You don't wait to be told every step. You think ahead, bring solutions, and stay steady even when things move fast. A lot will be expected of you, and the right person will love that.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Project management or workflow systems

WHO THRIVES HERE



Someone who genuinely wants to be the best EA in the room, not just employed as one

Organized but adaptable

Positive, warm, and confident communicator

Calm under pressure with extremely high standards

Independent thinker who enjoys close collaboration

Someone excited to be fully invested and grow long-term in a right-hand role



If you read the hours and expectations above and felt excited instead of nervous, you're probably who I'm looking for.

Send your resume to

title: PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
We are looking for a PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist to own our preventive maintenance pipeline and keep our technicians’ calendars full. This is a production scheduling role with real sales responsibility: you will prospect new PM customers, send and follow up on PM proposals until they sign, schedule all PM and warranty work, and keep existing PM accounts happy.



You will work closely with our Customer Service Admin, who handles the main phone line, collections, repair invoices, and simple bookings when parts are already onsite. You take everything they hand off — PM leads, warranty jobs, and repairs that need parts ordered — and you own the calendar from there.



This is not a generic receptionist job. Success here means a full tech calendar (~1 week booked ahead), PM contracts signed, and PM customers retained.



What you will do every day

PM sales & retention



Identify and pursue new PM prospects: gyms, hotels, HOAs, property managers, and commercial facilities

Work warm leads handed off from Customer Service (PM LEAD packets)

Send PM contract proposals via email and follow up persistently until the customer signs or clearly declines (target: touch every open quote at least every 5 business days)

Proactive outreach to existing PM accounts — resolve issues before contracts churn

Scheduling & calendar management



Schedule all preventive maintenance visits for signed PM contracts (commercial + residential)

Keep technicians booked ~1 week ahead — never let the calendar drop below ~3 business days of work unless intentionally left open

Schedule warranty jobs within each manufacturer’s expected timeline

Schedule parts repair jobs when parts are ordered, in transit, or marked ready in Trello (Parts Admin workflow)

Process HANDOFF packets from Customer Service — book in ServiceMinder same day (urgent) or within 24 hours (routine)

Daily workflow



Review open PM proposals due for follow-up today

Check ServiceMinder calendar density per technician

Monitor Trello Parts Admin for Phase 5 overdue cards and parts-ready jobs

Work PM compliance list for overdue commercial PM visits

Process warranty queue

Return PM retention calls/messages from the prior day

What this role is NOT

Not the primary answer on the main customer service phone line (Customer Service Admin owns that)

Not responsible for unpaid invoice follow-up or sending repair invoices

Not responsible for repair/diagnostic proposals (those are Customer Service)

Not booking simple diagnostic/repair visits when parts are already at the customer’s site (Customer Service books those)

Clear handoffs between the two roles are documented — you will know exactly what is yours vs. what gets handed off.



Tools you will use

ServiceMinder (primary — scheduling, PM proposals, customer records)

Google Sheets (PM schedule planning calendar)

Trello (Parts Admin cards, commercial PM funnel)

Gmail (PM proposals and scheduling confirmations)

RingCentral (PM prospect and retention calls — backup on main line when needed)

WhatsApp (scheduler/tech coordination)

Warranty manufacturer portals (training provided)

Ideal candidate

title: General Program Manager
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:


/ansiblehealth/4b610b44-ac59-43da-a514-ca69e2cce9c3



We are seeking a dynamic and talented General Program Manager to join our team. This role is perfect for a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare.



What is Ansible Health?

Ansible Health unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We're seeking a super smart, hungry, and resilient individual who is passionate about technology and healthcare to join us as a Program Manager. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and brings a strong organizational mindset to complex projects. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple complex programs across various departments to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. This role requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently and adapt to the dynamic nature of a growing startup in the healthcare technology space.



Responsibilities

- Impact the strategy and execution for AnsibleHealth's general operations, clinical operations, and technology initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams.

- Work independently on projects through the full life cycle, overseeing clinical, operational, and technology aspects.

- Develop and manage program plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful delivery.

- Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

- Establish program governance structures and processes, including risk management, issue management, and change management.

- Monitor and report on program progress, status, and performance to stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Ensure effective communication and alignment with stakeholders at all levels.

- Continuously identify and mitigate program risks and issues.

- Facilitate program-related meetings and workshops.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to drive program success and identify growth opportunities.

- Bring a continuous improvement mindset to our operations to ensure we're ready to scale.

- Anticipate issues, propose solutions, manage dependencies, and identify areas for tool/process improvement.

- Collaborate with and steer internal teams, including Marketing, Engineering, Program Management, and Clinical Operations.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.



Education

Bachelor's degree from one of the top five universities in the Philippines.



Required Qualifications and competencies

- Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; 0-5 years of relevant work experience is an advantage but not required.

- Demonstrated passion for technology and ability to quickly adapt to new digital tools and platforms.

- Exceptional organizational skills.

- Resilient mindset with the ability to bounce back from challenges and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Keen interest in healthcare and improving patient outcomes; prior healthcare experience is a plus but not mandatory.

- High intellectual curiosity and a hunger for personal and professional development.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace and willingness to learn new software tools as needed.

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a startup environment.

- Eagerness to take on leadership roles and initiative to drive projects forward.

- Ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement.



The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, adapt quickly to new challenges, and contribute to our innovative and fast-paced work environment.



Job Details

Full-time: Full-time: 40 hours a week

Benefits: Flexible PTO and HMO coverage

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work US hours - EST/EDT)

About us and the role



Tarantino Law is a small, growing law firm in North Carolina, USA. We help families and business owners with estate planning, business law and probate administration. Our clients find us through seminars, referrals, networking and our website, and every new inquiry deserves a fast, warm, professional response.



We are looking for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to own our intake and lead follow-up process and help us build smarter systems. You will support our attorney and paralegal day-to-day, and you will help us use automation and AI tools to save time across the firm. This role starts part-time, with the potential to become full-time as our firm grows. It is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with a small team.



What you will do

Client intake and data entry

• Enter new leads and intake information accurately into our practice management software (MyCase)

• Create and update contact records, intake forms, matters, tasks and notes

• Check new records for missing or duplicate information and keep the data clean

• Organize and file documents in the right client folders



Lead follow-up

• Follow up promptly and consistently with every lead, including seminar attendees, referrals, networking contacts and website inquiries, by
, text and phone using our templates and schedule

• Track every lead's status so no inquiry falls through the cracks

• Manage seminar leads from start to finish: enter sign-in sheets and registrations accurately, send thank-you and follow-up messages within 24 hours, and book consultations with interested attendees

• Record each lead's source (seminar, referral, networking group, website) and follow-up history in detail

• Schedule consultations on the attorney's calendar and send confirmations and reminders

• Re-engage leads who went quiet, and request reviews from satisfied clients

• Give the attorney and paralegal a short weekly report on lead status and conversions



Attorney and paralegal support

• Help the attorney and paralegal follow up on open leads and pending client items

• Manage task lists, deadlines and reminders inside our software

• Draft routine
s, letters and client communications for review

• Prepare client folders and gather documents before consultations and signings



Automation, processes and AI

• Build and improve automations for intake, follow-up sequences, reminders and reporting

• Use AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to draft, summarize and speed up routine work

• Connect our tools with platforms like Zapier or Make where it saves time

• Write clear step-by-step SOPs (standard operating procedures) for every process you build or touch

• Suggest ways to save time and remove manual work across the firm



Other support (as needed)

• Schedule social media posts and help with simple marketing tasks (Canva, Buffer)

• Help with networking follow-ups, thank-you notes and referral tracking

• Light inbox and calendar management



Tools you will use

Experience with these is a plus. We will train you on the ones you don't know.

Area

Tools

Practice management and CRM

MyCase

, calendar and files

Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

AI

Claude, ChatGPT or similar

Automation

Zapier, Make or similar

Social media and design

Buffer, Canva

Time tracking

Jibble (screen-capture time tracker)

Communication

, Zoom, Google Meet, text messaging



What we are looking for

Must have

• Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, professional tone for US clients

• At least 2 years of experience as a virtual assistant, admin or customer support for US clients

• Hands-on experience with a CRM or practice management system and accurate data entry

• Comfort using AI tools and learning new software quickly

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions exactly

• A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet and a backup power or internet plan

• A quiet workspace for calls and the ability to keep client information strictly confidential



We read every application carefully. To show us you have read this whole post, begin your application with the phrase "Organized and Ready" and tell us in one sentence which automation you are most proud of building.



Nice to have

• Experience in a law firm, legal intake or another professional services office

• Experience with MyCase, Clio, Lawmatics or a similar legal software

• Experience building automations in Zapier or Make

• Experience writing SOPs or training guides

• Basic Canva and social media scheduling skills

Schedule, pay and logistics

• Hours: Part-time to start 20 hours per week, with the potential to move to full-time, Monday to Friday, overlapping with our office hours in US Eastern Time (Mon–Thu 9:00 AM–4:30 PM, Fri 9:00 AM–12:00 PM ET)

• Pay: USD per hour, depending on experience, paid via Wise

• Trial period: 30-day paid trial, with a pay review after 90 days

• Time tracking: Jibble time tracker with screenshots during working hours

• Paid time off: Philippine regular holidays plus [X] days of paid leave after 6 months

• Confidentiality: You will sign a confidentiality agreement before you start, since you will handle private client information

• Growth: Performance bonuses and raises as you take on more of our systems and automation work



How to apply

Please send the following through OnlineJobs.ph:

1. A short cover letter telling us why you are a good fit for a law firm

2. Your resume, with the US clients and tools you have worked with

3. A 1–2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself in English

4. Your internet speed test result (a screenshot from speedtest.net)

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD and your earliest start date

Applications missing any of these items will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task (data entry and a lead follow-up
) and a video interview.

title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Using SEO data to make content decisions.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms in professional SEO or content workflows.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



Local SEO Knowledge

Candidates should have strong working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page strategy.

-City and location-page strategy.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local content architecture and service-to-location relationships.

-Local competitor and SERP analysis.

-Determining when location-specific pages are justified by search intent and business needs.

-Avoiding thin, duplicate, templated, or doorway-style local pages.

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

-Content prioritization.

-Google Search Console data.

-Modern search behavior and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable.



AI & Claude Experience

AI is an important part of how our team works. We are particularly interested in candidates who know how to use AI for more than simply generating content.

You should be comfortable using AI to assist with:



-Research and analysis.

-Local and organic content-gap identification.

-Competitor and SERP analysis.

-Content strategy and prioritization.

-Service and location content planning.

-Content briefs.

-SEO analysis.

-Reviewing and improving existing content.

-Identifying entity, topic, and question-coverage opportunities.

-Developing repeatable workflows.



Experience using Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, or other structured/reusable AI workflows is a strong advantage but is not required.



We can teach our specific systems to someone with excellent SEO/content strategy skills who can learn sophisticated AI workflows.



AI Search Visibility

We also want this person to understand how search is evolving beyond traditional organic rankings.



The strategist should be able to consider how content can improve visibility across Google AI experiences and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.



This includes thinking about entity clarity, topical coverage, question coverage, authoritative supporting content, and how local businesses and their services, locations, and expertise are represented across the web.



AI search knowledge is important, but it does not replace strong traditional and Local SEO fundamentals.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:



-Thinks strategically rather than simply completing tasks.

-Has strong Local SEO instincts as well as broader organic SEO knowledge.

-Can determine whether a local content opportunity actually deserves a dedicated page.

-Can explain the reasoning behind recommendations.

-Has strong professional content writing and editing experience and can recognize excellent versus mediocre content.

-Can independently improve content to a publication-ready standard when needed.

-Is highly analytical.

-Has strong attention to detail.

-Can work independently.

-Follows instructions carefully.

-Communicates clearly.

-Is comfortable learning new technology and workflows.

-Understands that AI should enhance strategic thinking rather than replace it.

-Can identify opportunities rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Position Details

Position: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search

Schedule: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time

Location: Remote - Worldwide

Compensation: Competitive compensation based on experience, demonstrated skill level, and geographic market.



Candidates must be able to consistently work the required Eastern Time schedule.



This is not a freelance or part-time opportunity. We are hiring someone to work full-time as part of our team.



Application Process

Applications submitted through the job platform alone will not be considered.

To apply, you must complete our application form:



The application includes questions about your SEO, Local SEO, digital marketing agency, content strategy, writing/editing, and AI experience and requires a short video introduction.



Candidates who successfully complete the initial application process may be invited to complete a practical assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the position, including Local SEO content strategy, broader SEO strategy, and content writing/editing judgment.



Hiring Process

Application + Video → Initial Review → Practical Assessment → Team Review → Interview → Final Evaluation

We use this process to evaluate practical ability, Local SEO and organic SEO strategy, content writing and editing ability, strategic thinking, communication, attention to detail, and overall fit for the position.



Please do not apply unless you are willing to complete the full application process and can consistently work 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time.

title: ☀️ GoHighLevel Expert & API Integration Specialist – Solar/Roofing CRM

About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **GoHighLevel (GHL) Systems Architect and API Developer to build and optimize a comprehensive CRM and operations system for our commercial solar, residential solar, and roofing businesses.



We already have a detailed technical blueprint and scope of work. We need someone who can execute complex CRM architecture, build advanced workflows, integrate external platforms, and develop custom solutions—not just create funnels or basic automations.



Experience with Python and FastAPI is a major advantage, particularly for integrating our custom door-knocking and canvassing application, Smart Knock, with GoHighLevel.

Key Responsibilities

/SMS infrastructure, and A2P 10DLC registration where applicable.

 reports.

4. API Integrations and Automation

- Integrate GoHighLevel with external applications using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and custom code.

- Implement two-way synchronization between GHL and OpenSolar, including project creation, design links, system size, contract price, proposal documents, and signing status.

- Integrate QuickBooks Online or Xero with the appropriate business sub-accounts.

- Configure mobile-friendly estimates, digital contracts, invoices, and supported payment options.

- Troubleshoot API issues, workflow errors, and integration failures.

- Help deploy and maintain our custom Smart Knock door-knocking and canvassing application.

- Integrate Python/FastAPI services with the GoHighLevel v2 API.

- Configure embedded applications through GHL Custom Menu Links and iframe-based interfaces where supported.

- Pass appropriate account and user identifiers to create or update contacts and trigger pipeline opportunities.

- Maintain secure API authentication, error handling, and reliable data synchronization.



6. Ongoing Maintenance and Optimization

- Test and document workflows, integrations, and system configurations.

- Identify and resolve technical issues.

- Improve CRM performance and automation reliability.

- Develop new integrations and custom add-ons as the business grows.



Required Qualifications



- Demonstrated experience building complex systems in GoHighLevel.

- Strong knowledge of GHL workflows, custom fields and objects, pipelines, permissions, dashboards, and contracts.

- Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and API authentication.

- Experience with 
, Zapier, or custom integration middleware.

- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and document solutions.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to follow an established technical blueprint.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with solar companies, roofing contractors, home services businesses, or EPC operations.

- Familiarity with OpenSolar, Aurora, Solo, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, Roofr, or SalesRabbit.

- Python and FastAPI development experience.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or Xero integrations.

- Experience managing large CRM databases and multi-account environments.

- Knowledge of A2P 10DLC compliance and messaging infrastructure.



Engagement Structure



Phase 1: Initial Project Build

- CRM architecture and sub-account configuration.

- Pipeline and workflow development.

- User permissions and dashboards.

- External integrations and custom application setup.

- Testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.



Phase 2: Ongoing Support

- CRM maintenance and optimization.

- API and webhook troubleshooting.

- Workflow improvements.

- New integrations and custom feature development.



The initial project scope and milestones will be discussed with the selected candidate. Successful completion may lead to a long-term working relationship.



How to Apply

Please answer the following questions in your application:

title: Commercial Construction Project Estimator

- Mark up drawings and make updates based on project requirements or changes.

- Create or modify plans and layouts based on existing drawings and project requirements.

- Review construction documents and identify missing information, inconsistencies, or potential issues.

- Support the estimating and bidding process from initial project review through proposal preparation.

- Coordinate with project stakeholders, including owners, Project Managers, Superintendents, Subcontractors, and suppliers.

- 3+ years of experience in construction, architecture, drafting, BIM, estimating, or a related field.

title: Investment & Credit Analyst
description:
Title: Investment & Credit Analyst (Part-time, 25 to 30 hours a week, UK hours)

Fee: $800 to $950 per month for 25 to 30 hours a week, plus an annual performance bonus of up to one month's fee

About us

We are a Glasgow-based private investment and lending firm active in energy, infrastructure, housing and structured credit across the UK and US. We are launching direct lending programmes in both markets and are building a small, high-performing remote team that works directly with our Managing Director.

What you will do

• Build and maintain financial models: three-statement, cash flow, debt sizing, returns and scenario analysis.

• Underwrite borrowers: spread financial statements, analyse cash flow and leverage, test covenants (DSCR, ICR, LTV, gearing) and draft credit papers for the credit committee.

• Write investment committee memos with a clear recommendation and risk assessment.

• Produce external materials: 1-pagers, teasers and investor and lender presentations.

• Monitor live loans and investments against covenants and flag issues early.

• Research markets, counterparties and comparable transactions.

What you need

• 3+ years in financial analysis, credit analysis or modelling at a bank, lender, investment firm, advisory firm or a KPO serving UK, US or Australian clients.

• Advanced Excel. You build models from a blank sheet without templates.

• Experience writing credit or investment memos in clear, concise English, in your own words. AI tools are fine for checking your work, never for drafting it.

• Strong PowerPoint skills and a clean, professional visual standard.

• Degree in finance, accounting or economics.

• Able to work 25 to 30 hours a week within UK business hours on a fixed weekly schedule. Other work is fine if disclosed, but not for competing lenders, investors or advisers.

Advantages

• Bank credit analysis experience (corporate, project finance or receivables).

• Exposure to infrastructure, energy, housing, construction or government contractor lending.

• CFA (any level), CPA or equivalent.

How to apply (applications that do not follow every step are not reviewed)

1. Use the subject line: "Analyst: [Your full name]: Covenant".

2. Attach your CV as a PDF.

3. Answer in writing, 150 words maximum each:

    1. Describe the most complex model you have built from scratch: purpose, structure and the hardest part.

    2. A borrower's DSCR falls from 1.40x to 1.15x in one year. What would you check, and in what order?

    3. How many clients or employers do you currently work for, and how many hours a week?

4. Record a 2-minute video introducing yourself and explaining your current work and how you would fit 25 to 30 hours a week around it. Send it as an unlisted link.

5. Attach one sample of your work (a model screenshot, memo extract or slide), with confidential details removed.

title: Engineering Student / Hardware Developer
description:
# Looking for Engineering Student / Hardware Developer



I am looking for an engineering student, intern, or hardware developer with a background or strong interest in **electrical engineering, embedded systems, IoT, wireless communications, or hardware development**.



I am developing an early-stage project involving a **small networked beacon device** designed to provide directional and navigation data for **blind and visually impaired individuals**.



**Project Status:** The software prototype is already in development, and I am looking for someone to help advance the hardware side of the project, including component selection, hardware architecture, prototyping, and testing.



The device will be approximately **pager-sized or slightly larger** and may include:



- GPS

- Cellular connectivity

- Bluetooth LE

- Wi-Fi

- Thread/Matter

- LoRa / mesh networking

- Battery power, potentially with solar charging

- Off-the-shelf microcontroller

- Power-management and communication components



The system may use a **mesh-network architecture similar to Meshtastic**, allowing multiple nodes to receive and relay data to wearable devices or smartphones.



### What You'll Help With



- Evaluate and select suitable hardware components.

- Design and develop the hardware architecture.

- Integrate GPS, wireless communication, and power-management systems.

- Build and test hardware prototypes.

- Collaborate with the existing software development team.

- Help move the project toward a functional **minimum viable product (MVP)**.



The software prototype is already underway, so the primary focus of this role is **hardware development and integration with the existing software**.



I am open to working with an engineering student, intern, or experienced hardware developer who is interested in contributing technical ideas and helping build an innovative assistive technology solution.



I am located in **Arlington, Virginia**, and plan to develop, test, and eventually deploy the system.



If you have experience or an interest in **hardware, embedded systems, GPS, LoRa, wireless networking, or IoT**, I would love to connect.



**Contact:** 



I welcome technical ideas, collaboration, and suggestions. I look forward to bringing this project to life and developing technology that can make navigation more accessible for blind and visually impaired individuals.

title: Social Media Growth Expert
description:
About the role

We're hiring a Social Media Growth Strategist to turn It's About Time into a show with an audience that matches its guest list. You will own subscriber and follower growth on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, and the engagement that drives it.

It's About Time is a video series from Laughing Man Studios built around the mechanical clock in Bogardus Plaza, TriBeCa. Guests have included Ed Burns, Danny Meyer and Brooke Shields. The format pairs a fast, gamified quick-fire round at the clock with a longer sit-down conversation. The guests are already world-class; the following isn't yet. That's your job.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy and also do the work: packaging, posting, testing, community management and reporting.

What you'll own

Strategy across all three platforms

Build and run a cross-platform growth plan with clear roles for each channel: YouTube for depth and subscriptions, TikTok for reach and discovery, Instagram for community and the downtown audience.

Turn each episode into a content package: full-length video, Shorts, Reels, TikToks, carousels and Stories.

Run a weekly test-and-learn cadence on hooks, thumbnails, titles, lengths and posting times, and scale what works.

YouTube: subscriptions

Own titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, end screens and playlists for every upload.

Use YouTube Shorts as a funnel into long-form episodes and subscriptions.

Work with our existing vidIQ optimization approach and YouTube Analytics to improve click-through rate, average view duration and subscriber conversion per video.

Plan a consistent upload schedule the production team can sustain.

TikTok: growth and discovery

Cut and publish native vertical content built around the clock quick-fire round and the strongest guest moments.

Spot trends, sounds and formats early and adapt them to the show's voice.

Grow followers and drive viewers toward the full episodes on YouTube.

Instagram: growth and community

Run Reels, carousels and Stories that build a loyal audience, especially in TriBeCa and downtown Manhattan.

Use collaborative posts with guests to tap into their audiences.

Connect the show with the Laughing Man cafe, studio and Bogardus Plaza community online.

Engagement

Manage comments, DMs and community replies across platforms in the show's voice.

Design prompts, polls, challenges and audience participation (for example, viewers answering the quick-fire questions themselves).

Coordinate with guests and their teams on promotion and cross-posting around each release.

Identify creator and brand collaborations that expand reach.

Reporting

Track growth weekly and report monthly to leadership with what worked, what didn't and what's next.

Provide audience data that supports sponsorship conversations.

How we'll measure success

You'll be judged on growth and engagement, with specific targets agreed in your first 30 days.

Platform

Primary metric

Supporting metrics

YouTube

Net new subscribers per month

Click-through rate, average view duration, subscribers per video, Shorts-to-long-form conversion

TikTok

Net new followers per month

Views per post, share rate, completion rate

Instagram

Net new followers per month

Reel reach, saves and shares, collab-post reach

All platforms

Engagement rate

Comments, replies, community response time



First 90 days

Days 1–30: Audit all three channels and past performance. Set baseline numbers and agree growth targets with leadership.

Days 31–60: Launch the cross-platform content system and a consistent posting schedule. Start weekly testing on hooks and thumbnails.

Days 61–90: Double down on winning formats, launch guest collaboration playbooks and deliver your first full growth report.

Who you are

Required

3+ years growing social channels for a show, creator, media brand or entertainment company.

A track record you can show with numbers: channels you grew, by how much, and how.

Deep working knowledge of YouTube Analytics, TikTok and Instagram insights, and tools like vidIQ or TubeBuddy.

Strong instincts for hooks, thumbnails, titles and short-form pacing.

Comfortable editing short-form video yourself (CapCut, Premiere or similar).

Organized enough to run a weekly publishing calendar without reminders.

Nice to have

Experience with interview, talk or celebrity-driven content.

Relationships with creators, talent teams or brand partnership managers.

Familiarity with automation tools for scheduling and publishing.

Knowledge of New York, TriBeCa or downtown culture.

description:

In this role, you will be making outbound cold calls to American blue-collar trade companies (plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical, etc.) to schedule appointments for our sales team.

If you are a fluent English speaker who can deliver a compelling sales pitch, masterfully handle phone objections, and navigate GoHighLevel, we want to hear from you!



What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)

• Hourly Rate: $4.00 – $5.00 per hour (based on experience).

• Performance Raises: Yearly hourly rate increases based on your performance and results.

• Closed-Deal Bonuses: Cash bonuses for every successfully closed deal generated from your leads (paid out directly in your next bi-weekly payment!).

• 13th Month Pay: Standard annual bonus included.

• Paid Time Off (PTO): Available after 6 months of successful employment.



Key Responsibilities

• Conduct outbound cold calls to blue-collar businesses across the United States.

• Deliver an engaging sales pitch and confidently handle gatekeepers and objections.

• Navigate (GHL) to schedule appointments and accurately log call results.

• Meet daily/weekly targets for dials and booked appointments.

• Maintain a professional, confident, and energetic tone on every call.



Job Requirements

• Proven Experience: 3 to 5 years of solid cold calling and sales experience.

• Sales Mastery: Proven ability in sales pitch delivery and objection handling.

• GHL Familiarity: Prior experience working inside GoHighLevel is preferred (basic navigation, setting appointments, and tagging call dispositions).

• Schedule Flexibility: Ability to adjust your working hours to align with various US Time Zones (EST, CST, MST, PST).

• Communication Skills: Flawless verbal English communication with a clear, professional accent.

• Work Environment: A designated, quiet workspace free from background noise.

• Tech Requirements: A highly reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution.



How to Apply (Strictly Follow These Instructions)

To be considered for an interview, you must use the subject line "Cold Calling Rockstar" and include the following two items in your first message to us:

1. Internet Speed Proof: Attach a screenshot/picture of your current internet speed test result.

2. Voice Recording: Send a voice memo or a link to a voice recording (Vocaroo, Loom, etc.) introducing yourself so we can evaluate your English fluency, sales tone, and sound quality.



Incomplete applications or messages with incorrect subject lines will not be reviewed. We look forward to hearing from you!
