title: Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)
description:
Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience, with a clear path to increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. You'll work directly with Matt, ABG Media's CMO and founder (10+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience), and get trained in the systems we use to grow brands.



Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and edit across more ABG client accounts as we grow. Video ads are a big part of how we grow every brand we work with.



Role Overview

We're looking for a video editor who knows how to turn raw creator footage into Meta ads that sell. Not pretty videos. Ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and get people to click and buy.



You'll get briefs and scripts from our Creative Strategist, footage from our UGC creators, and performance feedback from our media buyer. But we don't want a button-pusher, and this role is a path to becoming a Creative Strategist. You'll also have real creative freedom: every week you'll pitch and make some of your own ad ideas, and the best ones get real budget behind them. When there's no creator footage, you'll build ads from B-roll, product shots, voiceover, and AI tools. When an ad wins, you'll recut it into more versions so it keeps winning.



We're an AI-forward team. We expect you to use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, production, and iteration: ChatGPT/Claude for research, hooks, and scripts; Midjourney/ChatGPT Images for concept frames; Kling, Runway, or Higgsfield for AI video and B-roll; AI voice and captions to move faster. Human judgment still owns the creative call and compliance.



Career Path: Video Editor to Creative Strategist

This is not a dead-end editing seat. Strong performers whose own ideas win in testing will be trained by the CMO into a Creative Strategist role: owning research, angles, briefs, and the weekly testing plan.



Key Responsibilities



Editing UGC & Direct Response Ads

- Cut creator/UGC footage into 15-60 second Meta ads based on our briefs and scripts.

- Pick the strongest moments from raw footage and pace them so they feel natural and keep attention.

- Add hooks, captions, music, sound effects, product shots, text overlays, and voiceover.

- Write and style native-looking captions (TikTok/Reels style, not overdesigned).



Variations & Sizing

- Create multiple hook/opening variations for each ad (3-5 openings per concept is normal).

- Deliver every ad in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 for Meta placements.

- Recut and refresh winning ads with new hooks, new footage, new music, or new structures.



Your Own Creative Ideas

- Study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok, and customer reviews to spot hooks, formats, and trends worth stealing (in spirit, not copying).

- Pitch and produce 2-3 of your own concepts each week: your own hook, short script or voiceover, and edit. Run them by the Creative Strategist and they go into testing.

- Take a winning ad and remix it your way: new hook, new structure, new format.



AI & B-Roll Ads

- Build ads from B-roll, stock, product footage, and AI voiceover when no creator footage is available.

- Use AI tools daily (Kling, Runway, Higgsfield for video; ElevenLabs for voice; ChatGPT/Claude for scripts and hook variations) to fill gaps, speed up production, and iterate faster.

- Use AI for research and ideation too: mining reviews, summarizing competitor ads, and generating hook options before you cut.



Workflow & Feedback

- Hit roughly 20-40 finished ads per month (counting variations), depending on complexity.

- Turn around revisions quickly, usually within 24 hours.

- Keep files, project folders, and naming conventions organized so anyone can find any ad.

- Study our top-performing ads to understand why they work, and bring that into your next edits.



Compliance

- No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, and no exaggerated results in captions, text overlays, or voiceover. If something in the footage crosses that line, flag it or cut it. We'll teach you our rules, but you need to care about following them.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years editing short-form ads or UGC content, with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads.

- Pro-level skill in Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop), or DaVinci Resolve.

- Able to deliver 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 versions cleanly.

- Good written and spoken English: you can read a script and understand what it's really trying to say.

- Fast, reliable, and takes feedback well.

- Creative initiative: you have your own ideas for ads and can write a simple hook and short script yourself.

- Comfortable using AI tools every day as part of your workflow (or eager to get there fast).

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- AI tools: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar.

- After Effects or basic motion graphics.

- Experience with founder-style, mashup, or voiceover-led ads.

- Basic understanding of Meta ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR).



What We're Looking For

- A storyteller who can find the ad inside raw footage

- Obsessed with the first 3 seconds

- High output without sloppy work

- Owns their work: hits deadlines and communicates early if something is off

- Wants to get better every week based on real performance data



What We Offer

- Competitive pay based on experience, with a clear path to increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our direct response ad systems

- Work directly with the CMO (10+ years in ecommerce) and our Creative Strategist

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Clear briefs and scripts from a dedicated Creative Strategist

- Creative freedom to pitch and make your own ads, plus real performance feedback so you can see which ones win

- A clear career path into Creative Strategist: strong performers whose ideas win get trained by the CMO into strategy

- Or grow into a Senior Editor / Lead Editor role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN CUT" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've edited for, and your editing software.

2. REQUIRED SAMPLE: Links to 3 ads you edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio links; make sure they're viewable). Ads that ran on Meta are preferred. For each one, tell us in one line what you did (full edit, hooks only, captions, etc.).

3. The AI tools you use regularly, if any, and what you use each one for.

4. ONE AD IDEA OF YOUR OWN: for any DTC supplement or wellness product, give us a hook line and a 3-5 line script or shot list for an ad you'd make. Supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

5. Share your expected monthly pay (USD) based on your experience.

6. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can overlap with US Central time.



Applications without 3 sample ads and your own ad idea will not be considered. We'll review applications and shortlist within about a week. Finalists will complete a short paid test edit using footage we provide before we make an offer.



HOW TO APPLY: In your application, explain why you're an expert in performance ads. Name the brands or products you've edited for, tell us which of your ads earned real spend and why they worked, and share any results you know. Ads Manager spend screenshots are a plus but not required. Also tell us where you learned your skill and how you keep learning.

title: Revenue Operations Contractor
description:

Manage annual pricing updates in Salesforce, including price books, products, and quote templates, making sure they’re accurate and released on schedule.

Ensure all security updates and protocols are implemented in a timely manner.

title: TikTok UGC Creator & Poster: Easy, Flexible, Long-Term
description:
TikTok UGC Creator & Poster: Easy, Flexible, Long-Term



About us

We’re an Australian online brand selling laboratory research supplies. We’re building our TikTok presence and want a creator who can help us grow it from day one. You don’t need to be famous or have a big following. You just need to be fun, consistent and comfortable on camera.



Why you’ll love this role



Super simple work. Short videos filmed on your phone, with no fancy gear or editing skills needed.

We give you the ideas. You’ll get video concepts, hooks and scripts, so you’re never stuck wondering what to post.

Work from anywhere, on your own schedule. Film whenever suits you.

No experience necessary. We care more about energy and reliability than follower count.

Grow with us. Top creators get more videos, first pick of new campaigns, and a long-term spot on our team.

Build your portfolio. It’s a great way to get UGC experience and brand work under your belt.



What you’ll do



Film short TikTok videos of 15–60 seconds on your phone

Create content such as product unboxings, packaging close-ups, “pack an order with me”, behind-the-scenes, trending sounds and formats, and brand FAQs

Post videos to our TikTok account using captions and hashtags we provide or approve

Jump on relevant trends quickly

Reply to comments and help build our community



What we’re looking for



Comfortable on camera, or happy to do faceless videos (hands, voiceover, product shots)

A smartphone with a decent camera

Basic TikTok knowledge. If you scroll it daily, you’re qualified.

Reliable and consistent. If you say you’ll post, you post.

Able to follow simple brand guidelines

Bonus: CapCut skills, experience with trends, or previous UGC work



Content guidelines (easy to follow)



Keep it fun, clean and professional

No health, medical or personal-use claims. Our products are for research use only, and we’ll show you exactly what’s okay to say.



To apply, please include



Links to 1–3 TikToks or videos you’ve made (any topic is fine)

A short intro about yourself and how many videos you could create per week

One video idea you’d want to make for us

Start your message with “Lights” so we know you read the full post



Start: Immediately



Please reach out via whatsapp

description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor 



We’re looking for a remote contractor with experience creating animated videos for ongoing weekly work. We use doodle and whiteboard animation, engaging visuals, and clear storytelling to make educational and finance topics easy to understand and enjoyable to watch. Please include examples of relevant animated videos you’ve created.



Weekly workload: 



Every week you must finish:



1. One 8–10 minute YouTube video

2. Three related Shorts



If we need more that week, we may add a second package: One extra long video and Three extra Shorts



Both packages, if assigned, must still be finished that same week. Pay will be adjusted for the extra package.

Tools:



 - Intra Doodle for doodle / animated scenes

title: Freelance Backlink Specialist: Technical B2B Digital PR
description:

Stratique is a UK B2B marketing and lead generation agency working with manufacturing, engineering and specialist businesses.



Your purpose

Earn relevant, credible links and mentions that help our clients get found and trusted by search engines and AI tools.

You will report to our Senior SEO Strategist, who sets the link and digital PR plan. Schedules and deadlines are set by our Digital Campaign Coordinator. You will work closely with our AEO/GEO Specialist, account managers and writers.

• Verify every placement: live link, anchor text, link attributes and indexing.

• Keep accurate prospect, contact and outreach records.

• Report progress, blockers and results every week.

We never buy links or use private blog networks, link farms, mass or automated outreach, or any tactic that breaks search engine guidelines.



Core requirements

• Demonstrable white-hat link building or outreach experience, with live examples.

• Strong research skills and a clear understanding of link quality and relevance.

• Excellent written English and confidence writing to UK B2B audiences.

• Familiarity with a recognised SEO research tool.

• Organised record-keeping and reliable follow-through.

• Manufacturing, engineering or other technical B2B sectors.

• Digital PR or trade press relationships.

• Outreach or CRM tools.

• Relevant, verified placements secured.

• Accurate, complete outreach records.

• No links that break search engine guidelines.

• Prompt communication of blockers and results.

 you have used.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Chief of Staff – Operations, Growth & Marketing



Company: Rentercasa

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Eastern Time

Salary: ₱120,000–₱150,000 PHP per month, based on experience and leadership ability



About Rentercasa

Rentercasa is a growing U.S.-based property management company specializing in co-living, room rentals, and residential property management.



We are looking for an experienced Chief of Staff who can help run the business, manage department leaders, improve performance, and drive growth.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant or administrative position. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who can manage managers, analyze KPIs, solve problems, improve systems, and turn company goals into execution. You will report directly to the Founder.



Who You Will Manage

• Operations Manager

• Leasing Manager

• Marketing Manager/Specialist

• Collections Manager

• Other team leads as assigned



Your responsibility is to make sure these departments work together and consistently achieve their goals.



Main Responsibilities



Operations & Execution

• Turn company goals into actionable plans.

• Hold managers accountable for deadlines and results.

• Lead weekly management and accountability meetings.

• Monitor departmental KPIs.

• Identify operational problems and implement solutions.

• Coordinate projects involving multiple departments.

• Improve communication between teams.

• Ensure company policies and SOPs are followed.

• Reduce routine operational issues requiring Founder involvement.



Maintain an executive dashboard and provide weekly reporting on performance, missed targets, risks, opportunities, and matters requiring executive decisions.



Co-Living Operations

Oversee performance across the entire co-living lifecycle: Property Onboarding → Room Readiness → Marketing → Lead Generation → Leasing → Move-In → Resident Management → Collections → Retention → Turnover.



Monitor property onboarding, room readiness, occupancy, vacancies, resident onboarding, leasing, collections, delinquency, evictions, maintenance coordination, inspections, room turns, and resident and owner escalations.



Leasing & Occupancy

Work closely with the Leasing Manager to ensure rooms are getting filled. Track occupancy, vacant rooms, days vacant, leads, response times, tours, applications, approvals, move-ins, conversion rates, and leasing-agent productivity. When rooms are sitting vacant, work with Leasing, Marketing, and Operations to identify the cause and implement an immediate action plan.



Marketing Management

Supervise the Marketing Manager/Specialist and ensure marketing generates measurable business results. Oversee property advertising, listing performance, social media, lead-generation campaigns,
 and SMS campaigns, referral marketing, local marketing, owner-acquisition campaigns, partnerships, and new marketing channels.



Marketing will be measured by qualified leads, cost per lead, conversions, occupancy generated, owner leads, and marketing ROI—not simply the number of posts created.



Collections & Revenue

Supervise the Collections Manager and monitor collection percentage, delinquency, past-due balances, payment commitments, eviction status, bad debt, and resident payment trends. Ensure collection procedures are consistently followed and financial risks are addressed quickly.



Business Development & Growth

Help grow Rentercasa's management portfolio by developing relationships with property owners, real estate investors, Realtors, brokers, builders, housing organizations, employers, nonprofits, referral partners, and strategic partners.



Maintain a measurable business-development pipeline and track owner leads, sales meetings, proposals, follow-ups, signed management agreements, properties and rooms added, pipeline value, and conversion rates. Assist with new-market expansion, strategic partnerships, portfolio acquisitions, and other growth opportunities.



KPI & Performance Management

Own the company-wide management scorecard. When a KPI is missed: Identify the problem → Determine the cause → Create a corrective action plan → Assign accountability → Follow up → Measure improvement.



You must be comfortable managing a business through numbers and measurable results.



People Leadership

Manage department heads, conduct weekly accountability meetings, review manager scorecards, establish priorities, identify staffing and training needs, address performance problems early, and build a culture of ownership, urgency, communication, and accountability.



Systems, SOPs & Automation

• Create and improve SOPs.

• Document workflows.

• Eliminate unnecessary manual work.

• Identify automation opportunities.

• Use AI to improve efficiency.

• Audit processes.

• Improve reporting and communication.

• Ensure company systems contain accurate information.



Experience with Google Workspace, Rentvine, Follow Up Boss, CRMs, property-management software, project-management systems, and marketing platforms is helpful.



Special Projects

Lead projects involving new-market launches, new service offerings, portfolio acquisitions, technology implementations, operational restructuring, marketing initiatives, strategic partnerships, process improvements, and company expansion.



Who We're Looking For

• Thinks like an operator, not an assistant.

• Comfortable managing managers.

• Takes ownership without constant direction.

• Understands KPIs and dashboards.

• Can analyze numbers and identify problems.

• Can move between strategy and hands-on execution.

• Understands sales, business development, and marketing.

• Can manage multiple departments simultaneously.

• Communicates professionally and clearly.

• Is comfortable challenging underperformance.

• Solves problems instead of simply reporting them.



Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of operations, leadership, project management, real estate, property management, hospitality, co-living, or related experience.

• Experience supervising managers or team leaders.

• Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

• Experience managing remote teams.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong Google Workspace skills.

• Experience with KPIs, dashboards, CRMs, and performance reporting.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Property management or real estate experience strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to establish clear departmental KPIs, implement a company-wide management scorecard, establish weekly manager accountability meetings, improve visibility into occupancy and financial performance, identify operational bottlenecks, strengthen cross-department communication, improve owner service, and build a measurable business-development pipeline.



Ultimately, success means: Rooms are getting filled. Collections are performing. Managers are accountable. Owners receive excellent service. Marketing produces measurable results. The portfolio is growing. Problems are solved quickly. The Founder can focus on strategy and expansion.



Compensation

₱120,000–₱150,000 PHP per month



Final compensation will be based on experience, demonstrated leadership ability, and qualifications. This is a full-time, long-term position working primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



How to Apply

1. Submit your resume.

2. Provide a brief explanation of your experience managing teams or managers.

3. Provide an example of a KPI or scorecard you have previously managed.

4. Describe a business or operational problem you identified and solved.

5. Submit a 1–2 minute introduction video explaining who you are, your leadership experience, your experience managing managers or departments, and why you would be an excellent Chief of Staff for Rentercasa.



Applications without the requested information and introduction video may not be considered.

title: IT Helpdesk Specialist
description:
Role Overview

As an IT Helpdesk Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for technical support within the organization during US business hours, with in-house IT serving as the escalation point. You will troubleshoot and resolve issues with our primary systems, provide remote hardware and software support, and suggest improvements to IT workflows based on recurring ticket trends and knowledge base gaps. The ideal candidate is resourceful, tech-savvy, and customer-service oriented.

Scope: This role works US Pacific (PST/PDT) or US Central (CST/CDT) business hours, with flexibility to consider US Eastern (EST/EDT) hours. On-site work, system administration, and security remain with in-house IT.

Reports to: VP Operations and Technology

What success looks like: Meeting SLA targets, resolving issues on first contact where possible, high user satisfaction, and an accurate, growing knowledge base.



Key Responsibilities

Technical Support: Provide remote first-level support for operating system, application, connectivity, and peripheral issues on Windows and Mac, including printers, Wi-Fi/VPN, and home-office connectivity.

I
 Resolution: Respond to and resolve tickets by
, chat, or phone within defined SLA targets. Triage every ticket by impact and urgency, keep status and notes updated at each step, and escalate to senior IT when troubleshooting is exhausted or a ticket is at risk of missing its SLA.

Microsoft 365 and Slack Support: Provide user-level support for accounts, licenses, group membership, and troubleshooting in Microsoft 365 (including Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive) and Slack (account access, channels, notifications, and basic member management). Access is limited to what the role requires.

Password, Lockout, and MFA Resets: Complete required identity verification before any reset or access change to protect against social engineering. Admin and executive accounts are handled by in-house IT.

Access and Software Requests: Process access, software, and local admin password requests under our IT Hardware & Software Request Standards, including manager approval. Fulfill only pre-approved groups and applications.

Onboarding/Offboarding: Run Trelica onboarding and offboarding workflows from an approved request, following the checklist, to set up access for new hires and securely deactivate accounts for departing employees. Permanent deletions and device wipes require in-house IT approval, and in-house IT may run sensitive offboardings directly.

Device Management and Monitoring: Support company laptops, desktops, and mobile devices remotely through NinjaOne and Intune (troubleshooting, app installs, and compliance checks). Use NinjaOne for remote sessions, monitoring alerts, and patch status, and escalate any failures.

Security Handoff: Forward reported phishing
s, suspicious sign-ins, and other security concerns to in-house IT without investigating. Urgent concerns, such as a suspected compromised account, go through the urgent escalation path rather than the regular Slack channel.

Documentation and Records: Write or update a knowledge base article for any new or repeat issue (reviewed by in-house IT before publishing), maintain FAQs and user guides, and keep ticket and asset records accurate.

Communication with In-House IT

Ticketing System: NinjaOne is the system of record for all user requests and updates. No work happens without a ticket.

Slack IT Channel: Day-to-day coordination with in-house IT. Respond to IT team messages within 30 minutes during the shift, and faster for P1 escalations.

Slack Direct Message or Phone: Urgent P1 escalations only, following the escalation path.

Slack Status: Keep your status current (available, away, on break) throughout the shift.

End-of-Shift Handoff: Post a report of open tickets, escalations, and recurring issues in the Slack IT channel before the shift ends.



Qualifications

Experience

• At least 2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk or technical support role.

• Familiarity with remote work environments and supporting distributed teams.

• Experience supporting US-based clients, or working at an MSP/BPO, in a similar offshore setup is preferred.

Technical Skills

• Proficient in user-level Microsoft 365 and Entra ID support (accounts, licenses, MFA, password resets, local admin password requests, and Outlook/Teams/OneDrive troubleshooting).

• Skilled in supporting Slack users (account access, channels, notifications, and basic member management).

• Knowledgeable in both Windows and macOS environments.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and ticketing systems.

• Experience with NinjaOne or Trelica (preferred but not required).

• Basic understanding of networking concepts and remote access tools.

• Certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, or Microsoft MD-102 or MS-900 are a plus.

Soft Skills

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication in English.

• Strong collaborative mindset, with efficient communication with senior IT staff.

• Strong customer service orientation with a focus on user satisfaction.

• Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently during the scheduled shift, with set start and end times and required overlap with in-house IT.

Work Requirements

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Backup power and internet to cover outages and brownouts.

• A private and secure workspace.

• Use of a company-managed device or approved security controls.

• Signed NDA and data-protection agreement.

• Use of a secured admin account for elevated tasks.

title: Community & CRM Virtual Assistant
description:
Role overview



We are hiring a remote, full-time virtual assistant to run our online community, newsletter, and CRM day to day. You will be the friendly, organized voice members and subscribers hear from between Dr. Truong's live calls and content.



About us. 



Dr. Anne Truong is a board-certified sexual health specialist and author of Erectile Dysfunction Fix. She runs the Modern Man Club, a paid Skool community that pairs group coaching, live Q&A calls, and a doctor-led natural protocol for men with erectile dysfunction. Our audience is mostly men in their 50s, and many join after trying quick fixes that didn't work. We reach them through a
 group, a YouTube channel, webinars, and an
 list.



Job title: Community & CRM Virtual Assistant

Location: Remote

Reports to: Dr. Anne Truong



Key responsibilities

Modern Man Club community (Skool)

Welcome every new member within 24 hours and guide them to the onboarding steps and protocol materials.

Post daily engagement prompts, wins threads, and reminders that keep members on track with the 90-day protocol.

Announce and promote the twice-monthly live Q&A calls; post replays and summaries afterward.

Monitor posts and comments daily, answer non-medical questions, and route medical questions to Dr. Truong.

Moderate the community: enforce guidelines, remove spam, and flag sensitive posts.

Track engagement and spot members who have gone quiet, then reach out to re-engage them.

Social media 
 group, YouTube, other channels)

Moderate the
 group, approve members, and answer questions using approved responses.

Reply to YouTube and social comments, and invite engaged followers to the free lead magnet, webinars, or the Club.

Schedule posts and clips repurposed from Dr. Truong's videos, webinars, and live calls.

Keep a simple content calendar and a log of common questions for future content.

Newsletter setup and management

Set up and maintain the
 newsletter: templates, branding, sign-up forms, and list segments.

Draft, format, and schedule the weekly newsletter from Dr. Truong's content, for her approval.

Build and maintain automated sequences: lead magnet welcome, webinar reminders, and Club onboarding.

Make sure every
 includes the required compliance footer and unsubscribe link.

Report monthly on list growth, open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes.

DoctorBoss CRM management

Keep contact records, tags, and pipelines accurate and up to date.

Enter and update leads from webinars, the lead magnet, and social channels.

Set up and monitor CRM workflows, automations, and follow-up tasks.

Manage appointment reminders and follow-ups for ED Breakthrough Visits.

Clean the database regularly: remove duplicates and fix missing fields.

Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA rules for all patient data in the CRM.

Reporting and admin

Send Dr. Truong a short weekly report: new members, engagement, newsletter results, leads, and open issues.

Keep SOPs (written how-tos) current for each recurring task.



Requirements



2+ years as a community manager, social media manager, or virtual assistant for an online business, coach, or course creator.

Hands-on experience with an online community platform (Skool preferred; Circle, Mighty Networks, or
 Groups also fine).



Experience setting up and sending
 newsletters and automations (for example GoHighLevel, Kajabi, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, or similar).



Experience with a CRM: managing contacts, tags, pipelines, and workflows. DoctorBoss experience is a strong plus.



Excellent written English with a warm, professional tone.



Comfortable discussing men's sexual health topics with maturity, discretion, and respect.



Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently with written SOPs.



Reliable internet, availability Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, and quick response times.



Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement and complete HIPAA training before handling patient data.



Nice to have



Experience in healthcare, telehealth, or wellness marketing.

Basic graphic design (Canva) and short-form video scheduling.

Familiarity with
 deliverability and list segmentation.

Experience with Loom, Google Workspace, and project tools like Asana or ClickUp.



What this role is not

You will not give medical advice. All medical or treatment questions go to Dr. Truong or her clinical team.



Schedule and compensation

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.

Pay: $6–$7 USD per hour, based on experience.

Trial: Paid 2-week trial project, then a 90-day review.

KPIs: weekly engagement rate, active members %, response time, posts saved/shared, call bookings.

 

Success in the first 90 days

Every new member is welcomed within 24 hours.

The newsletter goes out on schedule every week.

The CRM is clean, tagged, and connected to the newsletter and lead sources.

SOPs are written for every recurring task.



How to apply



Send the following: (INCOMPLETE REQUIREMENTS WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED)

1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and the communities, newsletters, or CRMs you have managed.

3. A sample welcome post for a new Modern Man Club member (under 150 words).

4. Your expected hourly rate and confirmation that you can work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.

5. Include the word "Morning" in your subject line so we know you read the full post.



Please keep an eye on your online jobs messages as we reply here to set up an interview.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Company: Rentercasa

Position: Marketing Coordinator

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation: ₱40,000–₱50,000 PHP per month, based on experience and qualifications

Industry: Property Management | Co-Living | Residential Real Estate



POSITION SUMMARY



Rentercasa is seeking a creative, organized, and results-driven Marketing Coordinator to coordinate and execute day-to-day marketing initiatives for our growing co-living and property management business.



The Marketing Coordinator will be responsible for increasing occupancy, generating qualified renter and property-owner leads, managing digital marketing channels, creating engaging content, maintaining property listings, and tracking marketing performance.



This is a performance-focused marketing position. Success is measured not simply by posts, views, or followers, but by qualified leads, applications, occupied rooms, new property-management opportunities, and revenue growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Property & Co-Living Marketing

• Develop and execute campaigns designed to fill available Rentercasa rooms and properties.

• Create compelling advertisements for available rooms and rental properties.

• Maintain accurate, attractive, and up-to-date property listings.

• Market vacancies across
 Marketplace,
 Groups, Craigslist, Roomies, Roomster, and other applicable rental platforms.

• Identify new websites, platforms, groups, organizations, and partnerships that can generate renter leads.

• Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, advertising, and positioning.

• Work closely with Leasing to identify properties requiring additional marketing attention.

• Develop campaigns and promotions for properties experiencing extended vacancy.

• Help drive Rentercasa’s goal of reducing vacancy and increasing portfolio occupancy.



Digital & Social Media Marketing

• Coordinate Rentercasa’s social media presence and marketing calendar.

• Create and schedule content for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

• Develop short-form videos, graphics, property advertisements, reels, and promotional content.

• Maintain consistent Rentercasa branding, messaging, fonts, colors, and visual standards.

• Respond to or appropriately route inquiries generated through marketing channels.

• Identify trending content and marketing opportunities relevant to housing, co-living, real estate, and property management.



Lead Generation

Develop and coordinate marketing strategies targeting renters and co-living members, property owners and investors, real estate agents and brokers, employers and workforce-housing partners, veterans organizations, housing agencies, relocation organizations, community organizations, universities and student-housing opportunities, and referral partners.



Build and maintain lead-generation campaigns that consistently produce qualified opportunities for the Leasing and Business Development teams.



Business Development Marketing

• Create marketing materials designed to attract new property-management clients.

• Support
, social media, and direct-outreach campaigns targeting property owners and investors.

• Develop presentations, flyers, brochures, landing-page copy, and other sales collateral.

• Assist with campaigns promoting Rentercasa’s co-living and property-management services.

• Coordinate with leadership and Business Development on growth initiatives and new-market launches.



, CRM & Marketing Automation

• Assist with lead-nurture campaigns through Follow Up Boss and other company systems.

• Create
 and text campaigns for renter leads, owners, investors, and referral partners.

• Maintain organized lead lists and marketing databases.

• Support automated follow-up campaigns.

• Track lead sources to determine which marketing channels produce the strongest results.



Content & Brand Management

Create and coordinate marketing content including property advertisements, social media posts, reels and short-form videos,
 campaigns, flyers, brochures, owner marketing materials, leasing promotions, blog and website content, testimonials, and success stories.



Ensure all marketing materials accurately represent Rentercasa’s services and brand.



PERFORMANCE & REPORTING



The Marketing Coordinator will maintain a weekly marketing scorecard and report results to management.



Key Performance Indicators

• Qualified renter leads generated

• Applications generated

• Marketing-generated move-ins

• Cost per qualified lead

• Lead-to-application conversion rate

• Application-to-move-in conversion rate

• Occupancy improvement

• Number of property listings actively marketed

• Owner/investor leads generated

• Property-management appointments generated

• Social media reach and engagement

• Website traffic

•
 campaign performance

• Response time to marketing inquiries

• Lead-source performance

• Marketing ROI



The Marketing Coordinator should continually identify which channels are producing leases and revenue and recommend shifting resources away from channels that are not performing.



WEEKLY EXPECTATIONS



• Review all current vacancies.

• Identify priority properties requiring additional marketing.

• Confirm listings are active and accurate.

• Launch or refresh advertisements.

• Review lead volume and conversion by source.

• Coordinate with Leasing regarding lead quality and occupancy needs.

• Review social media and content performance.

• Develop new lead-generation opportunities.

• Submit a weekly marketing scorecard and action plan.

• Recommend specific actions for properties that are not receiving sufficient leads.



QUALIFICATIONS



• Previous experience in marketing, digital marketing, social media, lead generation, real estate marketing, or a related field.

• Strong written English communication skills.

• Experience creating social media content and marketing materials.

• Comfortable working with Canva or similar design platforms.

• Understanding of
 Marketplace,
 Groups, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other digital marketing channels.

• Ability to coordinate multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing data.

• Ability to collaborate with Leasing, Operations, Business Development, and leadership.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with property management, real estate, co-living, apartment leasing, rental marketing, lead generation, CRM systems, Follow Up Boss, Canva, ManyChat,
 marketing, Meta Business Suite, Google Workspace, and video editing is a plus.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is creative, organized, proactive, and highly accountable to results. You enjoy testing new marketing strategies, analyzing performance, finding unconventional ways to generate leads, and quickly changing direction when something isn’t working.



You should be comfortable working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change quickly and where marketing directly impacts occupancy and revenue.



REPORTING STRUCTURE



The Marketing Coordinator reports to the Chief of Staff/Executive Leadership and works closely with the Leasing Manager, Leasing Specialists, Operations Manager, Business Development, Collections/Member Support, and Property Management Leadership.



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



Success means Rentercasa has a consistent pipeline of qualified renter and owner leads, properties receive strong marketing exposure, vacancies are aggressively addressed, the Rentercasa brand is professionally represented, and marketing activities can be directly connected to occupancy, portfolio growth, and revenue.





APPLICATION & SCREENING PROCESS



How to Apply



Applicants should submit the following:

• Updated resume.

• Link to a marketing portfolio or 3–5 examples of work, if available.

• A 1–2 minute introduction video explaining who you are, your relevant marketing experience, the tools/platforms you have used, and why you believe you would be a strong fit for Rentercasa.

• Written responses to all screening questions below.



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Tell us about your marketing experience. What types of companies, products, services, or industries have you marketed?

2. Describe a marketing campaign you personally helped execute that generated measurable leads, sales, applications, bookings, or another business result. What was the goal, what actions did you take, and what were the results?

3. What experience do you have marketing rental properties, real estate, property management, co-living, apartments, or housing-related services? If you have no direct experience, explain how your previous marketing experience would transfer to this role.

4. Rentercasa has several vacant rooms in a property, and the current marketing efforts have generated very few qualified leads over the past two weeks. As the Marketing Coordinator, what are the first five actions you would take to improve inquiries and increase applications? Please explain your priorities and why you would take those actions.

5. Suppose you are managing several marketing tasks, including publishing property listings, creating social media content, responding to lead-generation needs, and preparing a campaign report. At the same time, your manager asks you to launch an urgent marketing campaign for a property with multiple vacancies. How would you prioritize your tasks, communicate with your manager, and ensure that important deadlines are not missed?

6. Imagine that a property listing is receiving many inquiries, but most prospects are not qualified or do not proceed to schedule a viewing. How would you identify the problem and improve the quality of leads and conversion rate? What information would you review, and what changes would you make to the marketing strategy?

7. Which marketing platforms and tools are you comfortable using? Please include your experience with Canva, Meta Business Suite,
 Marketplace,
 Groups, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube,
 marketing platforms, CRMs, Follow Up Boss, ManyChat, Google Workspace, and video-editing tools.

8. What experience do you have creating short-form videos, social media graphics, property ads,
 campaigns, landing-page copy, or other marketing content? Please provide links, samples, or a portfolio when possible.

9. How do you determine whether a marketing campaign is actually working? List the key metrics you would track for a rental or co-living campaign and explain how you would use those metrics to improve performance.

10. Give an example of a time you had to manage several marketing projects or deadlines simultaneously. How did you stay organized, track progress, and ensure nothing was missed?

11. This position requires working Monday–Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time. Are you able to consistently work this schedule?

12. What is your current monthly compensation, what monthly compensation are you seeking, and how soon could you start if selected?



INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIREMENT



Please include a 1–2 minute video introduction with your application. The video should cover:

• Your name and current location.

title: Onboarding Manager – Australia
description:
About Wonderful Stay



Wonderful Stay is a short-term rental management company operating across Australia (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne and regional areas) and the UAE. We manage 50+ properties in Australia on behalf of landlords and are growing fast, with new properties signing every week. We run on Notion, Slack, Guesty and PriceLabs, and we hold ourselves to a high standard: every property we launch should look, feel and perform like a premium stay.



The role



When a landlord signs with us, you take over. You own the entire onboarding of that property, from signed agreement to a fully prepared, compliant and photographed property ready for handover to our operations team, and you make sure it meets Wonderful Stay standards within our 2-week target. This is not an assistant role. You are the person who drives every onboarding forward, makes the calls, makes the decisions and makes sure nothing gets stuck.



What you will be responsible for:

Landlord setup. You send and track the management agreement via DocuSign and confirm the onboarding fee is paid. You get the landlord onboarding form and inventory checklist back complete, and you keep every document organised in Notion and Google Drive.



Compliance. You arrange the correct short-term rental registrations and permits for each state, such as NSW STRA, the WA STRA Register, and the requirements in Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and Tasmania. You make sure no property is handed over without them.



Property set-up. You organise the on-site audit and coordinate the furnishing package if the property is unfurnished. You schedule the handyman, staging team and initial deep clean plus styling. You make sure devices, internet and TV are installed and working, and that the property matches our furnishing and presentation standards.



Services. You source and schedule local suppliers, including cleaners, housekeeping, window cleaning and photographers, and you make sure every new property has a reliable cleaning team in place before the first guest arrives.



Photoshoot and handover to operations. You book and coordinate the professional photoshoot and make sure the property is fully styled, cleaned and camera-ready on the day. In the final stage of each onboarding, you work closely with our operations team, who handle the image editing, listing creation and go-live. You make sure they have everything they need: photos, property details, access information, inventory and supplier contacts. Once that is done, you complete a clean handover so the property moves smoothly from onboarding into live operations.



Daily ownership. You lead the daily onboarding stand-up, keep every property’s progress up to date in Notion, and flag and solve blockers the same day instead of waiting for someone else to.



Who we are looking for



You are confident on the phone. You pick up the phone to call a landlord, a council, a cleaner or a supplier without hesitation, and you handle difficult conversations calmly and clearly.



You take action without being chased. You see what needs to happen next and you do it. When a cleaner cancels, a permit stalls or a supplier doesn’t respond, you find a solution before anyone has to ask.



You make decisions. Within your mandate, you d
 and move forward rather than asking for approval at every step. You know when something truly needs escalating, and you don’t escalate what you can solve yourself.



You are organised and detail-focused. You can run multiple onboardings at once across different states without dropping anything.



Requirements



You have at least 2 years’ experience in property management, short-term rentals, operations or project coordination, ideally working with Australian clients. Your spoken and written English is excellent and you are comfortable on calls all day. You are available full-time during Australian business hours, Monday to Friday. Experience with Airbnb, Guesty, Hostaway, PriceLabs or Notion is a strong plus, and so is knowledge of Australian short-term rental regulations. You need a reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace and a professional headset.



What we offer



This is a full-time, long-term remote position with real ownership and responsibility in a fast-growing company. You get a competitive monthly salary based on experience, plus performance bonuses linked to properties handed over on time. You will work directly with the founder and have room to grow as the portfolio expands.



How to apply



Send your CV together with a 2-minute voice recording or Loom video. In it, explain how you would handle this situation: a property is due for its photoshoot in three days, and the cleaner who was booked for the deep clean has just cancelled. Tell us exactly what you would do, step by step. Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Meta Ads Director
description:
META ADS DIRECTOR (AI-FIRST / ANDROMEDA-ERA)



THE ROLE

- We are hiring a Meta Ads Director to take full ownership of paid social strategy and execution across our client portfolio.

- This is not a traditional media buyer role and it is not a button-pusher role.

- You must understand how Meta Ads work in 2026. That means you understand the shift to an AI-first ad delivery environment where campaign success is driven less by manual audience micromanagement and more by creative strength, creative diversification, signal quality, incrementality, and strategic optimization inside Meta’s evolving ad system.



You should be fluent in how Meta’s current advertising environment has changed campaign planning, testing, and scaling. You should understand the implications of Andromeda, Advantage+ automation, faster AI-driven optimization cycles, stronger ranking systems, and the growing importance of creative as a core targeting and performance lever.



We are looking for someone who knows that:

- Creative is key

- Creative diversification is no longer optional



Winning on Meta in 2026 requires strong strategy, clean signals, and a creative testing system

CPL alone is not success

CAC, qualified pipeline, booked calls, sales, and ROI are what matter



You will work directly with the Founder and alongside a lean, high-performance team that values speed, precision, initiative, and results. We need someone who sees problems early, spots optimization opportunities quickly, and acts before performance declines.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE



The right person for this role:



Understands how to build and scale Meta campaigns in today’s AI-driven environment

Knows how to structure campaigns so Meta’s system has the right inputs to optimize effectively

Treats creative strategy as a primary growth lever, not an afterthought

Can evaluate, analyze, and optimize creative performance across every stage of the funnel

Knows the difference between a weak creative, a fatigued creative, a misaligned offer, and a signal/tracking problem

Makes decisions based on business outcomes, not vanity metrics

Can connect ad performance to lead quality, sales quality, CAC, and ROI

Operates with urgency, ownership, and independent thinking

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy & Campaign Architecture

Own the end-to-end Meta Ads strategy for every client account, from audit and research to campaign architecture, scaling, and performance management.

Build campaign structures that reflect how Meta Ads work in 2026, using automation, broad inputs, strong conversion signals, and creative-led strategy instead of outdated over-segmentation.

Develop full-funnel paid social strategies across prospecting, retargeting, and re-engagement.

Map campaigns to buyer awareness stages and ensure the right message, angle, format, and offer are shown at the right stage of the journey.

Build testing roadmaps for offers, hooks, messaging angles, formats, landing pages, and conversion objectives.

Creative Strategy, Evaluation & Diversification

Lead the creative strategy behind every campaign.

Build and maintain a creative diversification system that includes multiple concepts, hooks, personas, proof mechanisms, formats, visuals, and CTAs.

Continuously evaluate, analyze, and optimize creatives based on performance data, funnel stage, audience response, and conversion quality.

Identify why a creative is underperforming and determine whether the issue is the hook, angle, offer, format, message match, fatigue, or conversion friction.

Work closely with designers, editors, and copywriters to produce creatives that are strategically different, not just visually different.

Ensure a regular cadence of creative testing and refreshes to avoid fatigue and keep campaigns competitive.

Write and direct high-performing ad copy that aligns with the audience’s psychology, awareness stage, and intent level.

Campaign Management & Optimization

Manage day-to-day Meta Ads operations across multiple client accounts.

Monitor campaigns daily and act quickly on leading indicators such as rising CPMs, declining CTR, falling conversion rates, weak lead quality, or frequency issues.

Make strategic optimizations across budget allocation, campaign structure, creative rotation, exclusions, retargeting logic, and offer positioning.

Know when to simplify, consolidate, scale, or cut.

Use performance data to guide creative decisions, not just media-buying decisions.

Tracking, Attribution & Signal Quality

Maintain strong campaign hygiene across naming conventions, UTMs, event prioritization, Pixel, Conversions API, CRM attribution, and reporting systems.

Ensure Meta has the strongest possible data inputs to optimize against.

Diagnose tracking gaps, poor attribution, or weak event quality before they distort decision-making.

Understand how to measure true performance beyond platform-reported numbers.

Reporting & Business Impact

Report on the metrics that actually matter: CAC, qualified lead rate, booked appointment rate, show-up rate, close rate, revenue attribution, and ROI.

Build reports that explain what happened, why it happened, and what actions are being taken next.

Present strategic recommendations clearly and confidently to leadership and, when needed, directly to clients.

Stay focused on profitable scaling, not cosmetic reporting.

AI & Workflow Leverage

Use AI tools as force multipliers for ideation, analysis, copy, research, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Stay current with Meta’s evolving ad environment and AI-driven changes to campaign execution and creative performance.

Use AI to improve speed and quality, while still applying strong strategic judgment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Minimum 4+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience with a proven record of generating leads and revenue for service-based businesses.

Strong understanding of how to succeed running Meta Ads in 2026, including AI-first delivery, creative-led performance, automation, signal quality, and modern attribution.

Clear understanding of Andromeda-era Meta Ads strategy and how current changes affect campaign structure, audience strategy, testing, optimization, and scaling.

Strong belief that creative is key, with the ability to build systems for creative diversification across concepts, formats, messaging angles, and awareness stages.

Strong ability to evaluate, analyze, and optimize creatives for each campaign to improve performance.

Strong copywriting and messaging skills with a track record of writing ad copy that drives real business results.

Deep experience with Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, Events Manager, Pixel, CAPI, Custom Audiences, Lookalikes, and attribution workflows.

Strong analytical ability across Meta reporting, landing page performance, CRM outcomes, and downstream sales data.

Experience managing multiple accounts at once in an agency environment without losing strategic depth or attention to detail.

Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Strong ownership mentality, proactive communication, and ability to execute without constant oversight.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube Ads

Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRMs

Experience with lead nurture systems, SMS/email follow-up, and funnel optimization

Experience with landing page testing and CRO

Meta Blueprint Certification

Experience building reporting dashboards in Looker Studio, DashThis, Hyros, Triple Whale, or similar tools

THE MINDSET WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We are not looking for someone who hides behind dashboards, blames the algorithm, or waits for instructions.



We are looking for someone who:



takes ownership

thinks strategically

moves fast

catches issues early

understands that great Meta performance is now driven by creative quality, creative variation, strong signals, and smart optimization

cares about profitability and client results, not vanity metrics



You should be comfortable in a fast-moving agency environment where expectations are high and performance matters.



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please submit:



Your updated resume/CV

A portfolio or case study deck showing 2–3 Meta lead generation campaigns you managed for service-based businesses

A 3–5 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one campaign you are proud of

Examples of ad copy you have written

A short summary of how you use AI in your workflow

In your Loom video, you must also answer:

How has Meta’s newest ad delivery environment changed the way you build campaigns?

What does creative diversification mean to you in practice?

How do you d
 whether a creative problem is caused by the hook, the offer, fatigue, poor signal quality, or bad funnel alignment?

Why is CAC and ROI more important than CPL when evaluating Meta campaign performance?



Applications without a Loom video, case studies, and direct answers to the questions above will not be considered.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

CTM Prospect Staging





Qualifications

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Freight Logistics Appointment Setter – Remote (Commission Only)
description:
Job Type: Remote | Independent Contractor (subject to applicable laws)



Compensation: 15% Commission | No Hourly Base Pay



Location: Philippines (Work From Home)



Industry: U.S. Freight Brokerage & Logistics



Schedule: Flexible, with availability during U.S. business hours



About the Opportunity



We are looking for motivated, confident, and experienced B2B Cold Callers / Appointment Setters to help us connect with U.S.-based companies that need freight transportation and logistics services.



We work within an established U.S. freight brokerage network, helping businesses explore reliable transportation solutions.



This is a performance-based opportunity for individuals who enjoy prospecting, building business relationships, and generating qualified sales opportunities.



This is a commission-only position with no guaranteed hourly pay. It is best suited for individuals who are comfortable with commission-based income and understand that earnings depend on successfully converted customers.



Key Responsibilities



Make outbound cold calls to U.S. businesses across various industries.



Identify shipping managers, transportation managers, logistics coordinators, and other decision-makers.



Gather accurate contact information, including names,
s, direct phone numbers, and company details.



Ask discovery questions to understand transportation needs, shipping frequency, commodities, equipment requirements, and shipping challenges.



Determine whether prospective customers are open to exploring additional freight transportation providers.



Schedule qualified appointments for our freight specialist.



Immediately forward freight quote requests and relevant shipment details to our team.



Maintain accurate call notes, lead information, and follow-up activities in our CRM.



Follow up with interested prospects when appropriate.



Important: You will not be responsible for negotiating freight rates, providing quotes, booking trucks, or closing sales. Your primary responsibility is generating qualified opportunities.



Compensation Structure



You will earn 15% of our agency representative's earned commission from qualifying shipments generated by customers you successfully refer.



How it works:



You identify and qualify a new potential shipping customer.



You document their shipping needs and schedule an appointment or submit a qualified opportunity.



Our freight specialist handles quoting, negotiations, and closing.



When the customer begins shipping with us, you earn commission on qualifying shipments.



Your commission eligibility continues for six months from the customer's first completed shipment.



Commissions are paid after the brokerage collects payment and releases the applicable earned commission.



Example:



If a customer you refer generates $1,000 in brokerage gross profit, our representative's commission is $600. Your 15% share would be $90.



You can earn commissions from multiple qualifying customers during their respective six-month eligibility periods.



There is no guaranteed income, and the number or value of shipments cannot be guaranteed. Specific lead-attribution, payment, and post-termination terms will be provided in the written agreement.



Qualifications



Previous B2B cold-calling, telemarketing, appointment-setting, or lead generation experience.



Strong spoken and written English communication skills.



Confidence speaking with U.S.-based business decision-makers.



Ability to ask discovery questions and recognize potential sales opportunities.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, and communication tools.



Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.



Self-motivated, consistent, and comfortable working independently.



Preferred but Not Required:



Experience in freight brokerage, trucking, logistics, or supply chain services.



Experience calling U.S. manufacturers, distributors, warehouses, or industrial businesses.



Familiarity with freight terminology such as FTL, LTL, dry van, reefer, and flatbed.



Experience using CRM or outbound calling software.



What We Provide



Guidance on our freight brokerage services.



Cold-calling scripts and discovery questions.



Defined lead qualification criteria.



Lead tracking and reporting procedures.



Support with prospects requiring quotes or additional information.



A transparent commission tracking process.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



A brief introduction about yourself.



Your previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.



The industries or types of businesses you have called.



A short voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a U.S. business.



Your availability during U.S. business hours.



Confirmation that you understand and are interested in a commission-only opportunity with no guaranteed hourly compensation.



We are looking for serious, reliable individuals interested in building long-term business relationships and earning commissions based on results.

title: Luxury Real Estate Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist Closer - AI work 90% of time , you 10%
description:
We’re launching a real estate wholesaling business focused on houses, teardown opportunities, and land suited to luxury residential development.



Our software is about **90% complete**. The AI researches properties, identifies possible developer matches, drafts messages, and supports negotiation and closing. We’re looking for an experienced real estate professional to review its work, catch mistakes, assess whether opportunities are worthwhile, and help move strong deals forward.



## First month



The first month is a paid trial at a fixed rate of **$300 for the month**, plus any earned bonuses. This rate is not negotiable. The position is part-time, with a flexible schedule of **up to 15 hours per week** during the first month. We’ll agree on a schedule in advance.



If you close a high-value deal during your first month, you’ll receive a significant increase in your base pay during that month.



## Responsibilities



- Review AI research and suggested buyer matches for accuracy.

- Confirm that a property fits a developer’s criteria, including location, property type, lot size, budget, and timeline.

- Assess whether an opportunity is worth pursuing using comparable sales and potential assignment-fee calculations.

- Catch errors or gaps in the AI’s research, messages, negotiation support, or closing steps.

- Build developer relationships and keep their buying criteria current.

- Work with the AI to communicate and negotiate with sellers and buyers.

- Help coordinate promising deals through contracts, title or escrow, and closing.

- Keep deal information and next steps organized, and suggest improvements to the software and process.



## Compensation and bonuses



The first-month base pay is **$300 for the month**. Closing bonuses range from **$100 to $1,000**, depending on the deal.



Additional bonuses:



- **$500 first-closing bonus** if your first qualifying deal closes and the company receives its assignment fee within your first 60 calendar days.

- **$700 first-month bonus** if a qualifying deal you helped close during your first month brings the company an assignment fee of approximately $80,000 or more.

- **$1,000 monthly bonus** if you complete four or more qualifying closings in one calendar month. This is an incentive, not a quota.



Bonuses may be combined. A qualifying deal is one you meaningfully help manage. Deal ownership and any shared bonus arrangements will be agreed in advance. Bonuses are paid after the company receives cleared assignment-fee funds; a signed contract alone does not count as a closing.



### First-month earnings examples



- No closed deals: **$300 base pay**.

- One deal with a $40,000 assignment fee: $300 base + a closing bonus of $100–$1,000 = **$400–$1,300**.

- First qualifying deal closes in month one with an assignment fee of approximately $100,000 or more: $300 base + a closing bonus of $100–$1,000 + $500 first-closing bonus + $700 first-month bonus = **$1,600–$2,500**.



These examples do not include the significant base-pay increase that may apply after closing a high-value deal during the first month.



## Experience we’re looking for



- U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispositions experience.

- Seller negotiation experience and involvement in completed deals.

- Ability to review comparable sales, buyer fit, and assignment-fee assumptions.

- Strong English, reliable follow-up, and good organization.

- Comfortable sharing your judgment and feedback.

- A computer, reliable internet, and a quiet space for calls.



Experience with developers, land, teardown properties, or luxury markets is a plus. Cold calling or appointment-setting experience alone isn’t enough for this role.



## First-month focus



Learn the selected market, review and verify AI-generated research and matches, build developer relationships, and help negotiate and advance promising opportunities. We’ll focus on sound judgment, accurate reviews, follow-through, and pipeline progress.



## Questions for applicants



Please include answers to these questions with your application:



1. How many real estate deals have you personally helped close, and how many did you typically close in a month?

2. What was your role in those transactions, from finding or evaluating the property through negotiation and closing?

3. What types of properties and markets have you worked in? Have you worked with luxury properties, land, teardowns, or developers?

4. What was the largest assignment fee or deal value you handled, and what was your specific contribution?

5. How do you evaluate whether a property is a good deal and a genuine match for a buyer?

6. Tell us about a challenging negotiation. How did you handle it, and what was the outcome?

7. Which real estate tools or software have you used?

8. How would you review AI-generated property research, buyer matches, and outreach messages to catch mistakes before they affect a deal?

9. Are you comfortable with a fixed first-month base of $300, up to 15 hours per week, and the bonuses described above?

10. What hours are you available, and which U.S. markets or time zones can you support?

Orders, payments, inventory, production, and shipments stay accurate and on schedule. Records remain organized, communication is consistent, and potential problems are resolved early.

title: Virtual Assistant – Business Operations & Startup Support
description:
Virtual Assistant – Operations, Marketing & Partnerships

.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant

Who we're looking for:

- You have hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, store updates, theme edits, and order management

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You're highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You're hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You're fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Experience with WooCommerce, Amazon, or TikTok Shop

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Beyond Shopify, experience isn't everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the other platforms and tools, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: up to ₱5,000, based on performance

- ₱1,500 signing bonus after completing the probationary period

- Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn't for everyone

We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you're after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A screenshot of your internet speed test

- Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

- A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience (especially your Shopify work), and telling us why you're the right person for this role



Important: Put "ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)" in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We're looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you're disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.
