title: Team Lead Support
description:
### About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven **Team Lead Support** professional to join our internal operations team.



The ideal candidate must have **at least 3 years of experience as a Team Leader**, with a strong background in coaching, performance management, team engagement, and operational support.



This is a fast-paced role that requires someone who can work effectively with different teams, manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to changes, and take ownership without constant supervision.



We are not looking for someone who simply monitors attendance, tracks tasks, or waits for problems to happen. We need someone who can lead, coach, identify issues early, build relationships, and drive continuous improvement.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

- Monitor Remote Professional (RP) performance, productivity, attendance, responsiveness, and work quality.

- Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions and performance check-ins.

- Identify performance gaps and provide actionable feedback.

- Develop, implement, and monitor performance improvement plans.

- Address performance concerns proactively before they escalate.

- Reinforce accountability, professionalism, and client expectations.

- Document coaching sessions, improvement plans, and follow-up actions.



**2. Coaching & Team Development**

- Provide consistent coaching to improve communication, productivity, problem-solving, and overall performance.

- Identify individual strengths and development opportunities.

- Help team members build confidence, independence, and accountability.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally and constructively.

- Encourage teamwork, knowledge-sharing, and continuous learning.

- Support team members in achieving both individual and team goals.



**3. Team Collaboration & Engagement**

- Work closely with operations, training, recruitment, and client success teams.

- Build strong relationships with team members while maintaining clear performance expectations.

- Promote a positive, collaborative, and accountable work environment.

- Encourage open communication and teamwork.

- Support cross-functional initiatives and operational improvements.

- Be willing to step in and help the team when needed.



**4. Client Satisfaction & Issue Resolution**

- Identify early warning signs of performance concerns or potential client dissatisfaction.

- Support the resolution of RP-related concerns and escalations.

- Coach team members on proactive client communication, responsiveness, and relationship-building.

- Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

- Follow through on corrective actions and monitor results.

- Help improve client satisfaction, RP retention, and service quality.



**5. Operational Support & Reporting**

- Maintain accurate performance records, coaching documentation, and action trackers.

- Prepare performance reports and management updates.

- Monitor outstanding issues and ensure timely resolution.

- Manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.

- Adapt quickly to shifting operational priorities and business needs.



### Required Qualifications



- **Minimum of 3 years of proven experience as a Team Leader or Team Lead.**

- **Strong hands-on experience in coaching, performance management, and people development.**

- Proven ability to work effectively in a **fast-paced, high-pressure environment**.

- Strong team player who can collaborate with different departments and personalities.

- Experience conducting one-on-one coaching, performance reviews, and corrective action discussions.

- Experience managing underperforming team members and implementing improvement plans.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and decision-making abilities.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of handling multiple priorities.

- Ability to work independently while remaining collaborative and accountable.

- Proactive mindset with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Experience working with remote teams and US-based clients is an advantage.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets, and other productivity tools.

- Willing to work full-time during US business hours.



### Preferred Experience



- BPO Team Leader or Operations Team Leader background.

- Experience in remote staffing, outsourcing, customer success, or service delivery.

- Experience handling client escalations and employee retention concerns.

- Background in quality assurance, coaching, or performance improvement.

- Familiarity with Hubstaff, CRM systems, and task-management tools.

- Experience creating SOPs and tracking team KPIs.



### What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



- **Is a team player:** Works well with others, supports teammates, and understands that success is a team effort.

- **Thrives in a fast-paced environment:** Can handle pressure, shifting priorities, and multiple responsibilities without losing focus.

- **Knows how to coach:** Has actual experience developing people, correcting behaviors, and improving performance.

- **Takes ownership:** Doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done.

- **Is proactive:** Identifies potential issues before they become bigger problems.

- **Can lead with accountability:** Builds good relationships while maintaining high standards.

- **Communicates effectively:** Can handle sensitive conversations and provide clear, constructive feedback.

- **Is adaptable:** Comfortable with changes, new processes, and evolving business needs.

- **Is solutions-oriented:** Doesn't just report problems but actively works toward resolving them.



### How Success Will Be Measured



- Consistent completion of coaching sessions and performance check-ins.

- Measurable improvements in RP performance.

- Timely identification and resolution of performance issues.

- Reduced preventable escalations and attrition.

- Improved team engagement and collaboration.

- Strong client satisfaction and service quality.

- Accurate reporting, documentation, and follow-through.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your **Team Leader experience (minimum 3 years)**.

2. A brief introduction describing your coaching and people-management experience.

3. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

4. Your earliest available start date.



**Please answer the following questions:**



**1.** Tell us about a time you coached an underperforming team member. What was the issue, what actions did you take, and what was the outcome?



**2.** How do you manage competing priorities while supporting multiple team members in a fast-paced environment?



**3.** One of your team members consistently completes assigned tasks, but the client is unhappy because of poor communication. How would you address this?



**4.** How do you maintain good relationships with your team while ensuring accountability and performance standards?



**We are looking for a hands-on leader, not just someone with a Team Leader title.** Someone who can coach, collaborate, adapt quickly, handle challenges, and genuinely contribute to the success of the entire team.



If you have the experience, leadership mindset, and passion for developing people, we encourage you to apply.

Are you a detail-oriented mortgage professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We are seeking an exceptional Mortgage Loan Processing Virtual Assistant to serve as a key driver in our daily mortgage operations.



In this dynamic role, you will work directly with our Loan Officer/Mortgage Broker to manage the loan pipeline, run detailed pricing scenarios, streamline client communication, and ensure that loan files move smoothly from initial pre-approval to final clear-to-close. While licensed activities and complex underwriting remain under the direct supervision of the Loan Officer, you will serve as the engine behind our operational efficiency.



This position is designed for someone who wants more than just a task-based admin job. We are looking for a professional who wants to build a long-term career, take ownership of processes, and scale into full-cycle loan processing as our volume grows.



What You Will Be Doing



Your day-to-day responsibilities will touch every critical stage of the mortgage lifecycle:



1. Client Onboarding & Pre-Approval Support



You will guide clients smoothly through the initial stages of the mortgage application. This involves gathering and organizing essential financial documents—such as income verification, tax returns, and credit reports—and conducting initial completeness reviews. You will run various loan scenarios to project loan amounts, monthly payments, and potential interest rate structures, giving the Loan Officer clear data to evaluate basic qualification parameters.



2. Structuring Loans & Comparative Analysis



Finding the right solution for every borrower is core to what we do. You will collect all required paperwork to draft Loan Estimates (LEs), pricing models, and side-by-side cloned scenario estimates. By evaluating guidelines across different lender portals, you will compare interest rates, loan terms, and program specifics to present comprehensive closing cost estimates and tailored program options for client review.



3. Pipeline Management & Closing Coordination



Once a file is ready, you will prepare and submit the complete package into lender portals and meticulously track its journey. You will act as a proactive bridge between underwriters, lenders, and clients—obtaining conditional approvals, clarifying specific underwriting requests, gathering missing conditions, and keeping the CRM continuously updated. Your persistent follow-up ensures every file advances smoothly toward the final Clear-to-Close (CTC) and closing disclosures.



4. Operational & Administrative Excellence



Beyond loan-specific tasks, you will help maintain the health of our business system. This includes managing daily task workflows inside our CRM, handling
 communications, logging client contacts, and generating daily activity and productivity tracking reports. Your meticulous organizational habits ensure no detail or follow-up ever slips through the cracks.



Career Development Path



We believe in rewarding performance with growth. You will begin by mastering essential support operations—such as pricing scenarios, basic document intake, file organization, and initial Loan Estimates. As you demonstrate consistency, accuracy, and strong system mastery, your role will expand into full-scale loan processing, direct condition management, and complete operational ownership over our active loan pipeline.



What We Are Looking For



To succeed in this role, you should possess a solid background in mortgage processing, lending support, or real estate finance.



Core Qualifications



Mortgage Experience: Prior hands-on experience in mortgage processing, loan coordination, or residential lending operations.



Mortgage Fluency: A clear understanding of Loan Estimates (LEs), closing disclosures, mortgage pricing concepts, loan structuring, and standard underwriting workflows.



Tech Proficiency: Hands-on experience working with mortgage CRMs, lender portals, document management tools, and digital communication channels.



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with clients and lender representatives.



Time Zone Alignment: Full availability to work dedicated business hours within the Eastern Standard Time (EST) zone.



Ideal Mindset & Attributes



Meticulous Precision: You take pride in high-level accuracy; you double-check calculations and review documents thoroughly before submission.



Proactive Problem Solving: Rather than waiting for instructions when a challenge arises, you actively seek solutions and keep the pipeline moving.



Process-Driven: You excel in structured environments, thrive on managing checklists, and enjoy creating smooth operational workflows.



Growth Mindset: You are coachable, open to constructive feedback, and eager to expand your mortgage knowledge.



How to Apply



If you are a high-performing mortgage professional ready to take on an impactful remote position, we would love to hear from you.



Please submit the following items to apply:



Your updated CV / Resume highlighting your relevant mortgage experience.



A short Intro Video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself, your background in the mortgage industry, and why you are a great fit for this role.



Your active WhatsApp Phone Number (including country code) so our team can reach out directly.



We review applications on a rolling basis and will contact qualified candidates directly via WhatsApp to schedule an initial interview.

# E-commerce Marketing Manager | Meta Ads, Creative Strategy & Brand Growth



**Salary: $200 USD/month | Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity**



### About Us



We are a growing international business building and scaling multiple e-commerce brands.



We are looking for a highly skilled, experienced, and results-driven **E-commerce Marketing Manager** to take ownership of our marketing operations across our brands.



**We are NOT looking for someone who simply launches ads.**



We want a strategic thinker, a creative problem-solver, and a marketing professional who understands how to turn products into profitable brands.



You will work alongside our wider team, including designers, video editors, content creators, developers, and management.



Our goal is to build a powerful, long-term marketing operation, and we want someone who can grow with us.



### Key Responsibilities



- **Paid Advertising:** Plan, launch, manage, test, and optimize Meta Ads campaigns across our e-commerce brands.

- **Marketing Strategy:** Develop effective marketing strategies focused on sales, profitability, and sustainable growth.

- **Creative Strategy:** Research winning ad concepts, develop hooks, write advertising copy, and coordinate with our creative team to produce high-converting content.

- **Market & Competitor Research:** Analyze competitors, customer behavior, product demand, market trends, and advertising opportunities.

- **Performance Optimization:** Monitor ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates, and other important performance metrics.

- **Creative Testing:** Continuously test different creatives, audiences, offers, and marketing angles.

- **Brand Development:** Help position our products as trustworthy, professional, and competitive international brands.

- **Team Collaboration:** Work closely with our content creators, designers, editors, and developers to execute marketing strategies.

- **Reporting:** Provide clear performance reports, identify problems, and recommend practical solutions.



### Who We're Looking For



**Experience and proven results are essential.**



Our ideal candidate:



- Has proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising for e-commerce brands.

- Has previously worked with successful e-commerce businesses or personally managed or owned an online brand.

- Understands Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, conversion optimization, and e-commerce sales funnels.

- Can demonstrate actual campaign results, not just theoretical knowledge.

- Understands how to create and direct effective advertising content.

- Has strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.

- Thinks outside the box and proactively brings new ideas.

- Takes ownership, communicates professionally, and meets deadlines.

- Can work independently while collaborating with a larger international team.

- Is genuinely passionate about marketing, branding, and business growth.



**Experience owning or scaling your own e-commerce brand is a major advantage.**



### What Makes This Opportunity Different?



You won't be working alone or handling every part of the business yourself.



You will be part of a growing operation with access to a wider creative and operational team.



We want you to focus on what matters most: **strategy, creative direction, campaign performance, testing, and growth.**



We value people who challenge ideas, identify opportunities, think creatively, and bring solutions rather than waiting for instructions.



This is an opportunity to become a long-term part of our business, contribute to multiple brands, and grow professionally as the operation expands.



### Compensation & Work Structure



- Starting compensation: **$200 USD per month**

- Part-time remote position, approximately 20 hours per week

- Responsible for coordinating and managing marketing campaigns across our e-commerce brands

- Flexible schedule with clear deliverables and consistent communication

- Long-term collaboration opportunity

- Potential for compensation increases based on performance, responsibilities, and business growth

title: Bank Reconciliation & Reporting Specialist – Legacy ERP Systems (Remote/Outsourced)
description:
# Bank Reconciliation & Reporting Specialist



**Remote | Outsourced Position | U.S.-Based Clients**



### Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced Bank Reconciliation & Reporting Specialist to support our U.S.-based clients. This position will focus heavily on bank and credit card reconciliations, preparing reports, and maintaining Excel spreadsheets, with some additional bookkeeping and accounts payable responsibilities as needed.



The ideal candidate has a strong bookkeeping background, excellent Excel skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures while working with multiple clients and accounting systems.



Experience with RFMS or other legacy ERP systems is strongly preferred. Familiarity with AI-assisted reconciliation tools is also beneficial.



### Key Responsibilities



**Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations**



- Reconcile bank and credit card statements to transactions recorded in client ERP systems.

- Research missing, duplicated, incorrectly posted, and outstanding transactions.

- Review checks, deposits, transfers, bank charges, and other unreconciled activity.

- Identify discrepancies and communicate unresolved items.

- Use approved AI tools to identify possible individual and grouped transaction matches.

- Carefully review and verify all AI-generated matches.

- Maintain reconciliation worksheets and supporting documentation.



**Reporting & Spreadsheet Management**



- Pull financial and operational reports from client ERP systems following established procedures.

- Enter, organize, and update report data in Excel spreadsheets and standardized templates.

- Compare data across multiple reports to identify discrepancies or missing information.

- Review spreadsheets for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

- Maintain recurring reports and tracking spreadsheets according to established schedules.

- Ensure reports are completed accurately and submitted by required deadlines.



**Bookkeeping & Accounts Payable Support**



- Post approved deposits, bank charges, transfers, journal entries, and other basic bookkeeping transactions.

- Assist with accounts payable invoice entry and processing as needed.

- Verify invoice details and accurately enter vendor invoices into client ERP systems.

- Research and correct transaction discrepancies as instructed.



**Workflow & Communication**



- Communicate with internal team members and clients to obtain missing information or resolve questions.

- Follow established SOPs, checklists, and client-specific instructions.

- Update workflow records in Financial Cents and maintain client-facing spreadsheets.

- Manage multiple client assignments while meeting established deadlines.

- Access client systems using remote tools such as RDP, NinjaOne, ScreenConnect, and GoTo.



### Qualifications



- Previous bank reconciliation experience is required.

- Bookkeeping or general accounting experience is required.

- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, sorting, filtering, and working with large datasets.

- Experience preparing reports and maintaining spreadsheets.

- Basic accounts payable processing and invoice entry experience is preferred.

- Strong understanding of debits, credits, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, outstanding checks, and timing differences.

- Experience with legacy ERP or accounting systems is strongly preferred.

- RFMS experience is highly preferred.

- Exposure to AI-assisted bank reconciliation or financial analysis tools is preferred.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Ability to follow detailed written procedures and work independently.

- Willingness to ask questions and communicate knowledge gaps promptly.



### Training & Expectations



Structured training, written SOPs, and ongoing support will be provided. Accuracy, consistency, and the ability to follow established procedures are essential.



Only approved AI tools may be used, and all AI-generated results must be independently reviewed for accuracy.



### Position Details



This is a remote, outsourced position supporting multiple U.S.-based clients. Specific hours, compensation, and client assignments will be discussed during the interview process.

Role Overview	

We are looking for a highly organized, self-driven Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager to run our day-to-day financial workflows for our Print-on-Demand business. In this role, you will own our transactional data and independently execute the vast majority of our month-end closing process in QuickBooks Online (plus the company’s proprietary inventory management software) so that it is nearly complete before being handed off to our Controller.

Additionally, you will act as the accounting and tax team's central traffic controller — managing our offshore Accounts Payable function, staying ahead of every tax deadline (you own the deadlines; the tax preparers own the tax expertise), and taking full ownership of processing company mail. You will report directly to our CFO with a dotted line to the Company’s owners. 



Schedule & Location

*Location: 100% Remote.

*First 6 Months: You must work California time (Pacific Standard Time) from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a 1-hour break so you can communicate live with the US team.

*After 6 Months: Upon a successful performance review, you have the flexibility to shift your schedule to a split-shift model: 7:00 AM–10:00 AM and 5:00 PM–10:00 PM PST.



Key Responsibilities

-Own the Monthly Close: Independently manage the month-end closing process within QuickBooks Online (reconciling accounts, verifying balances, and prepping data). You should be able to get the books 90% of the way there before handing them to the outsourced Controller for final review.

-Manage Operational Workflows: Direct, coordinate, and review the daily work of three internal, offshore Accounts Payable (AP) accountants to ensure transactions are accurate, coded correctly, and completed on time.

-Proactive Deadline Tracking: Build and maintain an airtight schedule for all local, state, and federal tax deadlines as well as bank covenant requirements. You must be highly proactive to ensure the company never faces a late filing or penalty.

-Mail Operations: Actively manage, sort, and process all incoming digital mail that is sent to you related to compliance, taxes, and vendor billing.

-Leadership Collaboration: Act as the main operational contact for our fractional CFO and outsourced Controller, providing them with clean, reliable data and accurate draft reports.

-Bookkeeping duties. Ensure all cash activities are posted to the appropriate activities on a weekly basis with a full reconciliation on a monthly basis back to bank statements

s, and providing direct feedback or instructions to your offshore team members.

title: TikTok Shop & Affiliate Manager
description:
BY FAY | Remote



BY FAY is a Netherlands-based beauty brand and professional nail supplier. We are looking for an experienced TikTok Shop specialist who can build our shop from scratch, prepare it for launch and develop a network of creators who generate sales.



We do not currently have a TikTok Shop. You will be responsible for the complete process: account setup, Shopify integration, product listings, creator recruitment, affiliate management and ongoing performance.



We need someone who has done this before and can work independently.



About the first launch



Our upcoming collection includes:



* 18 handmade Nail Jewel styles.

* 100 pieces per style.

* Prices ranging from €9.95 to €14.95 excluding VAT.

* Easy application and a time-saving benefit for nail professionals.

* A premium finishing detail that creates opportunities for demonstrations, styling videos and creator collaborations.



This collection will be the starting point for developing TikTok Shop as a sales channel for BY FAY.



Your responsibilities



1. Complete TikTok Shop setup



Take ownership of setting up a functioning shop that is ready to accept and fulfil orders.



This includes:



* Checking seller eligibility and the requirements for our market.

* Providing one clear checklist of the business documents and information needed.

* Managing the setup and verification process, coordinating with us where owner action is required.

* Configuring seller information, payment details, shipping, returns and customer-service settings.

* Setting up the shop’s branding and connecting the appropriate TikTok account.

* Resolving onboarding issues and communicating any blockers promptly.

* Testing the customer journey and operational setup before launch.



2. Shopify integration and order management



Our existing webshop runs on Shopify. You will be responsible for establishing and testing the appropriate connection between Shopify and TikTok Shop.



Your work should cover:



* Product and variant mapping.

* Accurate inventory synchronisation.

* Correct prices and product information.

* Order transfer and fulfilment workflows.

* Shipping and tracking updates.

* Identifying and resolving synchronisation errors.

* Clear instructions for the team on handling TikTok Shop orders.



With limited quantities per style, accurate stock management is essential.



3. Product listings and merchandising



Create complete, professional product listings that reflect the BY FAY brand and help customers make purchasing decisions.



This includes:



* Product titles, descriptions, categories and attributes.

* Correct prices, quantities and variations.

* Clear information on what each purchase includes.

* Product images, application visuals and video requirements.

* Application and care information based on verified product instructions.

* Selecting suitable products to feature during the launch.

* Recommending bundles where commercially appropriate.

* Resolving listing issues and monitoring product approval status.



You will coordinate with our content team for assets and provide clear briefs when additional material is needed.



4. Creator research and recruitment



Build a relevant creator network for the launch and future campaigns.



You will:



* Find nail, beauty and manicure creators whose audiences match our customers.

* Assess content quality, audience relevance, engagement and available sales performance.

* Prioritise creators who can demonstrate the product clearly and credibly.

* Conduct personalised outreach and manage follow-ups.

* Negotiate collaboration terms within agreed budgets and commission limits.

* Coordinate samples, delivery details and publishing timelines.

* Maintain an organised creator pipeline with contact details, status and next actions.



We expect active recruitment and relationship management, not simply a spreadsheet of creator names.



5. Affiliate programme management



Set up and manage the affiliate programme from recruitment through performance review.



Responsibilities include:



* Recommending commission structures based on our margins.

* Setting up appropriate creator collaborations.

* Managing product samples within an agreed budget.

* Preparing clear briefs covering product benefits, demonstrations and calls to action.

* Following up on sample receipt, content creation and publication.

* Tracking which creators publish and which generate sales.

* Building longer-term relationships with effective creators.

* Recommending improvements or ending ineffective collaborations.



Samples, fees and commissions must be tracked so we understand the cost and value of each partnership.



6. Launch and content coordination



Develop a practical TikTok Shop launch plan that works alongside our wider BY FAY campaign.



You will:



* Plan the shop launch around our Inner Circle early-access schedule.

* Coordinate product availability, creator content and launch communications.

* Brief our content team on videos needed for the shop.

* Develop concepts for application demonstrations, before-and-after videos, styling and product close-ups.

* Coordinate shoppable content and assess whether LIVE shopping is appropriate.

* Identify content worth testing further.

* Recommend paid promotion where justified, with approval before spending.



Our team can support content production. You must provide the commercial direction, clear briefs and follow-through.



7. Reporting and optimisation



Provide a concise weekly report showing what has been completed, what is working and what needs to change.



Track relevant metrics such as:



* Shop sales and orders.

* Product performance.

* Product clicks and conversion.

* Average order value.

* Creators contacted, responses and confirmed collaborations.

* Samples sent and content published.

* Sales generated by individual creators.

* Affiliate commissions and other campaign costs.

* Cancellations, returns and operational issues.

* Profitability based on available cost data.



Success will be assessed on execution, sales and profitability—not views or follower growth alone.



What we expect in your first month

Week 3 — Creator activation and launch preparation

* Coordinate samples, briefs and publishing schedules.

* Complete shop checks and resolve outstanding issues.

Week 4 — Launch and optimisation



* Launch once the shop is approved and operationally ready.

* Coordinate creator content and monitor orders.

* Resolve issues quickly.

* Report initial results and propose the next growth priorities.



This is an indicative timeline. In your application, explain what is realistic based on your experience, including platform approval times and other dependencies.



Required experience



You must have:



* Direct experience setting up and managing TikTok Shops.

* Practical experience recruiting and managing affiliate creators.

* Evidence of previous shop or campaign results.

* Experience with ecommerce operations and Shopify integrations.

* An understanding of commissions, product margins and campaign profitability.

* Strong written communication and creator outreach skills.

* The ability to manage the project independently and keep accurate records.



Experience with TikTok Shop in the Netherlands or other EU markets is strongly preferred. Beauty, nail or cosmetics experience is an advantage.



How you should work



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes initiative and researches solutions independently.

* Gives clear recommendations rather than waiting for instructions at every step.

* Communicates blockers early and proposes solutions.

* Works to agreed deadlines and follows up consistently.

* Collaborates effectively with our content and ecommerce team.

* Keeps accounts, creator records and campaign information organised and accessible to BY FAY.

* Obtains approval before committing to advertising spend, paid collaborations or unagreed costs.



How to apply



Please include:



1. Relevant TikTok Shop experience: which shops you worked on, the markets involved and your exact responsibilities.

2. Setup examples: explain a shop you built from scratch and the main challenges you resolved.

3. Creator recruitment experience: how you find, approach and activate suitable affiliates.

4. Results: provide examples with a timeframe and explain whether sales came from organic content, affiliates, LIVE shopping or paid advertising.

5. Supporting evidence: shop links, case studies or screenshots, with confidential information removed where necessary.

6. Your first-month plan: how you would approach the BY FAY setup and creator recruitment.

7. Availability and rate: your start date, weekly availability and proposed pricing, distinguishing setup work from ongoing management.



Please do not apply if you have no direct TikTok Shop and affiliate creator experience. General social media management, content creation or personal TikTok use alone does not qualify you for this role. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate relevant work and take ownership from day one.

title: AI Avatar & Video Content Specialist for CLINIQ by Fay
description:
BOUT US



CLINIQ by Fay is a medical and aesthetic clinic based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We are looking for an experienced AI Avatar & Video Content Specialist to create a realistic digital version of our founder and owner, Fay, and turn it into a consistent source of high-quality video content.



We want Fay to remain the recognisable face of the clinic, sharing our approach, introducing our services and answering common questions without needing to film every video herself.



This role covers the complete production process: creating the avatar and voice, developing scripts, generating footage and delivering fully edited videos.



THE VISION



We will share a reference video showing the presentation style we want: a confident presenter speaking directly to the camera, natural facial expressions, different camera angles, professional lighting, clear subtitles and engaging editing.



Your task is to achieve a similar level of presentation using Fay’s own appearance and voice, adapted to CLINIQ by Fay’s identity.



The videos should feel personal, warm and credible. Realistic facial movement, natural speech and consistent likeness are essential.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



1. Creating Fay’s AI avatar



• Advise us on the photos, video recordings and voice samples required.

• Provide clear recording instructions and guide Fay through the initial setup.

• Create an avatar that closely reflects her actual face, proportions, expressions and mannerisms.

• Maintain a consistent appearance across videos, including different outfits, settings and camera angles.

• Refine the avatar based on feedback before moving into ongoing production.

• Check for unnatural expressions, distorted hands, inconsistent features and other visible generation errors.



2. Voice creation and Dutch-language quality



• Create an authorised AI version of Fay’s voice using recordings she provides.

• Preserve her recognisable tone, warmth and speaking style.

• Produce natural Dutch speech with accurate pronunciation, pacing and emphasis.

• Check pronunciation of our brand name and treatment terminology.

• Support English versions when required.

• Ensure accurate lip-sync and avoid robotic delivery or unnatural pauses.



3. Content development and scripting



• Turn our ideas, campaign briefs and frequently asked questions into clear video scripts.

• Propose topics and formats proactively.

• Write strong openings that capture attention quickly.

• Structure videos so they are easy to follow and keep viewers engaged.

• Adapt scripts to different lengths and platforms.

• Include relevant calls to action, such as booking a consultation or learning more about a service.

• Submit scripts for approval before generating the final videos.



Fay should always be presented accurately as the founder and owner of CLINIQ by Fay. Medical information and treatment-related claims must be reviewed by our clinical team. The avatar should never imply qualifications she does not hold or present invented personal treatment experiences.



4. Video production and editing



• Produce complete videos using the approved avatar, voice and scripts.

• Create visual variety through suitable framing, camera angles, backgrounds and supporting footage.

• Add accurate subtitles, on-screen text, branding, music and supporting visuals where appropriate.

• Keep subtitles readable and positioned correctly for each platform.

• Deliver polished vertical videos for Instagram Reels, Stories, TikTok and Meta ads.

• Create alternative hooks, shorter edits and different calls to action for testing.

• Review each video for visual consistency, audio quality, spelling and timing before delivery.



5. Collaboration with our social media team



We already have a social media team that can supply images, brand assets and available clinic footage.



You will work closely with them to:



• Request the specific assets you need, with clear briefs and deadlines.

• Align video topics with our content calendar and campaigns.

• Maintain a consistent brand identity across our social channels.

• Deliver organised, clearly labelled files ready for publishing.

• Use performance feedback to improve future videos.



You will own the AI video production process and be expected to work independently, manage deadlines and suggest solutions.



EXAMPLES OF CONTENT



• A welcome message from Fay introducing the clinic.

• “What can you expect from your first consultation?”

• Answers to common questions about our services.

• Educational videos using information approved by our clinical team.

• Founder messages explaining our values and approach.

• Short videos addressing questions that prevent potential clients from booking.

• Campaign videos with a clear invitation to schedule a consultation.

• Longer explanations that can be repurposed into shorter clips.



THE EXPERIENCE WE NEED



• A portfolio of realistic AI avatars based on actual people.

• Demonstrable experience with voice cloning and accurate lip-sync.

• Strong skills in video editing, pacing and visual storytelling.

• The ability to preserve one person’s identity across multiple scenes and videos.

• Experience producing natural Dutch-language content, or a reliable process for Dutch-language quality checks.

• An understanding of social media engagement, retention and conversion.

• A polished visual style suited to a premium clinic.

• Clear communication, attention to detail and reliable delivery.



Experience with beauty, skincare, wellness or medical aesthetics brands is a plus.



Please explain which tools you would use and why they suit this project. We care about the quality and consistency of the final result, as well as a practical production workflow.



INITIAL PROJECT AND ONGOING WORK



The first stage will include:



• Reviewing our reference video and brand assets.

• Agreeing on the creative direction and recording requirements.

• Creating and refining Fay’s avatar and voice.

• Producing one pilot video for approval.

• Establishing a repeatable workflow for future videos.



After the pilot is approved, we would like to move into regular video production. Monthly volume and turnaround times will be agreed based on your production capacity and the approved quality standard.



OWNERSHIP AND ACCESS



The avatar and voice will be created with Fay’s explicit consent and used only for approved purposes.



Please explain how you will handle account access, recordings, editable project files and handover. We require a setup that allows CLINIQ by Fay to retain access to its assets and continue using the agreed workflow. Any licensing restrictions or recurring software costs must be disclosed upfront.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking to build a long-term working relationship. As the collaboration develops and the content delivers results, there may be opportunities for increased production volume, broader responsibilities and growth in compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Two or three relevant AI avatar videos you personally created, with a brief explanation of your role.

2. An example showing the same avatar across different scenes or camera angles.

3. Details of your experience with Dutch-language voice generation and quality control.

4. Your recommended approach, tools and production workflow.

5. What you would need from Fay to create a high-quality avatar and voice.

6. Your estimated timeline for the setup and first pilot video.

7. Your pricing for avatar and voice setup, the pilot video and ongoing production.

8. Any additional software, subscription or usage costs.

9. Your availability, typical turnaround time and revision terms.



Please begin your application with “CLINIQ AI Avatar” and briefly explain how you would make Fay’s digital presence feel natural, recognisable and consistent.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist | Content, Email & Social Media
description:
Company: Wise Agent

Location: Remote, Philippines

Type of Work: Full Time

Pay: 8–11 USD per hour, depending on skills and experience

Hours: 40 paid hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time, including a 30-minute unpaid meal break



ABOUT WISE AGENT

Wise Agent is an established U.S.-based real estate CRM company headquartered in Fountain Hills, Arizona. We help real estate agents and brokers stay organized, automate follow-up, build stronger relationships, and close more deals.

Our platform combines contact management, marketing automation,
, texting, transaction tools, websites, and other business tools, backed by personalized onboarding and 24/7 support.

We have a collaborative team in the United States and the Philippines. We value initiative, clear communication, attention to detail, and people who take responsibility for completing their work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on marketing professional to take ownership of our daily marketing execution.

You will write and publish content, build
 campaigns, maintain our marketing calendar, coordinate podcast promotions, engage with our online community, and use performance data to improve results.

We have established processes, a custom content approval and scheduling system, a brand designer, a video production partner who also handles Meta Ads, and a Google Ads specialist. You will collaborate with these specialists and our internal team to keep marketing organized, accurate, consistent, and moving forward.

The right person can take an agreed direction, ask useful questions, and turn it into finished work without needing instructions for every step. You should enjoy learning a product, understanding its audience, and creating marketing with a clear purpose.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Content Writing and Product Marketing

Write and publish blogs, weekly newsletters, product announcements, press releases, website copy, and promotional
s.

Learn Wise Agent well enough to explain features accurately and connect them to problems real estate agents and brokers face.



Research real estate industry conversations, market challenges, coaches, and competitors to propose relevant content.

Develop content around a clear audience need, useful takeaway, and appropriate call to action.

Turn member stories, support questions, product updates, and webinar discussions into helpful marketing.

Maintain a consistent, approachable brand voice.



Proofread and verify product claims, links, dates, offers, and instructions before publication.

Apply practical SEO principles to articles and website content.



 Marketing and Automation

Write, build, test, schedule, and send our weekly newsletter and other marketing
s.

Create and maintain nurture campaigns, event promotions, product campaigns, and re-engagement sequences.

Segment audiences and maintain accurate campaign lists.



Check formatting, personalization, links, tracking, and mobile presentation before sending.

Monitor clicks, replies, registrations, conversions, bounces, and unsubscribes.

Recommend and execute improvements based on results.

Coordinate lead follow-up with our member success and support teams.



Social Media and Community Engagement



Maintain a purposeful content calendar across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other selected platforms.



Write platform-appropriate captions and create branded graphics, carousels, stories, and educational posts.

Coordinate approved video content with our video partner and verify that scheduled content publishes correctly.

Monitor comments, questions, and messages on company pages, posts, ads, and our member community.

Provide helpful responses, identify opportunities, and route support issues appropriately.



Participate in relevant real estate industry communities where permitted, clearly identifying your Wise Agent affiliation.

Build trust through useful answers and relevant information.

Evaluate whether social activity contributes to qualified traffic, conversations, registrations, and member engagement.

Monthly Podcast and Webinar Coordination

Coordinate guest invitations, topics, biographies, headshots, and other assets.

Maintain production timelines, outlines, registration pages, calendar invitations, and reminder schedules.

Organize registration questions for the host and internal reviewers.

Create and execute
 and social promotions to build attendance.

Coordinate promotional materials with associations, partners, and guests.

Work with our video partner on recordings, replay content, and highlight clips.

Publish approved replay materials and coordinate attendee and registrant follow-up.

Track registrations, attendance, engagement, and follow-up results.

Partner, Affiliate, and Ambassador Marketing

Create promotional
s, co-branded materials, and content partners can easily share.

Coordinate podcast and campaign promotion with real estate associations and industry partners.

Maintain partner deadlines, asset requests, tracking links, and follow-up.

Help reactivate and support our affiliate and ambassador programs.

Keep promotional resources accurate, current, and organized.



Campaign Coordination and Analytics

Coordinate product launches, feature releases, seasonal promotions, and event campaigns.

Work with our Meta and Google Ads specialists on messaging, creative briefs, landing pages, and follow-up.

Use Google Analytics 4 to evaluate traffic sources, key events, and conversion funnels.

Use consistent campaign tracking links and identify missing or questionable attribution.

Distinguish leads, trial registrations, activated accounts, and paying members when reporting results.

Prepare a concise weekly update covering completed work, results, problems, next steps, and decisions needed.

Recommend practical tests and improvements based on evidence.



Marketing Operations and Creative Support

Keep the marketing calendar, assignments, approvals, deadlines, and assets organized.

Follow up promptly after meetings and raise obstacles before deadlines are missed.

Use our Lovable-based Video Studio, marketing Claude account, and other company tools.

Use AI to assist with research, drafting, and repurposing while personally checking accuracy and quality.

Create and adapt graphics using appropriate design tools.

Provide basic video editing or screen-recording support when needed.

Document repeatable processes and keep work accessible in company-owned systems.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

At least three years of hands-on digital marketing experience with responsibility for finished campaigns or published content.

Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to write clear, natural copy for a U.S. business audience.

Strong samples of marketing
s, articles, and social content you personally created.

Experience building and sending
 campaigns, including segmentation, testing, and reporting.

Experience managing social publishing and responding professionally to an online community.

Practical Google Analytics 4 experience, including interpreting traffic sources and conversion funnels.

Strong organization, prioritization, and deadline management.

Ability to learn a software product and explain its value accurately.

Confidence collaborating with leadership, designers, developers, support staff, and outside specialists.

Reliable computer, internet connection, and a backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.

Consistent availability during the required Arizona working hours.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

U.S. real estate, real estate technology, CRM, or SaaS marketing.

Podcast or webinar coordination and promotion.

Affiliate, ambassador, association, or partner marketing.

SEO, WordPress, landing page copy, and conversion improvement.

Familiarity with Meta Ads and Google Ads reporting.

Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, or comparable design tools.

Basic short-form video editing and screen-recorded product demonstrations.

Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools with strong editing and fact-checking practices.



TOOLS YOU MAY USE

Wise Agent CRM

Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console

Lovable-based Video Studio and social calendar

Claude and ChatGPT



Google Workspace

Slack

Zoom

Meta Business Suite

Canva, Adobe tools, or comparable creative software

WordPress and
 publishing tools

Training will be provided on Wise Agent and our internal systems.



WORK SCHEDULE

This position follows our Arizona office schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time, including a 30-minute unpaid meal break, for a total of 40 paid hours per week.

In the Philippines, this is Monday through Friday, 11:00 p.m.–7:30 a.m. the following morning, with the final shift ending Saturday morning. Arizona does not observe daylight saving time, so this schedule stays consistent throughout the year.

You must be available and responsive during these hours for collaboration, training, meetings, and marketing execution. Please apply only if this overnight schedule is sustainable for you.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS

Learn Wise Agent’s core features, audience, brand voice, and marketing processes.

Independently maintain an accurate marketing calendar and meet recurring publishing deadlines.

Produce useful content that requires progressively fewer corrections.

Execute a complete podcast or webinar promotion cycle with the team.

Keep social questions and messages monitored and appropriately handled.

Establish clear weekly reporting and identify tracking or follow-up gaps.

Implement and evaluate practical improvements to content,
, or campaigns.

Keep processes and assets organized so another team member can find and use them.



COMPENSATION AND OPPORTUNITY

Starting pay of 8–11 USD per hour, based on relevant experience, portfolio quality, and demonstrated ability.

Long-term, full-time opportunity with an established software company.

Direct collaboration with leadership and an experienced international team.

Training on Wise Agent, our audience, brand voice, and marketing systems.

Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.

Performance reviews at 3, 6, and 12 months, with the opportunity for pay increases based on performance, quality of work, initiative, and increased responsibility. Pay increases are considered at each review but are not guaranteed. 



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject:

Wise Agent Marketing Specialist | [Your Name]



Please include:

Your resume.



Three existing work samples: one marketing
 or newsletter, one blog or article, and one social campaign or branded creative. Explain what you personally did and any results you can share.



A short explanation of how you organize recurring deadlines and follow through on assignments.



Your experience with U.S. real estate, CRM software, or SaaS marketing.



Your expected hourly rate, earliest available start date, and confirmation that you can consistently work 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time, Monday through Friday, equivalent to 11:00 p.m.–7:30 a.m. Philippine time.



Bonus points: Include a quick 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, explaining why this role interests you, and highlighting a marketing project you personally took from idea to completion. A simple phone or webcam recording is perfect. We’re interested in your communication and approach, so no polished production is needed.

title: Social Media Video
description:
Job Summary:

We're looking for a video editor who can take raw footage and turn it into short, disruptive content videos. You find the 30 seconds that matter in a 40-minute interview, cut it so it stands on its own, and deliver a high-quality video in every size and dimension the platform needs. Must work in EST hours. 



About the company:

Navara works with energy and home service brands that provide fuel, HVAC maintenance, and more. As our Social Media Video Editor, you'll edit 20–30 short-form videos a month for our clients: interview cutdowns, customer-service explainers, and "why choose us" brand videos. You'll take direction straight from our Project Manager and work as part of our Execution Team.



We move fast, especially in peak season (think winter storms for customers that use heating oil to warm their home). Volume goes up and down. Hitting deadlines and keeping to your hours matters.



Responsibilities:

- Edit interviews and conversations into short, standalone clips. Pull the exact moments you're given, reorder them, and make them make sense on their own.

- Edit short videos that help our clients win customers.

- Deliver every video in the sizes social needs; reframe the shot properly. 

- Add accurate captions, clean up audio, and do basic color correction on every video.

- Work directly with Client Partners: take their feedback, ask questions early, and turn revisions around fast.

- Keep files organized and named the same way every time, so anyone on the team can find them.

- Track your work, deadlines, and hours.

- Flag problems early and say when something needs a decision from someone else.

- Stay current on what's working in social video: hooks, formats, trends, and platform changes. Bring ideas to Client Partners when something could make a video perform better.



Qualifications:

- 2+ years editing short-form social video (agency experience is a plus).

- A portfolio with at least 3 short-form edits, including one cut from a longer interview or talking-head video.

- Strong in Adobe Premiere Pro (or another pro editor you can show work from). 

- Comfortable with Canva for simple graphics.

- Knows how vertical video works: hooks in the first 2 seconds, captions on screen, reframing for each size.

- Bonus: experience with energy, HVAC, propane, heating oil, or other home service brands.

- Bonus: motion graphics or After Effects skills.



About You:

- You do what you say you'll do, on time.

title: Sales Licensing Manager – YouTube & Media (Remote)
description:
Company: KOPS | Amsterdam, Netherlands

Location: Philippines – Fully Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time, with the opportunity to become Full-Time

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM Manila Time (occasional overtime may be required)

Hiring: ASAP



About KOPS



KOPS is a growing media company based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, led by Jordi, one of the biggest content creators on YouTube. Our main YouTube channel has over 15 million subscribers, alongside our gaming channel with over 5 million subscribers.



We operate in the fast-paced world of YouTube, digital entertainment, and media, creating opportunities to expand our reach through strategic partnerships and content licensing.



We are looking for a talented Filipino Sales Licensing Manager to join our growing international team. This is an opportunity for an experienced sales professional who understands the YouTube and media industry, knows how to communicate with business partners, and has the ability to turn opportunities into successful deals.



About the Role



We need someone who can take ownership of our licensing sales process from start to finish. You will be responsible for managing incoming licensing inquiries, engaging with prospective clients, presenting our channels and content, conducting sales calls, negotiating agreements, and following through until contracts are signed.



This is not a purely administrative position. We need someone who is confident speaking with clients, understands the business they are selling into, and can independently move opportunities forward without constant supervision.



You will work directly with our licensing pipeline and use HubSpot to manage active deals, review client conversations, track upcoming calls, identify opportunities that need follow-up, and ensure that no potential deal is left unattended.



What You Will Do



You will manage our licensing inbox and respond to incoming inquiries, ensuring that potential partners receive timely and professional communication. You will review active opportunities in HubSpot, monitor upcoming calls, follow up with clients who have questions, and reconnect with prospects who have not yet made a decision.



You will lead sales conversations with potential licensing partners, confidently pitch KOPS's YouTube channels and content, explain our licensing opportunities, address client questions, and handle objections. You will be expected to understand what we offer and communicate its commercial value to prospective buyers and partners.



You will manage the entire sales cycle, from qualifying interested prospects and arranging meetings to conducting calls, negotiating commercial terms, coordinating contracts, and following through until the deal is closed. You will also maintain accurate records in HubSpot, update deal stages, document conversations, and ensure every active opportunity has a clear next step.



You will proactively identify opportunities to grow our licensing business, build relationships with relevant media companies and commercial partners, and help improve our sales processes and conversion rates. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and understands that consistent communication is essential to closing deals.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a candidate with extensive end-to-end sales experience and a strong background in YouTube, digital media, entertainment, content licensing, or a related industry. You should understand how the media business operates and be familiar with the commercial opportunities surrounding YouTube content and distribution.



You must have excellent written and spoken English and be comfortable leading professional conversations with international clients. You should be confident presenting offers, negotiating terms, handling objections, and persuading potential partners to move forward.



Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms is highly desirable. You should know how to manage a sales pipeline, prioritize active deals, track follow-ups, and maintain accurate client records.



We need someone who is proactive, organized, commercially minded, and capable of working independently in a remote environment. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your own pipeline, identifying what needs to happen next, and acting without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.



Most importantly, you must know your line of business. We are looking for someone who already understands sales and the YouTube or media industry, rather than someone who needs to learn the fundamentals from scratch.



Work Schedule and Opportunity



This is a fully remote, part-time position with a regular schedule of Monday to Friday, from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM Manila Time. Occasional overtime may be necessary to accommodate client calls, negotiations, or important business opportunities.



As KOPS continues to expand, this position has the potential to transition into a full-time role for the right candidate. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and contribute to building a successful licensing operation.



We are looking to hire as soon as possible.



How to Apply



If you believe you have the experience, industry knowledge, and confidence to succeed in this role, please send your updated resume and a short video introduction to 
 with a subject line: Sales KOPS.



In your video, introduce yourself, explain your experience in end-to-end sales, highlight your background in YouTube or media, and tell us why you would be a strong fit for this position.



Please ensure your video is professionally recorded, with clear audio and appropriate presentation. Speak confidently and naturally, as if you were speaking directly to a potential client. Do not read from a script. We want to see your genuine communication skills, confidence, and ability to present yourself professionally.



Applications without a video introduction may not be prioritized.



If you are an experienced sales professional who understands YouTube and media, knows how to build client relationships, and can confidently turn opportunities into closed deals, we would love to hear from you.

title: Orthodontic Insurance & Patient Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines-based candidates only

Schedule: Monday to Wednesday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Thursday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM (approx. 34 hours/week). Long-term role with hours expected to increase for the right person.

Work Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Overnight schedule in the Philippines)

Compensation: $7.00 to $9.00 USD/hour (based on experience)

 

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, warm, and experienced Orthodontic Insurance Coordinator to join our remote team supporting a U.S. orthodontic practice!



In this role, you will take ownership of the practice’s front-end insurance workflow—including eligibility verification, claim submissions, follow-ups, and insurance A/R. You will also manage Medicaid claims from submission all the way through payment posting and EOB uploads.



Beyond billing, you’ll serve as our friendly back-end phone support for the scheduling coordinator—answering incoming calls, booking appointments from a simple template, and gracefully handling patients or parents running late.

This is a stable, long-term growth role designed for someone who wants to master practice revenue cycles and expand into deeper back-end tasks (like denials and appeals) over time.



What You’ll Do

1. Insurance (Front End): Verify patient orthodontic/dental insurance eligibility and benefits before visits, submit claims accurately, follow up on aging/unpaid claims, and keep insurance A/R moving.

2. Medicaid Management: Submit Medicaid claims, post payments accurately, and upload EOBs to the correct patient charts.

3. Growth Path (Back End): Handle denials/rejections and prepare corrected claims and appeals as you build mastery.

4. Phone Support: Back up the scheduling coordinator by taking calls, booking appointments using office templates, and managing late arrivals with a friendly, professional tone.

5. Communication & Documentation: Maintain clean, detailed notes on claims/calls and keep both our remote team and the U.S. office updated proactively.



What You Must Have (The Essentials)

1. Experience: 1+ year of hands-on U.S. orthodontic or dental insurance billing experience (eligibility, claims, follow-ups, and A/R).

2. Medicaid Experience: Hands-on experience submitting Medicaid claims, posting payments, and uploading EOBs.

3. Communication & Phone Skills: A warm, confident, and natural phone presence with U.S. patients/parents, combined with the ability to book appointments live during calls.

4. Responsiveness: Clear, proactive communication and fast response times without needing to be chased.

5. Attention to Detail: Impeccable data entry and posting accuracy.

6. Technical Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power/internet plan, and a quiet workspace free from background noise for calls.



Nice to Haves

1. Specialized orthodontic billing experience (TIP claims, payment installments, lifetime maximums, age limits).

2. Familiarity with orthodontic/dental software or clearinghouses (Ortho2 Edge, OrthoTrac, Dolphin, Open Dental, Dentrix, Curve, DentalXChange).

3. Prior exposure to denials, appeals, and full-cycle revenue management.



How to Apply

To make sure you are a great fit and pay attention to detail, please submit all 4 items below when applying. Incomplete applications cannot be reviewed.



1. Resume Link: A viewable link via Google Drive or Dropbox. (Make sure sharing permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view").

2. Experience Paragraph (4–6 sentences): Briefly cover:

     Your U.S. ortho/dental insurance billing and front-end experience.

     Your Medicaid experience (which states and tasks handled).

     Any phone or scheduling experience with U.S. callers.

3. Claim Success Example: A short written description (3–4 sentences) of a claim or A/R problem you personally solved (The Issue, What You Did, and The Result).

4. Voice Sample Link: A link to a 60-to-90 second recording (using Vocaroo, Loom, etc.) handling this scenario:



"A parent calls to say they will be 15 minutes late for their child’s braces adjustment, and the schedule is tight." (Please start by briefly introducing yourself as if answering the office phone).



Please confirm in your application message that you are comfortable with the U.S. overnight shift schedule.

description:
ABOUT US



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago. People who join our tours have loads of fun as we explore Chicago neighborhoods, enjoy delicious ice cream treats at local businesses, and learn fun facts about ice cream and the city. Guests smile, mingle, laugh, and enjoy America’s #1 dessert. Good vibes are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on our team.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a proven, full-cycle B2B closer to grow our private tour and group sales. You will find new clients, build lasting relationships, and book private tours from the first conversation to the confirmed booking. You will work directly with our founder as a true partner in building our sales plan and generating income for the business.



Sales always comes first. You will also support projects across the company as needed.



Partnerships in this role means the relationships that bring in bookings and run our tours. Sponsorships are handled separately and are not part of this role.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



● Run the full sales cycle with corporate teams, wedding planners, hotels, convention planners, and alumni groups, from first outreach to booked tour.

● Make outbound calls and send outreach every day to build a strong, healthy pipeline.

● Grow accounts over time, so one great contact leads to repeat bookings and referrals across departments, couples, and groups.

● Manage relationships with our tour partner shops and our referral partners.

● Track every lead, conversation, and deal in our CRM, and report on results weekly.

● Partner with our founder on the sales plan, and support company projects as needed.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 8+ years of US B2B sales experience with increasing revenue responsibility.

● A proven full-cycle closer with provable results and references from employers, clients, and customers.

● A consistent track record of long-term engagements with employers or clients, typically two years or more.

● Expert at building long-term relationships, growing a book of business, and creating reliable, recurring revenue from repeat clients and referrals.

● Strong pipeline management, consistent follow-up, and a solid post-sale process that turns happy clients into referrals.

● Clear, confident, professional spoken and written English, and professionally presentable on video calls.



Preferred: experience in tourism, hospitality, or events.



This role is open to candidates in any country at the stated USD pay, as long as you meet every requirement and can work during our US Central Time hours.



SCHEDULE & PAY

● Core hours 10 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, predominantly Monday through Friday, with flexibility to meet business needs.

● Weekly team meeting, Tuesdays 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM US Central Time (required).

● Optional online team events, held at various times.

● $6 to $9 per hour, plus potential bonus, plus commission on every booking you close.

● Independent contractor.

● Target start date: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, with flexibility if more time is needed on your side.



GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation and fun as a company culture. We perform with excellence and have a good time along the way.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: Write your own
 subject line. Make us want to open your
.



Cover letter (required): Two paragraphs, simple and to the point.



Paragraph 1, your personality. Tell us why Ice Cream Sunshine caught your eye and how you bring good vibes to your clients and team.



Paragraph 2, your proof. Describe one US B2B client relationship you built and grew, including how it turned into repeat business or referrals, with real numbers. Then add one or two sentences about your additional sales expertise and results, including your typical annual sales range (for example, $250,000 or $2 million per year).

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We sell VerraField, a field sales tool for roofing companies in the United States. Your job is to call roofing company owners from a list we give you and book them into a fifteen-minute video demo with our sales manager. You don't run the demo or sell anything. You get the owner on the phone, run a short script, and put a time on his calendar.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call US roofing company owners from our list during US morning hours.

- Get past the front desk to the owner. Most calls end at a receptionist or a voi
. That's normal, and it's the job.

- Run our script. It's short. You'll drill it before your first live call.

- Book a fifteen-minute video demo and lock it in: cell number, the
 the owner actually reads, calendar invite accepted before you hang up. Owners who show are how your appointments close.

- Log every call in our CRM: who you reached, what happened, when to call back.

- Honor every do-not-call request on the spot and log it.



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- The list. You never find your own leads.

- The CRM you log every call in, and the script.

- Training on the script and the product before you dial.

- Me. I'm the sales manager. I review your calls every week and tell you exactly what to fix.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least one year cold calling US or UK businesses by phone. Appointment setting for a US company is the ideal background. Real estate, solar, insurance, roofing, agency work, all of it counts.

- Clear English on the phone that a busy roofing owner follows without effort. If he has to work to understand you, he hangs up. I hire from the voice recording, so send a good one.

- You can take a "no" fifty times in a row and dial the next one the same way.

- Your own computer, a quality wired headset, stable internet, and a quiet room. No background noise on calls.

- Available Monday to Friday, 8:00 PM to midnight Philippine time, every week (an hour later once US clocks change in November).



PAY

- $4 USD/hour base, paid for every hour worked, including training.

- $5 bonus for every appointment you book that becomes a paying customer.

- If you book, hours go up. I'd rather grow one good caller to full time than hire three average ones.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word ROOF so we know you read this. Then include:

1. A 60 to 90 second voice recording (a link is fine) introducing yourself and telling us about the last cold calling job you had: who you called, what you were booking, and how many calls a day you made.

2. How long you've cold called US or UK businesses, and for what kind of company.

3. Confirm you can work 8:00 PM to midnight Philippine time, Monday to Friday.

4. Your internet speed and the headset you use.



No recording, no review. If you're shortlisted you get a video interview with me, then a practice session on the script before you ever call a real owner.



VerraField is a product of NextVerra LLC, Alabama, USA.
