title: Consumer Product Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Swooc Games is one of the fastest-growing game companies in the U.S., creating innovative products that bring people together through play. Since 2015, we have grown into an eight-figure business, and we’re continuing to expand into new product categories.



As part of this growth, we’re developing a new collection of thoughtfully designed children’s furniture, activity products, and home products that encourage creativity, learning, and family connection.



We are seeking a dedicated and committed candidate for a long-term position with room for growth at our company.



For a candidate with the drive to learn and grow, this truly is an amazing opportunity. We are recruiting, training & building a team for long and successful careers with our company. Our ideal candidate is committed to growing together with us, and in turn, we will give you all the tools and support to succeed and grow in your career.



Are you passionate about:

- Think Big

- Learn & Grow

- Focus on the Future

- Be Fueled by Innovation

- Take Ownership

- Be Respectful



Then, you've found the right place! Our team values these qualities and seeks individuals who are enthusiastic about making an impact.



This opportunity may not be the perfect match if:

- You're just looking for any gig to try

- Adapting to USA working hours doesn't fit your schedule





ABOUT THE ROLE

As part of the Swooc Games Team, your mission is to design commercial products (primarily children's furniture and outdoor games), coordinate associated manufacturing processes, and collaborate with the team to turn ideas into marketable products.



- Design products from ideation through final production in collaboration with the product development team, other department heads, and manufacturers.

- Ensure products are designed to be cost-effective, suitable for mass production, and easy for customers to assemble, particularly for knock-down (KD) products.

- Coordinate with the product development team and vendors/manufacturers to finalize product concepts and specifications.

- Create rough/initial product designs using sketches and design software.

- Create 3D models and 2D technical drawings using Autodesk Inventor, including complete product designs, dimensions, and specifications.

- Create step-by-step visual presentations and documentation for customer assembly guides.

- Select appropriate product materials and develop manufacturing processes based on product requirements.

- Create Bills of Materials (BOMs), exploded assembly views, and assembly instructions.

- Test and evaluate product prototypes to identify and correct design flaws and opportunities for improvement.

- Evaluate product prototypes to identify and address potential safety hazards.

- Collaborate with shipping and logistics teams to identify cost-effective manufacturing procedures and materials.

- Analyze the feasibility, cost, and potential return on investment (ROI) of product ideas.

- Work with manufacturers to troubleshoot and resolve design- and manufacturing-related issues.



ABOUT YOU

The ideal candidate must have the following knowledge, skills, and work experience.



- Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent proven industry experience in furniture/product design and manufacturing.

- 3+ years of product engineering experience is required.

- Experience designing children’s furniture, Montessori furniture, wooden home products, or other ready-to-assemble wooden products is strongly preferred.

- Key Competencies: Creative/Innovative, Highly Organized & Effective Planning, Strategic Thinking/Visioning,

Results-Oriented, Detail-Oriented, High Standards

- Proficiency in 3D CAD software, Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred.

- Adheres to ASME Y14.5 engineering drawing standards

- Experience or exposure to parts fabrication, 3D printing, plastic injection molding, and conventional/CNC machining is an advantage.

- Knowledge of furniture/wood-product construction, assembly methods, hardware/fasteners, material selection, and design for manufacturing (DFM) is highly preferred.

- Google Workspace, MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint

- Asana, Slack





CONTRACT TYPE

We are flexible and open to either:

- Part-Time (approximately 20–25 hours per week | 08:00am to 01:00pm EST)





SALARY & BENEFITS

- $10-15 per hour depending on experience

- Benefits vary depending on the contract arrangement

- Work-Life Balance

- Payments made biweekly via Wise



If you are a great fit for this position, please reply to this job post with a resume and example of your 2d drawings.



For the drawing package, please include:



• Overall assembly with 2D/isometric views, BOM, and exploded view.

• One subassembly with its own views, BOM, and exploded view.

• One individual part manufacturing drawing with dimensions, tolerances, material, and finish.



Please use ASME standards. 



Applications without a drawing package will not be considered. All information you provide will remain strictly confidential.



Swooc Games team is looking forward to meeting you!
